Savills began in the mid-nineteenth century as Savill and Son and has grown into a global real estate services business. The company provides advisory, transactional and management services across property sectors, including valuation, planning, investment advice, property management, consultancy and buying or selling support. Savills serves residential, commercial and agricultural clients through a wide international network spanning the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa and the Middle East. Its market presence is built around specialist expertise, research and services that support clients across the property lifecycle.

The company works across office, residential, mixed-use, industrial and logistics, and life science and health care sectors. Its services include development support across design, construction management, leasing, and financing, along with broader solutions for nearly every product type. Trammell Crow Company maintains a national and international presence through its offices and projects, supported by a long record of buildings developed or acquired over time.

Prudential began in 1875 as the Prudential Friendly Society in Newark, New Jersey, and grew into Prudential Financial, a diversified financial services company. The company serves individual and institutional customers through life and health insurance, retirement services, annuities, mutual funds, and investment management. Prudential operates across the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America, and its business portfolio includes insurance, retirement, and asset-management activities.

PGIM, formerly Prudential Investment Management, is the asset management business of Prudential Financial and a trading name used by PGIM, Inc. and its affiliates. The company traces its legacy to 1875 and provides active management and client-focused advisory services across public and private markets. PGIM's investment platform spans fixed income, equity, private markets, real estate, private credit, and multi-asset strategies for institutional and individual investors. The company maintains a broad global footprint and delivers investment solutions across major financial markets worldwide.

EY’s purpose is clear: to build a better working world. Through trusted insights and high-quality professional services, EY strengthens confidence in global capital markets and economies. The firm develops exceptional leaders who collaborate to deliver on commitments to clients, communities, and stakeholders worldwide. In an era of rapid change, EY’s purpose serves as a guiding principle—providing meaning and direction for its people and the work they do every day. EY helps digital innovators combat data piracy, advises governments through fiscal challenges, unlocks new medical treatments using advanced analytics, and delivers rigorous audits that reinforce trust in financial markets. From entrepreneurs to multinational corporations and even entire nations, EY partners with clients to solve their most pressing challenges and create long-term value.

Since 1967, RCLCO (formerly Robert Charles Lesser & Co.) has been the “first call” for real estate developers, investors, the public sector, and non-real estate companies and organizations seeking strategic and tactical advice regarding property investment, planning, and development.  RCLCO leverages quantitative analytics and a strategic planning framework to provide end-to-end business planning and implementation solutions at an entity, portfolio, or project level. With the insights and experience gained over 50 years and thousands of projects – touching over $5B of real estate activity each year – RCLCO brings success to all product types across the United States and around the world.

PwC is a British professional services network that provides audit, consulting, deals, and tax services for public and private clients. The company combines industry-focused capabilities with work in technology, risk, analytics, legal services, and financial advisory, serving organisations across a broad range of sectors. PwC traces its roots to London in the mid-19th century and later took shape through a merger of major accounting firms, giving the business a long history in client service and assurance. The firm maintains a significant global presence and continues to organize its work around trust, transformation, and problem-solving for clients in the UK and beyond.

In 1936, two architects and an engineer formed a partnership; their founders understood the power of combining their expertise within a single firm. Since then, SOM has grown to include urban designers and planners, interior designers, and more. Their teams are composed of designers with an artistic sensibility, architects and engineers with highly specialized technical knowledge, and planners with a deep understanding of policy and economics. The synthesis of these viewpoints generates design solutions that no single person could have imagined on their own. From sustainable engineering, to healthcare design, to regenerative city planning, none of their areas of expertise stands alone. Each is deeply interwoven with the others, informing and being informed by them.

Kennedy Wilson is a Beverly Hills-based real estate investment company founded in 1977 by William J. McMorrow. Originally established as a real estate auction business, the firm has evolved into a global investment manager with $36 billion of assets under management across the western United States, United Kingdom, and Ireland. The company operates through both a principal investment platform and an investment management business, focusing on multifamily housing, office properties, industrial assets, and real estate credit. Kennedy Wilson expanded internationally in 2011 through its involvement in the Bank of Ireland recapitalization, establishing a European platform with offices in Dublin and London. In 2017, the firm completed a merger with Kennedy Wilson Europe Real Estate Plc, consolidating its transatlantic operations. The company employs approximately 324 people across 19 global offices. In June 2026, Kennedy Wilson completed a take-private transaction led by Fairfax Financial Holdings and the company's management team, ending its tenure as a publicly traded company under ticker symbol KW on the New York Stock Exchange. The firm maintains 44,500 multifamily units and 24.4 million square feet of industrial, retail, and office space, complemented by $11 billion in loan investments. Kennedy Wilson targets supply-constrained markets in the western US states including California, Washington, Idaho, Nevada, Arizona, and Colorado, alongside select investments in Ireland and the UK. The company has closed over $60 billion in transactions across the property spectrum over the past 17 years.growth. In Ireland, the company owns 3,500 apartment units primarily in Dublin. The multifamily portfolio maintains 95 percent occupancy and generates approximately $300 million in estimated annual net operating income.

Gruen Associates traces its roots to Victor Gruen Associates, established in 1946 as a practice bringing together professionals from engineering, architecture, and planning. Over the years, the company has developed a broad portfolio of work in architecture, interior design, planning, urban design, environmental assessment, landscape architecture, and transportation planning, with services that also include master planning, feasibility analysis, design development, project management, and construction administration. Gruen Associates presents itself as a long-standing legacy firm with an ongoing focus on collaborative professional services for projects of many types and levels of complexity.

Sumitomo Corporation began in 1919 as The Osaka North Harbour Company Limited and later evolved from its early real estate roots into a broad trading and investment business. The company now operates across multiple business verticals, including steel, automotive, transportation and construction systems, urban development, communication services, digital and AI, lifestyle, mineral resources, chemical solutions, and energy transformation. As part of the Sumitomo Group, the business has grown into one of the major global sogo shosha firms, with activities spanning worldwide markets and a wide network of commercial relationships.

State Street traces its roots to Union Bank, founded in 1792, and has grown into a financial services firm focused on institutional investors. State Street provides investment servicing, markets and financing, and investment management, with offerings that include custody, accounting, administration, trading, foreign exchange, research, and tailored investment solutions. State Street also serves wealth managers through custody, clearing, advisory technology, and related digital platforms. The company works across public and private assets and serves asset managers and owners, insurance companies, official institutions, and central banks through a broad global presence.

JPMorgan Chase began in 1799 through the founding of the Bank of the Manhattan Company, and the modern firm took shape in 2000 through the merger of Chase Manhattan and J.P. Morgan. The company operates as a financial holding company with businesses in consumer and community banking, commercial and investment banking, asset and wealth management, and financial transaction processing. JPMorgan Chase serves millions of consumers, small businesses, corporations, institutional clients, and government clients through a broad mix of banking, lending, investing, payments, and treasury services. The firm maintains a broad market presence in the United States and abroad, with operations across many global markets and a long-running focus on financial services for households, businesses, and institutions.

Morrison Foerster began in 1883 as a San Francisco law practice and grew into an international law firm. The firm advises clients across corporate transactions, litigation, intellectual property, finance, regulatory matters, and other business-focused legal work. Morrison Foerster serves companies and institutions in sectors such as technology, life sciences, financial services, and government-related work. The firm maintains a broad presence across the United States, Asia, and Europe, supporting cross-border matters and complex disputes.

3Com has had a major impact on computer networking since the creation of Ethernet in 1979 with over 1,300 issued U.S. patents and more than 300 pending U.S. patent applications to date. A leading provider of secure, converged voice and data networking solutions that reduce network complexity and cost for businesses of all sizes, 3Com has an annual revenue of $651 million (FY05 year ended June 3, 2005) and a total of 1,500 employees (FY06) in over 41 countries.

BGRE, formerly Brookfield Properties, is the global real estate operating and development platform within the Brookfield organization. The company adopted the BGRE name in July 2026, with the rebranding involving no change to its operations or personnel. BGRE manages more than 330 million square feet of office, logistics, hospitality, retail and residential space across more than 1,400 properties worldwide.
BGRE operates as part of Brookfield’s broader global real estate business, which has approximately $280 billion in assets under management and more than 500 million square feet of commercial real estate. Brookfield’s real estate holdings span housing, logistics, hospitality, science and innovation, office and retail, including approximately 192 million square feet of office space, more than 160 million square feet of logistics space, and substantial residential and hospitality portfolios.
The platform traces its roots to 1923 and maintains its headquarters at Brookfield Place in New York. Its current portfolio reflects decades of acquisitions, development and active asset management across major global markets. Brookfield's investment strategy emphasizes acquiring high-quality assets on a value basis and enhancing returns through active management and its owner-operator capabilities.
BGRE benefits from the scale and investment capabilities of the broader Brookfield organization. Brookfield Asset Management currently oversees more than $1 trillion of assets under management and reported $672 billion of fee-bearing capital at June 30, 2026.

The company's service portfolio includes office, industrial, retail, and multifamily properties. While the early focus was on multifamily properties, the Company's investment focus evolved to include office properties and complementary retail space in California and Honolulu, Hawaii. The company owns and operates two asset classes: Class A office and multifamily apartments. Plante Moran is a certified public accounting and business advisory firm founded in 1924. The company provides audit, tax, consulting, and wealth management services, with offerings that include financial planning, cybersecurity, transaction advisory, and support for operations and strategy. Plante Moran serves clients across industries such as manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, construction, real estate, private equity, public sector, and energy. The firm has grown into a broad professional services business with a substantial market presence in the United States and beyond.

Howard Hughes Communities is the real estate development and community-building platform of Howard Hughes Holdings (NYSE: HHH), a publicly traded holding company headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. The company was formed in 2010 as a spin-off from General Growth Properties during its bankruptcy reorganization. Based in The Woodlands, Texas, the company plans and builds master planned communities. It sells improved residential land to homebuilders and puts the proceeds into office, retail, multifamily and hospitality projects, which it keeps as income-producing properties. Its communities cover about 101,000 gross acres in five states. They include The Woodlands, Bridgeland and The Woodlands Hills in the Houston area, Summerlin in Las Vegas, Teravalis in the Phoenix West Valley, Downtown Columbia in Maryland and Ward Village in Honolulu.
The operating portfolio has about 7.2 million square feet of office space, 2.2 million square feet of retail space and 5,203 multifamily units. Nearly half of the office and retail space is in The Woodlands. Major holdings include The Woodlands Towers at The Waterway, a 1.4 million-square-foot office complex where Occidental leases an 808,000-square-foot tower. Other major holdings are Downtown Summerlin and the Merriweather District in Columbia. At the 60-acre Ward Village, the company builds and sells condominium towers. The Park Ward Village was completed in 2026, and Kalae and The Launiu are under construction. Work on 'Ilima and Melia started in September 2026.
Major ownership changes occurred in May 2025 when Pershing Square Capital Management increased its stake to 47% through a $900 million investment, with Bill Ackman rejoining as Executive Chairman. In 2024, the company separated its entertainment-related assets into Seaport Entertainment Group, which now trades independently.

Hospitality at Work is Lowe’s hospitality-inspired commercial property management platform, built on decades of experience managing hotel, resort, and office properties. The company focuses on office buildings and combines property management, accounting and financial reporting, construction management, lease administration, due diligence, and compliance with tenant services such as programming, event hosting, health and wellness activities, and service coordination. Hospitality at Work also provides building maintenance, HVAC preventive maintenance and repair, energy optimization, and commissioning through a trusted affiliate partner. The business presents a guest-oriented workplace model for tenants, owners, vendors, and building users while drawing on Lowe’s broader real estate background across commercial, residential, institutional, hotel, and resort assets.

LaSalle Debt Investors is a U.S. commercial real estate credit platform within LaSalle Investment Management focused on originating floating-rate, first-mortgage bridge loans for value-add and transitional assets. The platform’s roots date to 2000 under Legg Mason Real Estate Investors; following a 2009 sale to Latitude Holdings, JLL (via LaSalle) acquired control of the business in 2019 and completed the buyout in 2023, integrating the team and strategy into its Americas debt franchise. Today, LaSalle Debt Investors emphasizes middle-market loan sizes, typically financing multifamily and multi-tenant industrial properties and selectively other income-producing asset classes. Its investment approach targets growth markets and major metro “gateway” cities across the U.S., leveraging LaSalle’s research and origination network to source loans with active in-house asset management.

The operation is a lender rather than a property owner; portfolio exposure is measured by loan collateral and borrower mix rather than owned GLA. While detailed market weightings are not publicly reported, the team’s focus and recent activity point to durable demand in Sun Belt metros and coastal gateways—e.g., Dallas–Fort Worth, Phoenix, and Southern California—supported by job growth and supply barriers. As a lender, top tenants vary by collateral and are not consolidated; the borrower base is middle-market sponsors, often repeat relationships, and loan performance is monitored with integrated origination, underwriting, and asset management.

profile.locationBio: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency was created in 1863 as a bureau of the U.S. Department of the Treasury and now serves as an independent federal bank regulator. The agency charters, regulates, and supervises national banks and federal savings associations, and it also licenses, regulates, and supervises federal branches and agencies of foreign banking organizations. The OCC examines the condition of supervised banks and their compliance with laws and regulations, while also overseeing banking-related third-party services and enforcing federal banking laws. The agency's work includes supervision, enforcement, guidance, and publication of banking resources that support safety, soundness, and fair access to financial services.

The firm is positioned as a broad platform for clients across property types such as multifamily, industrial, office, retail, and hospitality.

Kroll began in 1932 as Duff & Phelps and later adopted the Kroll brand after expanding through acquisitions and a broader service mix. The company provides financial and risk advisory services centered on value, risk, governance, transactions, and valuation. Its work spans valuation advisory, dispute and expert services, tax and transfer pricing, real estate and fixed asset advisory, transaction opinions, private capital markets, and business services for restructurings, legal settlements, and other complex matters. Kroll also serves clients in areas such as financial services, investigations, and cyber-related risk work, giving the firm a broad presence across advisory, compliance, and transaction support markets.

Prescott Realty Group was founded in 1996 and grew from an initial portfolio of office buildings and land into a broader real estate operations business. The company manages office, multifamily, mixed-use, and transit-oriented properties, with capabilities spanning property management, construction management, asset management, leasing, and development. Prescott Group also operates related businesses in investments and debt servicing, giving the organization a wider platform across real estate market cycles.

The Commercial Real Estate Firm of David Z. Mafrige Interests was established in 1989. Mafrige Interests has been actively involved in over $2 billion worth of real estate transactions and has in excess of two and a half million square feet of improved property. David Z. Mafrige Interests is dedicated to redeveloping exceptional retail and office properties. A close-knit group of professionals, combining youthful enthusiasm and seasoned experience, is actively engaged in commercial property marketing. Midtown Central Square, LLC is a Texas real estate company centered on Central Square, an office property in Midtown Houston. The business focuses on office leasing and related property services, and the property includes office and retail space alongside valet parking, an on-site parking garage, conference rooms, a training room, restaurants, and tenant wellness amenities. The company maintains an active leasing operation tied to the asset, while the broader property strategy places the location within Houston's commercial office market.

CIM Group is a real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender and developer based in Los Angeles. Shaul Kuba, Richard Ressler and Avi Shemesh founded the firm in 1994. In February 2018 it acquired Cole Capital from VEREIT. On June 24, 2026, CIM Real Estate Finance Trust (CMFT), a non-listed REIT managed by CIM affiliates, acquired the real assets management business and investment portfolio of CIM Group, LLC and renamed itself CIM Group, Inc. CIM Group Holdings, a CIM Group, LLC subsidiary, holds 67.5% of the economic and voting interest. Former CMFT shareholders hold the other 32.5%. The company ended its REIT status effective January 1, 2026. Its common stock is quoted over-the-counter under the ticker CMRF, and the company has committed to start pursuing a national exchange listing within 24 months.

CIM reports $31.8 billion in assets owned and operated across five platforms: Real Estate, Credit, Infrastructure, Opportunity Zones and Strategic Opportunities. Its real estate strategies cover core, value-add, net lease and ground-up development. Capital deployed in real estate breaks down as residential at $17.3 billion (37%), office at $11.3 billion (24%), land and horizontal development at $2.3 billion (5%), and industrial at $875 million (2%). The firm also invests in hospitality, retail and mixed-use assets. It lends against office, multifamily, industrial and hospitality properties.

At year-end 2025, the company's own net lease portfolio had 202 properties totaling 6.7 million square feet in 37 states. The largest state exposures by annualized rental income were Virginia (16%), Ohio (12%) and Wisconsin (8%). Four tenants made up 28% of annualized rental income: CVS (9%), Cabela's (7%), United Oil (6%) and Lowe's (6%). Across the wider platform, CIM has invested about $4 billion of equity in the New York metropolitan area since 2010. It also has large projects in Los Angeles, Atlanta and Chicago. The firm has more than 900 employees.

Barrister Executive Suites began as AOMI and was renamed in 1990, building on a shared-office model first founded in 1966. The company provides flexible workspace solutions that include private offices, virtual office programs, business addresses, and meeting rooms. Barrister Executive Suites serves professional service firms and other businesses that need client-ready space, receptionist support, mail handling, and turnkey office arrangements across Southern California.

Cargile Company is pleased to offer personalized real estate services to Banks, Asset Managers, Portfolio Managers, Hedge Funds, REITs, and Private Equity Firms. We have a rich background in REO disposition. We have served the financial community for the past 30 years. We service all of Los Angeles county as well as Northern Orange County and Western Riverside County

Desmond, Marcello & Amster, founded in 1968, provides expertise in the valuation of privately held businesses and business assets, along with a wide range of litigation consulting and support services. They approach every assignment with commitment, ingenuity, and integrity. Intrinsic to their reputation and success is their emphasis on quality and responsiveness.

HQ Development, LLC, founded in 2003, is a dynamic real estate development firm specializing in creative office spaces in West Los Angeles. The company has also ventured into the culinary sector, launching the Toscanova Restaurant Group and The Juicy Bird in partnership with chef Agostino Sciandri. Previously, HQ Development pioneered the transition from paper gift certificates to plastic debit cards, creating the first nationwide mall gift card program, later acquired by Comdata Services. The firm also operated over 1,000 kiddie rides and 1,500 payphones across North America. Led by founder Robert Herscu, an Australian-born entrepreneur with a background in economics and finance, HQ Development continues to expand its diverse portfolio across real estate, hospitality, and other industries.

Global Commercial Real Estate was founded by our President and CEO, Frank Lahijani in 2003. We are a privately held full service Industrial and Commercial Real Estate firm operating in the Southern California area.

Mid-America Apartment Communities is a publicly traded multifamily real estate investment trust founded in 1977 by George E. Cates as The Cates Company. The company was organized as a REIT in 1993 and completed its initial public offering in February 1994. 

MAA's investment strategy centers on acquiring, developing, and managing Class A apartment communities primarily in high-growth Sunbelt markets. The portfolio is concentrated in dynamic economic regions including Texas, Florida, Georgia, and North Carolina, with operations extending across the Southeast, Southwest, and Mid-Atlantic regions. MAA completed two transformative mergers that expanded its footprint: the $8.3 billion acquisition of Colonial Properties Trust in October 2013 and the acquisition of Post Properties in December 2016.

The company maintains a vertically integrated operating platform that handles property management, leasing, acquisitions, development, and redevelopment activities.

Costco Wholesale Corporation operates an international chain of membership warehouses, mainly under the "Costco Wholesale" name, that carry quality, brand-name merchandise at substantially lower prices than are typically found at conventional wholesale or retail sources. The warehouses are designed to help small- to medium-sized businesses reduce costs in purchasing for resale and for everyday business use. Individuals also may purchase for their personal needs. 

Costco warehouses present one of the largest and most exclusive product category selections to be found under a single roof. Categories include groceries, candy, appliances, television and media, automotive supplies, tires, toys, hardware, sporting goods, jewelry, watches, cameras, books, housewares, apparel, health and beauty aids, furniture, office supplies and office equipment. Costco is known for carrying top-quality national and regional brands, with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

Warner Bros. Discovery was formed in 2022 from the combination of WarnerMedia and Discovery, creating a media and entertainment company built around branded content. The business spans television, film, streaming and gaming, with portfolio brands that include HBO, CNN, Warner Bros. Pictures and Discovery Channel. Its operations are organised around two broad areas, global linear networks and streaming & studios, reflecting a mix of traditional distribution and direct-to-consumer services. The company's roots reach back to Discovery's 1982 founding, giving the business a history that combines factual entertainment, cable networks and studio-led storytelling.

Southeast Texas Housing Finance Corporation (SETH) promotes affordable housing opportunities for low to moderate-income eligible Texans. For more than 40 years, SETH has met their community’s housing needs with a variety of programs that include assistance with home purchases and rental housing for residents and seniors. They have helped over 30,000 Texas homebuyers with their home purchase by providing $160 million in down payment and closing costs assistance. These programs also provide financing with fixed-rate FHA, VA, USDA, or conventional mortgage products.

Venterra Realty Management is a privately held multifamily real estate investment and property management firm that develops, owns, and operates apartment communities across the United States. The company was founded in 2001 by John Foresi and Andrew Stewart, who combined the words "venture" and "terra" to create the Venterra name, reflecting their venture into new territory in U.S. multifamily real estate. From initial operations managing four communities totaling approximately 800 apartment homes in Austin and Houston with 35 employees, the firm has expanded to manage approximately 70 communities comprising over 20,000 apartment units across 24 major U.S. cities. Venterra maintains a culture-focused operating model centered on core values that guide decision-making and business conduct. The company operates with a vertically integrated platform encompassing property development, acquisition, management, and asset optimization.

Occupier offerings include tenant representation, workplace and occupancy strategy, corporate consulting, project management, lease administration, facilities management, and flexible workspace solutions. Newmark maintains an international footprint and an integrated platform built around talent, data, and analytics, while the company has continued expanding into software and data subscription services.

Perkins&Will began in Chicago in 1935, founded by Lawrence B. Perkins and Philip Will, Jr., and the firm has grown into a global design practice. The company works across architecture, interior design, branded environments, urban design, and landscape architecture, with project work spanning health, higher education, workplace, science and technology, corporate and commercial, and urban design. Sustainability is built into the practice, and the firm prioritizes living design, health, well-being, and environmental performance as core parts of its work.

TD Bank U.S. is the U.S. banking business of The Toronto-Dominion Bank and serves retail, small business, and commercial customers through a network across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Carolinas, and Florida. The company offers personal online banking, checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, credit cards, personal loans, and home lending, along with small business banking services. TD traces its roots to 1855, and the U.S. business has grown into a broad banking platform that supports everyday banking and credit needs for consumers and businesses.

Koss Corporation.  Hearing is Believing. HJK International, Inc.is a total real estate service company, providing brokerage, management, appraisal, and remodel/renovation coordination services in the Greater Los Angeles area.

AIR Communities, formerly Apartment Income REIT Corp., is a multifamily real estate company that owns and operates rental housing communities across the United States. The company was formed in 2020 and operated as a publicly traded REIT (NYSE: AIRC) until June 2024, when Blackstone Real Estate Partners X completed its privatization of the company in an all-cash transaction valued at $10 billion, including debt. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, AIR Communities focuses on coastal markets apartment homes located in 10 states and the District of Columbia. Primary markets include Miami, Los Angeles, Boston, and Washington D.C. The company operates under a business model centered on resident selection, satisfaction, and retention, coupled with property management practices designed to drive organic growth. Following the Blackstone acquisition, the private equity firm committed to investing more than $400 million to maintain and improve the existing portfolio. AIR Communities is now owned by Blackstone and operates as a private entity with a focus on multifamily rental housing in markets where apartment demand generates continued growth.

Titan Hospitality specializes in brokerage and consulting assignments involving hotel assets located throughout California. Founded in 1999, they have completed over $1 billion in California hotel sale transactions. These assets have been located in most of the major markets in California.
Representing both buyers and sellers, they strive to complete hotel transactions in a quiet and confidential manner.

The mission of Centre Realty is to be the most successful real estate firm in all of Rhode Island. Centre Realty incorporates proven professional state of-the-art techniques specializing in the marketing, listing and selling of new and resale luxury homes, residential communities, condominiums, home sites, undeveloped land, commercial and investment opportunities. Centre Realty maintains a full-time staff of well-trained real estate professionals who continually strive to provide top quality service for their individual clients and customers. Centre Realty is a creative, innovative and people-oriented organization providing individual opportunity, personal satisfaction and rewarding challenges to all members of the firm.

Parkway Corporation started in 1930 as a family-owned real estate business focusing on parking facilities. The company expanded into mixed-use property development across the United States and Canada. Parkway provides parking management, real estate investment, and development services. The company has maintained multi-generational family leadership while growing its urban development portfolio. Parkway serves numerous markets with commercial properties and parking facilities.
Offices of real estate agents and brokers located in Los Angeles, California since 1990.

KB Home began in 1957 as Kaufman and Broad, founded by Eli Broad and Donald Kaufman, with a focus on making homeownership more affordable for first-time buyers. Today, the company builds personalized new homes and communities, with floor plans, design choices, energy- and water-efficient features, and smart-home options. KB Home also provides financing support through KBHS Home Loans and offers warranty coverage and customer care after move-in. The company remains one of the larger U.S. homebuilders and serves buyers across multiple markets in several states.

Real Estate Exchange group has been in business in Southern California since 2004. Throughout the years, they have helped thousands of investors & home buyers find their dream & ideal property. Coats Group, Inc. is a Commercial Relocation Consulting, Coordination and Management Firm which focuses on one core competency – Your Business Relocation!!! The Coats Group, Inc. team consists of seasoned professionals which are absolutely driven by the success of your commercial relocation project. Our team brings well over 170 years of experience to meet the needs of the commercial relocating client on a nationwide basis. We are fluent in the needs and requirements for corporate (office), industrial (heavy manufacturing, light manufacturing & distribution) and research and technology (lab) relocations. The deliverables in all sectors are the same, a seamless/transparent relocation that is managed by employing creativeness and best practice methods during which risks are mitigated and project costs are contained.

Based in Houston and Dallas, Coats Group serves clients on a nationwide basis.

Founded in 1994, The Information Store (iStore) provides integrated products and services for the oil and gas industry focused on maximizing the value of data. Our solutions help our clients discover and maximize reserves and improve production by providing easy access to organized, high-quality data.

iStore was born out of an industry-wide effort to improve the way E&P data was managed and utilized. In 1994, a group of former participants from POSC (a not for profit organization with a mission to standardize the data model for the upstream sector) formed iStore. They shared not only a common background rich in petroleum industry experiences, but had the technical know-how to implement practical and realistic solutions.

Headquartered in Houston, Texas, iStore is a privately held company with worldwide operations, servicing clients in North America, Latin America, Australia, Africa, and the Middle East. iStore is under the direction and leadership of President and CEO Barry Irani.

Bearden Development, Inc. (BDI) is an award-winning organization that builds and manages office, showroom and warehouse properties in central and east Texas. Our current focus is on Harris, Fort Bend, and Montgomery Counties. Founded in 1998, BDI's mission is to offer personal service and solutions to the Greater Houston area's unique and growing base of entrepreneurial and small businesses. A tour of the properties on this web site will show how our newest products were designed specifically with these clients in mind. Recent accomplishments are the 2005 Trees for Houston Award, and the 2004 Houston Business Journal Landmark Award for Best Industrial Development, Century Oaks Business Park.

LA Realty Partners is a commercial real estate firm that serves landlords, tenants, and investors through transaction-focused teams. The company's work centers on agency leasing, tenant representation, capital markets, investment sales, and project consulting, with a practice built around coordinating deal execution and property strategy across commercial assets. LA Realty Partners developed within Los Angeles real estate and focuses on brokerage services that support leasing, repositioning, and investment activity in the broader market.

Hines is a privately held real assets platform focused on investing in, developing, and managing real estate across global markets. The company was founded in 1957 by Gerald D. Hines and has built its business around investment judgment, development capability, and property management expertise. Hines provides real estate services that include development, redevelopment, asset management, engineering, and stewardship for investment portfolios and occupier needs. The firm also supports institutional and private wealth investors through multiple real asset investment strategies spanning different property types and risk profiles.

CAS is not a firm for the mass market; rather, we work with accredited investors, institutional and high net worth individuals. Bringing a global perspective and expertise to each of our engagements, we have earned a reputation for thinking outside the box to identify hidden opportunities.

Nelson Duffie Interests has a proven track record in the acquisition of existing "value add" improved properties and the turnkey development of multi-tenant and freestanding industrial facilities. Their collective experience allows them to offer a full range of services, including site selection, land acquisition, project design, project financing, construction, utility coordination, marketing, management and much more. They have strong ties and strategic relationships with the brokerage community, lenders, contractors, engineers and architects as well, as key corporations and individuals in the community.
What does all this add up to? Intellectual Capital. It’s hard to put in words all that they have gained in their collective 60 years working in the Houston real estate market, but each day, all that knowledge, experience, insight and creativity is put into practice on behalf of their projects and clients.

Barings is an alternative asset manager based in Charlotte, North Carolina. It traces its roots to Barings, a merchant bank founded in London in 1762. MassMutual bought Baring Asset Management's investment management business in 2005. In 2016 it merged that business with Babson Capital Management, Cornerstone Real Estate Advisers and Wood Creek Capital Management to form the current firm. MassMutual owns 82% of Barings. MS&AD Insurance Group, through Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance, bought the other 18% for about $1.44 billion; the deal closed in May 2026. Barings is privately held, but it manages listed vehicles such as Barings BDC (NYSE: BBDC). As of September 30, 2026, the firm managed about $500 billion across credit, real assets, capital solutions and emerging markets. It has more than 2,000 professionals in 35 office locations.
Real estate is one of the firm's real assets businesses and covers both equity and debt. It invests in office, multifamily, industrial and logistics, retail, hotel, student housing, self-storage, seniors housing and industrial outdoor storage, across core, core-plus, value-add and opportunistic strategies. Its debt group makes first mortgage, bridge, structured and construction loans of $15 million to $750 million. The firm built its real estate platform partly through acquisitions. As of June 30, 2026, real estate equity assets under management totaled about $39.3 billion. North America accounted for $25.48 billion (64.8%), Europe $6.98 billion (17.8%) and Asia Pacific $6.86 billion (17.4%). Real estate debt is more concentrated: North America held $21.82 billion of about $25.5 billion. Barings does not publish property counts, market-level allocations or tenant rent contributions for the platform.

Sanli Pastore & Hill began in 1992 as a financial advisory firm focused on business valuation and expert financial opinions. The company provides business, brand, and IP valuations, fairness and solvency opinions, forensic accounting, transaction advisory services, and expert testimony and litigation opinions for complex business situations. Sanli Pastore & Hill maintains an international presence alongside its U.S. operations, supporting clients across transaction and dispute-related assignments in multiple markets.

Qval Property Advisors was founded in 2004 after Jerry W. Witte Jr. bought out his practice from Hein & Associates LLP and formed a new entity centered on specialized consulting and valuation work. The company provides real estate and business valuation, acquisition and disposition support, due diligence, real estate capital markets work, IT consulting, and investment sales and leasing brokerage. Qval Property Advisors also handles loan valuation, debt restructuring, portfolio diagnostics, underwriting due diligence, and related analysis for institutional advisory assignments. The firm works across a broad range of property types and has experience in markets across the United States, Canada, Australia, Mexico, and Brazil.

D.R. Horton began in 1978 as a homebuilding business in Texas and has grown into a national builder serving buyers across the United States. The company builds homes for first-time buyers, move-up buyers, active-adult buyers, and luxury buyers, with offerings that span both home construction and related purchase support. D.R. Horton also provides mortgage financing, title services, and insurance agency services, and it operates rental housing businesses alongside its homebuilding operations. The business further holds a majority stake in Forestar Group Inc., extending its involvement in residential lot development.

Founded in 1991, JRK Property Holdings is a privately owned real estate investment and property management company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The company was created with the purchase of five multifamily properties from an RTC pool of Executive Life assets that co-founder Jim Lippman had been managing via receivership. Jim Lippman currently serves as non-executive chairman, with the firm co-founded alongside Robert Rooney and Keith Holmes. As a privately held company, JRK has no ticker symbol.

JRK's core business focus is the acquisition, ownership, and operation of multifamily apartment communities, supplemented by a hotel division and a smaller commercial holdings segment. The firm pursues value-add and core-plus investment strategies. It operates two primary vehicles: its $1 billion Platform 5 Fund, which targets apartment assets built after 1990, and its MF Opportunities III fund, which targets vintage properties built in or before 1989. The company's asset classes of interest span multifamily (its primary focus), hospitality/hotels, and commercial properties including office complexes, storage facilities, and industrial parks.

In 2025, JRK ranked as the 50th largest apartment owner in the United States per the National Multi Housing Council, with 26,938 units. The company's residential portfolio spans 28 states, giving it a nationally diversified footprint that reduces exposure to any single market. Its 2025 acquisitions concentrated in gateway metros including Los Angeles, Seattle, Washington D.C., and Hoboken. Top markets by recent deployment include Southern California (Los Angeles), the Pacific Northwest (Seattle), and Washington D.C. Because its multifamily cash flows are distributed across tens of thousands of individual residential leases, the company carries limited single-tenant concentration exposure.

ExxonMobil traces its roots to Standard Oil in the late nineteenth century and later emerged through the combination of Exxon and Mobil into the modern company. The business operates across fuels, lubricants, chemicals, and low-carbon solutions, with products and services sold under Exxon, Esso, and Mobil brands. ExxonMobil serves retail and commercial customers through gasoline, diesel, motor oil, fleet offerings, wholesale fuels, and rewards programs. The company maintains a broad global market presence and stands as one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants, and chemical companies in the world.

Gantry was established in 1991 as Newmark Realty Capital and now operates under the Gantry name in commercial real estate finance. The company arranges debt and equity financing for commercial properties and portfolios, covering property types such as multifamily, office, industrial, retail, self-storage, and mixed-use assets. The company maintains a broad U.S. market presence and integrates analysis, placement, closing, and servicing across its platform.

They focus on value-oriented real estate, finding opportunities for investors, and are led by Joseph Daneshgar, with a history of major developments and purchases, including significant Las Vegas properties.

Specializing in direct equity investments on behalf of high-net-worth individuals and family offices in the U.S. and abroad, CNA's investment activity encompasses the acquisition, capital structuring, asset management, and disposition of commercial properties across the United States.

The company operates nearly 6,000,000 square feet of commercial real estate throughout the United States. CNA specializes in grocery-anchored shopping centers and lifestyle centers, and also has investment experience with office, industrial, and mixed-use properties.

Throughout its thirty years of operating history, CNA has achieved its leadership position in the commercial real estate industry through strategic acquisitions and dispositions, favorable financing, and proactive management.

The company provides personal banking, small business banking, commercial banking, treasury and cash management, lending, and wealth management services across a broad U.S. banking network. KeyBank also serves institutional clients through capital markets, investment banking, and advisory capabilities, while Key Private Bank supports affluent and nonprofit clients with trust, portfolio management, and charitable giving services. The business remains part of a large financial services organization with long historical roots and a diversified mix of consumer, commercial, and institutional offerings.

Tri Pointe Homes began in 2009 and grew from a set of regional builders into a single homebuilding brand in 2021. Since 1969, Carl Terzian Associates has believed that superior public relations is only as effective as the people who develop, implement and analyze specific programs to impact sales, market share and image with highly defined publics. As a full-service firm, CTA is currently among the top five independent public relations firms based in Los Angeles and among the top 50 in the nation. Public Storage owns 3,171 self-storage facilities across 40 states with 229.4 million net rentable square feet. The company also holds a 35% equity interest in Shurgard Self Storage Limited, which operates 318 facilities with 17.5 million net rentable square feet across seven Western European countries. Public Storage operates the largest self-storage brand in the United States, controlling approximately 9% of the total U.S. self-storage square footage. The company's investment strategy centers on acquisitions, development projects, and third-party management expansion in high-density metropolitan markets. In February 2026, Public Storage announced its headquarters relocation from Glendale, California to Frisco, Texas. In March 2026, the company announced a pending $10.5 billion all-stock acquisition of National Storage Affiliates Trust, which would add over 1,000 properties and 69 million rentable square feet across 37 states and Puerto Rico. Public Storage generates revenue primarily from rental of self-storage space, supplemented by ancillary businesses including tenant insurance through its Orange Door Storage Insurance Program. Top geographic exposures include Texas with 477 facilities (40.5 million square feet), California with 450 facilities (32.8 million square feet), and Florida with 392 facilities (27.5 million square feet). The company focuses on urban and suburban markets with strong population density and growth characteristics, maintaining scale advantages through clustered facility locations in major metropolitan areas.

In 1954 when he was 24 and recently married, his father-in-law offered him a job at Randalls Super Valu Store in Pasadena. 12 years later, Onstead joined two other men, Norman Frewin and R.C. Barclay, whose experience in the grocery business went back two generations and who were both instinctive entrepreneurs. Together, the three men developed the concept of a discount supermarket. By 1990, the chain had expanded to 42 stores. In 1991, Randalls earned over a billion dollars in revenue, making it easily the fastest growing company in Houston. Today, Randalls operates as a banner of Albertsons Companies, one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. With both a strong local presence and national scale, the company operates stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia under 20 well-known banners.

GNC began in 1935, when David Shakarian opened a small store that grew into a company focused on nutrition and wellness. Today, GNC sells a broad assortment of vitamins, supplements, protein, creatine, weight management, and other health products through stores and online. The company emphasizes science-based products, quality standards, and customer support for people pursuing fitness and everyday wellness.

Space City Liquor is a Houston-area liquor retailer that has operated for many years and is now under new management. The business carries spirits, wine, beer, premium cigars, and cigarettes, and its online ordering listings show pickup and delivery options for customers. Space City Liquor serves shoppers through a neighborhood storefront and keeps a focus on everyday beverage and tobacco retail rather than broader chain operations. Recent directory and ordering sources place the business in the Clear Lake City area of Houston and describe regular store hours, reflecting an ongoing presence in the local retail market.

Uniglobe Travel International is a Canadian company defined by a passion for travel. Uniglobe Travel was founded by award-winning franchise entrepreneur U. Gary Charlwood. Fluent in multiple languages, Charlwood attended Southampton University on a scholarship before parlaying his part-time summer tour guide job into a full-fledged travel industry career.

Charlwood opened the first Uniglobe travel agency in British Columbia in 1981. Today, Uniglobe has offices in 60 countries on six continents. Rooted in local dependability and unrivalled entrepreneurial spirit, Uniglobe agencies and partners serve the unique needs of small and mid-sized enterprises (SME) by providing corporate and leisure travel services, meeting and incentive support – and much more!

The company began in 1963 when Budd Friedman opened The Improvisation in Hell's Kitchen, and the venue helped establish stand-up comedy as a live entertainment format in the United States. The company now operates as a network of comedy clubs that present ticketed performances across a wide lineup of venues and artists. Alongside live comedy, the business offers food and beverage service, including cocktails and menu items served during shows.

Keller Williams began in 1983 and grew from a single office into a real estate franchise built around agents, training, and education. The company provides residential brokerage services and supports affiliated agents with tools, technology, and a culture guided by the WI4C2TES belief system. Keller Williams operates a broad network of market centers and affiliated agents across the United States and other regions. The business publishes real estate news and company updates through KWRI as part of a wider brand platform.

Targa is a leading provider of midstream services and is one of the largest independent infrastructure companies in North America. They own, operate, acquire, and develop a diversified portfolio of complementary domestic infrastructure assets, allowing them to endeavor to supply natural gas and natural gas liquids (NGLs) efficiently and safely to meet the increasing domestic and global demand for cleaner, affordable fuel and feedstocks.

NRG Energy began in 1989 as a subsidiary of Northern States Power Company. The company became independent in 2000 and expanded through acquisitions of various energy firms. NRG Energy operates in both energy generation and retail electricity markets. The company's service portfolio includes natural gas, coal, nuclear, solar, and wind energy. NRG Energy maintains a significant presence in deregulated energy markets across multiple US states and Canada.

Paramount, a Skydance Corporation, was formed in 2025 through the merger of Skydance Media and Paramount Global, bringing together a long-running media legacy and a newer film and television business. The company operates across studios, direct-to-consumer streaming, and TV media, with brands and services spanning feature films, scripted and unscripted television, broadcast networks, sports, news, and consumer products. Paramount's portfolio includes Paramount Pictures, CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, BET, and Paramount+, and the business distributes premium entertainment content through a broad mix of platforms and international markets.

City Nails Two is a Houston nail salon serving clients in the Clear Lake area with a focus on manicure, pedicure, and nail enhancement services. Business listings describe a broad menu that includes classic and deluxe manicures, multiple pedicure options, gel services, liquid gel builder gel, powder sets, waxing, and add-on treatments such as paraffin and massage. Public directory profiles and customer review pages present City Nails Two as an active beauty-shop business with basic contact details and an established local presence in personal care and nail care services.

Quiznos began in 1981 in Denver as a small sandwich shop built around toasted submarine sandwiches and made-to-order ingredients. The company now operates as a franchised fast-food brand focused on toasted sandwiches, salads, soups, desserts, and other menu items, with a presence beyond the United States. Quiznos' official materials emphasize inventive food, high-quality ingredients, and a menu built around signature toasted sandwiches. Over time, the business has shifted into a franchise-driven model while keeping the toasted sandwich concept at the center of the brand.

Rosetta Resources is an independent oil and gas company based in Houston, Texas engaged in the exploration, development and exploitation of onshore energy resources in the United States of America. We are a leading producer in the Eagle Ford Shale in South Texas, one of the nation's largest unconventional resource plays, and hold a large oil-weighted position in the Permian Basin in West Texas.

Avantax began in 1983 as a tax-focused effort built around advice aligned with client tax situations, and the firm later unified HD Vest and 1st Global in 2019 before adding HK Financial Services in 2020. Avantax supports independent tax and financial professionals with comprehensive financial services that include securities, insurance, money management, banking solutions, and tax-intelligent planning. In 2023, Avantax joined Cetera, and the Avantax community continues to serve financial professionals, families, individuals, and small businesses through an independent-affiliate model within Cetera. Avantax operates as a tax-focused community within Cetera with a continuing emphasis on wealth management and tax-aware advice.
Law Firm.

Joe's Crab Shack offers a variety of favorites from all parts of the sea and shore. From its extensive menu, guests can choose from buckets of seasonal seafood, fried shrimp platters, and fish dishes, as well as options from the "mainland" that include steak, sandwiches, and chicken. Guests can indulge in over-sized and creative cocktails, such as the Shark Bite which is playfully garnished with a shark toy. Since its inception, Joe's popularity has stemmed not only from its menu but also from its retail store. With various pieces of merchandise for purchase, including the ever-popular tie-dye T-shirt with the phrase "Peace, Love and Crabs," Joe's has become synonymous with the word "fun."

At Rainforest Cafe, they cater to kids. Their loveable Cha! Cha! and the Wild Bunch are here to make sure children of all ages have a great time while exploring the rainforest. So take a look around and find out a little more about their jungle friends. They think you'll agree that the rainforest is the place to be!

The Chart House concept was born on Independence Day in 1961, the brainchild of famed Hawaiian surfer Joey Cabell and U.S. Navy man Buzzy Bent. The first location was modest, with just a few tables in a converted diner. However, two principles present in 1961 remain staples of every Chart House location – great food and equally impressive views. Today, Chart House restaurants overlook the coasts of both the Atlantic and the Pacific, and other scenic locations in between. And while they stretch from sea to shining sea, every location remains committed and specialized to its local community.

Whether you choose to dine at our location 750 feet above San Antonio in the Tower of the Americas, at their Cardiff by the Sea restaurant with the surf breaking right at your table or at their Weehawken location with breathtaking views of the Manhattan skyline, you can't go wrong with one of their signature fish specialties, slow-roasted prime rib and delicious salads.

The Aquarium is a spectacular underwater dining adventure where you are seated around an elaborate aquarium with floor to ceiling viewing of more than 100 species of colorful tropical fish. The Aquarium restaurants are located in both the Downtown Aquariums in Houston and Denver, Opry Mills in Nashville, and on the Kemah Boardwalk in Kemah, Texas.
While the Aquarium is a feast for the eyes, the menu is just as much a feast for the palate. The unparalleled offerings at Aquarium feature only the freshest fish, seafood, steaks and more. No detail has been overlooked at Aquarium.

Babin's offers the largest and most unique variety of fresh Gulf Coast Fish. If you want it any fresher, you are going to have to catch it yourself! Babin's Seafood House offers you the finest taste of New Orleans, where a unique brand of hospitality, culture and cooking are delivered. South Louisiana customs come alive with authentic recipes, generous helpings and Bon Temps hospitality. There is nothing like soul-satisfying New Orleans style seafood. Sample their world-famous gumbo, made with dark brown roux and the Cajun trinity (bell peppers, onions and celery). Blue crabs from the Gulf of Mexico, catfish from the Atchafalaya swamps, oysters shucked to order and a whole fish filleted in-house bring New Orleans right to your table.

A Houston legend for more than seven decades, Brenner's Steakhouse on Katy Freeway features outside dining in an exquisite garden area, surrounded by waterfalls and a gazebo. From prime steaks, fresh seafood and desserts to an extensive wine list, Brenner's continues its tradition of generous hospitality to guests.

In a world of trendy restaurants, Cadillac Bar has not only survived but continues to be a local legend. A lively mixture of tradition and Mexican flair, Cadillac is where you want to be for an unbeatable meal or an unforgettable party. Over the years, Cadillac Bar has delighted such famous faces as George Bush, ZZ Top, Dan Akroyd, Shirley Maclaine, Billy Joel, Elton John and countless others!

Roseman & Antoni, LLP prides itself on providing quality legal representation in the areas of real estate, construction, homeowners association, business and employment law, in both a timely and cost-effective manner. We maintain offices in Los Angeles, California and Las Vegas, Nevada. 
We recognize our clients concerns regarding rising legal expenses and actively seek to control these costs through blended billing rates, fixed fees and, in appropriate situations, fees contingent or partially contingent on the outcome of the case or transaction.

Since 1940, Fisherman’s Wharf® has been a legacy of great seafood with great views. As one of the best seafood restaurants in Galveston, it is a great place to enjoy a leisurely meal with all dining areas, both indoor and outdoor on the patio, offering a view of the bay. Fisherman’s Wharf® offers its famous bacon wrapped shrimp kisses, fresh fish, seafood combination platters, savory chicken dishes, pastas and Certified Angus Beef ® steaks along with many other favorites. With its idyllic location next to the Historic Strand District, the Tall Ship Elissa and the Galveston Cruise Terminal, this Texas-sized establishment is perfect for one or one hundred.

Enjoy waterfront seafood at its best at Fisherman’s Wharf® in Galveston, open daily for lunch and dinner with great happy hour specials including beers, cocktails and harborside bites.

The Flying Dutchman offers a variety of fresh seafood dishes from live seasonal crawfish to Louisiana Cajun gumbo and much more! Located directly on Texas’ Gulf coast, the waterfront views are enough to bring you in. So come on in and enjoy their Texas-hospitality and fresh seafood. You'll be telling your friends for weeks – and the legend will continue.

Saltgrass Steak House's authentic steak house captures the essence and the tantalizing flavors of the great American West. Now, their award-winning flavor can be enjoyed across Texas, Alabama, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Nevada, Mississippi, Tennessee, Missouri, Omaha, and Oklahoma, boasting more than 96 locations and counting!  

All of their Certified Angus Beef® steaks, chicken and seafood are consistently chargrilled to perfection. Don't forget to complement your meal with their freshly made breads, soups, and desserts, made from scratch daily. Come see them soon!

You can experience their legendary hospitality at one of their locations found throughout Texas, in addition to restaurants in Alabama, Arkansas, Louisiana, Colorado, Mississippi, Missouri, Nevada, Oklahoma, Florida, Omaha, and Tennessee.

National restaurateur, chairman, president and CEO of Landry’s, Inc., Tilman Fertitta, along with his father Vic, traveled across the country, experiencing the best steakhouses throughout North America. During their travels, they carefully researched and developed a list of attributes that make steakhouses truly great - a carefully crafted menu, an extensive wine selection, impeccable service and an elegant, yet cozy atmosphere. Those who know them will know that they had an awful lot of fun along the way. With incredible vision and an undeniable eye for detail, they have created the most spectacular dining environment you'll find anywhere - a world-class steakhouse. 

The only Landry’s entity built from the ground up, dining at Vic & Anthony’s Steakhouse is an exquisite culinary experience known for its award-winning menu with the finest prime beef & fresh seafood.

Inspired by an Old Country trattoria ambiance & classic Italian cooking, Grotto delivers a savory menu brimming with timeless recipes made on premises. Creations include many “Old World” signature dishes such as Neapolitan thin crust pizzas, Veal Kickerillo, Pollo Francese, Pasta Verdura and Snapper Siciliano. Enjoy Grotto’s famous Peach Bellini or extensive collection of Italian and domestic wines inside or on the patio.

The true flavor of Gulf Coast tradition is all about family, warmth and exceptional seafood. Landry's Seafood House strives to bring all of those things together in each and every location, providing a fun-filled dining experience that will make you want to drop your anchor and never leave. So sit back, relax, and take part in their experience. You'll do enough tasting, laughing and living for an entire lifetime.

A Houston favorite for over 25 years, La Griglia offers guests authentic Italian dining in the River Oaks neighborhood. The upscale casual environment, impeccable service, and authentic Italian cuisine combine to create a distinct recipe for an afternoon or evening to be enjoyed by all at your favorite Italian hotspot.

With offices in Los Angeles County, the firm provides the utmost professional and respectable services to its clients in the fields of Business, Real Estate, and Intellectual Property as well as other areas of law. The firm's dedicated attorneys and talented staff, having a broad range of technical background and legal experience, provide a full range of services to its most renowned clients throughout the firm's history of practice.

profile.locationBio: The Resmark Companies began in 1995 and focuses on residential real estate investment and capital deployment. The company provides capital to homebuilders, land developers, and multifamily developers, with strategies that include land and housing, multifamily, land and entitlement opportunities, land banking, model home sale-leaseback, and single-family build-to-rent. The Resmark Companies invests on behalf of institutional and private investors and maintains a market presence across California, the Western United States, Texas, the Southeastern region, the D.C./Mid-Atlantic region, and select major metropolitan markets. The firm employs a long-running residential investment approach built around disciplined underwriting, research-driven market selection, and repeat partnerships with experienced developers.

Devon Seafood + Steak features exceptional fare, serving the best seafood and top rated steak all cooked over an open wood fire for superior and unique flavor. They're known for their meticulously-prepared and sourced seafood – procuring the freshest seafood available direct from the most reputable sources based on the day’s catch. They're also renowned for featuring the finest cuts of USDA Prime Black Angus Beef only served in the city’s best steakhouses.

Claim Jumper Steakhouse & Bar is a premier dining destination where indulgence meets comfort. They are dedicated to providing their guests with a memorable and satisfying experience through exceptional food, warm hospitality, and a welcoming ambiance. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, enjoying a night out with friends, or simply craving a delicious Prime Steak, Claim Jumper is the perfect choice.

Their spacious dining area is adorned with rustic yet elegant decor, creating a cozy ambience that invites you to relax and savor every moment. Whether you're enjoying a romantic dinner for two or gathering with a larger group, their attentive staff is dedicated to ensuring your comfort and satisfaction.

Hines is a privately held real assets platform focused on investing in, developing, and managing real estate across global markets. The company was founded in 1957 by Gerald D. Hines and has built its business around investment judgment, development capability, and property management expertise. Hines provides real estate services that include development, redevelopment, asset management, engineering, and stewardship for investment portfolios and occupier needs. The firm also supports institutional and private wealth investors through multiple real asset investment strategies spanning different property types and risk profiles.

Black & Veatch began in 1915 when E.B. Black and N.T. Veatch formed a partnership after graduating from the University of Kansas. Black & Veatch is an employee-owned engineering, procurement, consulting and construction company focused on sustainable infrastructure and critical human infrastructure. The company works across energy, water, telecommunications, and related infrastructure services, including engineering, construction, operations, modernization, and advisory work. Black & Veatch serves clients in global markets and has a history of infrastructure work spanning more than a century.

Roberts Markel Weinberg Butler Hailey PC is a full service Texas law firm providing the experience and service their clients require for their transactional and litigation needs for 40 years.

Roberts Markel Weinberg Butler Hailey PC was formed by the merger of two well-established Texas law practices. Butler | Hailey was founded in 1980 and focused its practice on representing community associations, condominium associations, developers and builders. Roberts Markel Weinberg PC was founded in 1981 as a full-service civil law firm handling transactional and litigation matters throughout the state of Texas.

Since their inception, they have provided their clients with practical and efficient solutions to help them grow along with them

Capcom began in Japan in 1979 as a manufacturer and distributor of electronic game machines. In 1983 Capcom Co., LTD was founded and soon built a reputation for introducing cutting-edge technology and software to the video game market. Now an industry leader in the video game industry for 25 years, Capcom's legacy of historic franchises in home and arcade gaming are testaments to an unparalleled commitment to excellence.

Building on its origins as a game machine manufacturer, Capcom is now involved in all areas of the video game industry and has offices in Tokyo, Osaka, California, England, Germany and Hong Kong.

HealthRenu Medical, a biotech company founded in 1996, has emerged from the research & development stages and has begun to solidify relationships with distributors all over the world, signing an agreement with one of the largest distributors in the United States. HealthRenu Medical specializes in all-natural, over the counter, bioactive transdermal lipid technology products. The success of these products has been demonstrated in surgical procedures, nursing homes, hospitals, and hospice care. Use of these products has led to fibromyalgia patients finding relief from their symptoms, arthritis sufferers temporarily regaining pain-free flexibility in their joints, surgery patients having 66% less chance of infection, 75% less scarring, and recovery times cut in half.

Alamo Title is a U.S.-based title insurance and settlement services company focused on supporting commercial and residential real estate transactions. The company traces its origins to 1922, when its predecessor, Alamo Abstract and Title Company, was formed in San Antonio, Texas. Over time, Alamo Title expanded beyond its original market to serve a broader geographic footprint within Texas and neighboring states.
The company provides title insurance, escrow, and closing coordination services for property buyers, sellers, lenders, builders, and real estate professionals. Its operations include underwriting support and transaction management for both residential and commercial properties. Alamo Title is privately held and operates as part of a larger national title insurance framework through its underwriter relationships.
Notable milestones include its long operating history within the title insurance industry and its evolution from a regional abstract company into a multi-market title services provider. Alamo Title continues to operate under its established brand, with localized offices supporting real estate transactions in major Texas markets.

At HRSS, we steer our firm by the guiding principles of one clear mission: to deliver high-value accounting, tax, and advisory services while keeping the client at the center of all our efforts. With Big 4 backgrounds and decades of hands-on industry experience, we deliver world-class expertise with a personal approach and small-firm pricing.

At our full-service accounting firm, each client engagement calls up a deep commitment to open communication and an adherence to the very pinnacle of professional standards.

Our firm philosophy is thoroughly client-centered, and we work diligently to become each client’s trusted tax and accounting advisor. Because our senior leadership is composed of Big 4 and industry professionals, we are able to offer world-class expertise to our clients. And with our client- focused approach and mid-level size, we boast the reasonable fees and close attention typically found only in smaller firms.

In 2004, four energy professionals, who had been working together for several years for a competing brokerage firm in Houston, TX, decided to create a company that could provide superior customer service and more targeted market coverage than other existing energy brokerage companies. As a result of its four founding partners’ vision, IVG Energy (“IVG”) was created. IVG presently employs approximately 40 energy professionals, all of whom possess an average of over 10 years of energy industry experience.
As an independently-owned company, IVG fully realizes that customer satisfaction is the only way to assure IVG’s continuing success. IVG’s strict commitment to maintaining its customers’ confidentiality and privacy is what sets IVG above its competitors in the energy brokerage services industry.

Houston ENT & Allergy, founded in 1907 as Houston's first ENT clinic, has grown into one of the nation's largest ENT clinics. They offer cutting-edge care at multiple locations with skilled staff, prioritizing personalized and innovative solutions.
Houston ENT & Allergy believes everyone deserves to live comfortably and confidently, free from the discomforts associated with ENT, allergy, and hearing challenges. By providing personalized, compassionate, and cutting-edge care, they aim to alleviate the symptoms and address the root causes of one's problems.
