Established in 1980, Winther excels at identifying the ideal urban setting, and then carefully integrates neo-traditional architecture, resort-style site design and lush terraced landscaping themes to create a warm and inviting community to live, work and play.

Banyan Equity is a full-service multifamily management firm that represents more than 200 years of industry expertise from a dedicated team committed to making their clients and their properties shine with success. The cornerstone of their hands-on approach to third-party management provides a boutique experience with customized attention — a personalized client relationship style that truly sets them apart. As a company anchored in Houston, Texas and the surrounding markets, their communities are where the locals live.

WNS is a global business process management company delivering outsourcing and technology-enabled services across industries such as banking, insurance, healthcare, travel, and utilities. Founded in 1996, the company offers solutions in finance and accounting, customer interaction services, analytics, and digital transformation. WNS operates delivery centers worldwide and serves clients through a combination of domain expertise and technology platforms.

Cathexis is a private investment holding company that uses a permanent capital base to back businesses across several verticals, including engineering contracting, data centers, minerals, clean energy, real estate development, and early-stage venture capital. The company maintains portfolio activity in hyperscale infrastructure, utility-scale solar and storage, and mixed-use development, reflecting a broad investment approach across operating businesses and real assets. Cathexis functions as a long-term investor that works with management teams and uses flexible transaction structures.

U.S. Legal Support was founded in 1996 with a single goal: to be the first nationwide, all-inclusive litigation support company. As time has passed, their commitment to the legal industry has not wavered, and their mission remains the same: to build lasting relationships with their legal industry partners by delivering exceptional litigation support services.
There’s a common misconception that nationwide “big box” support means sacrificing personalized service and local expertise. At U.S. Legal Support, they debunk that myth. Having thirty years of experience gives them expertise in local market nuances but also the reach to have resources nationwide, ensuring that they deliver what’s needed when needed.

With operations in about 20 countries, Nabors has established a global network of people, technology and equipment to deploy solutions that deliver safe, efficient and responsible hydrocarbon production. By leveraging its core competencies, particularly in drilling, engineering, automation, data science and manufacturing, Nabors aims to innovate the future of energy and enable the transition to a lower carbon world. Nabors Industries owns and operates the world’s largest land-based drilling rig fleet and is a leading provider of offshore platform workover and drilling rigs in the U.S. and multiple international markets. Nabors also provides innovative drilling technology, directional drilling operations and drilling instrumentation and software. Through its various subsidiaries, Nabors manufactures and sells top drives, catwalks, wrenches, draw works and other drilling related equipment which are installed on both onshore and offshore drilling rigs.

Chase, the consumer and commercial banking brand of JPMorganChase, offers checking and savings accounts, credit cards, home loans, auto financing, and business banking services. Chase traces its roots to New York City's first water company in 1799, and the modern bank grew through the history of heritage firms including The Manhattan Company and Chase Manhattan Bank, the former name used before the merger with J.P. Morgan & Co. Chase now serves millions of people with a broad range of financial products and a significant branch and ATM network in the United States, while JPMorganChase operates across consumer, business, and institutional banking lines.

Founded in 1983, Pacific Premier Bank has grown to become one of the largest banks headquartered in the western region of the United States, with $21 billion in total assets. Pacific Premier Bank provides banking products and services, including deposit accounts, digital banking, and treasury management services, to businesses, professionals, entrepreneurs, real estate investors, and nonprofit organizations. Pacific Premier Bank also offers a wide array of loan products, such as commercial business loans, lines of credit, SBA loans, commercial real estate loans, agribusiness loans, franchise lending, home equity lines of credit, and construction loans.

Tarantino serves both institutional and private clients through customized real estate solutions.

Commerce Capital Partners, LLC is a private real estate management and investment firm focused on commercial real estate in the Sun Belt – primarily Texas. Over the last eighteen months, they’ve been active in this most recent downturn in commercial real estate and have purchased over $40,000,000 of multifamily properties in Texas.

profile.locationBio: The McGregor Company is a full-spectrum real estate development firm founded in 1987 and headquartered in California. The firm specializes in high-quality office, residential, mixed-use, and urban infill projects, taking an active, hands-on role throughout all phases of the development process. Its services include site selection and analysis, feasibility studies, design coordination, entitlements, construction oversight, budget management, marketing, leasing, and ongoing property and asset management. The McGregor Company operates both as an equity developer for its own projects and as a development manager and partner for third-party institutional and individual owners. With a long track record of complex, design-driven projects across Southern California, the firm is known for its integrated approach, attention to detail, and ability to manage projects from concept through completion.

Grayco Partners was founded in 2006 as a real estate firm focused on multifamily communities. Grayco Partners specializes in the investment, development, construction, financing, and management of well-designed apartment communities in major U.S. metropolitan markets. The company describes a long-term approach built around lasting product, premium locations, and a sound financial structure. Grayco Partners also emphasizes hands-on involvement across sourcing, acquisitions, design, construction, and delivery, while its property management arm handles the day-to-day operation of its communities.

Established in 1966, Berkshire is a registered investment advisor, headquartered in Boston and has offices in Dallas and San Francisco with over 1,000 employees.

The firm operates a vertically integrated owner-operator model across U.S. residential real estate. As a proven owner-operator with a team of industry experts, Berkshire has cultivated dedicated teams across a range of residential real estate disciplines, including acquisitions, dispositions, development, portfolio management, debt capital markets, property operations, and capital raising. The firm invests throughout the capital stack and across the risk spectrum, combining equity and debt strategies.

Its investment platform spans multiple fund types and asset classes. Across its residential platform, Berkshire currently sponsors a closed-end, value fund series with fund vintages beginning in 2005; an open-end, core fund; and two closed-end debt fund series. In addition, the Firm manages separate accounts focused on equity and debt investments in market-rate apartments and alternative sectors, including senior housing, single-family rentals, student housing, and manufactured housing.

Michael Stevens Interests, Inc. is a real estate investment company headquartered in Houston, Texas. Since 1981, the mission has been to own and manage multi-family and self-storage real estate properties that thrive throughout Texas.

Rockwell Management was founded in 1994 through the consolidation of two property management firms, Garden Property Management of Texas and Garden National Properties of New Jersey. The company focuses on full-service property management, with work centered on multifamily apartments, condominiums, single-family rental homes, and commercial office space. Rockwell Management also provides related support such as leasing, maintenance, construction management for capital improvements and tenant projects, financial reporting, and property operations oversight. Its portfolio and service lines show a business built around managing residential and commercial real estate assets for owners and residents across the Houston market.

The Principals of ARI entered North America in the early 1970s, establishing an initial office in Toronto, Canada. Later, the Group opened its first U.S. office in Houston, Texas, in 1977. By the mid-1980s, the value of North American investments had grown to over two billion dollars through real estate investments in major cities throughout the United States and Canada. At that time, the majority of the holdings were sold in one large transaction to a Canadian public company, with the Group’s remaining assets concentrated in larger office buildings in the United States.

In 1988, the Group began purchasing assets in Texas. By May of 1989, a new company was formed to manage these investments and seek additional opportunities in the state. The company quickly expanded from fifteen employees in 1989 to 150 employees just a few years later. The portfolio also grew, totaling more than five thousand apartment units and over 2.2 million square feet of office space and retail.

CMI Brokerage is a commercial real estate firm that provides brokerage, leasing, property management, development, facility management, consulting, property rehabilitation, and construction coordination services. CMI Brokerage was founded in 1978 by Houston real estate professional Vic Vacek and has built its business around commercial property owners, investors, buyers, and sellers. The company focuses on office, retail, industrial, land, and multifamily properties, with work spanning commercial sales, land disposition, tenant representation, and asset management across the Houston and Dallas markets.

Envolve is a privately held, vertically integrated multifamily real estate company engaged in property management, ownership, and investment, with a focus on affordable, workforce, and senior housing. The company traces its origins to 1979 through Memphis-based LEDIC Management Group, and the current platform was formed through a 2014 business combination involving BSR Trust. The LEDIC name was replaced by Envolve in early 2020. Shareholders have included Hunt Companies, FrontRange Capital Partners, and Legacy BSR. Chairman and CEO Daniel Hughes founded Summit Housing Partners in 1994.

The company operates through two primary divisions. Envolve Communities, based in Montgomery, Alabama, holds the owned portfolio and acquires, develops, and rehabilitates properties using Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, tax-exempt bonds, soft debt, and historic tax credits. Envolve Client Services Group, based in Memphis, Tennessee, provides third-party management. As of January 2026, the platform covered more than 450 properties and over 41,000 apartment homes across 29 states, with approximately 1,300 employees.

Expansion has come through regional platform acquisitions, including Ross in Denver, Lipton in St. Louis, MPM in Kerrville, Texas, and Excel in Raleigh. Texas is the largest market, with more than 11,500 homes, roughly 36% of the portfolio, reported in December 2022. North Carolina accounts for approximately 7,000 units, about 17% of the current managed total, and Colorado and Oklahoma for 2,920 units added through Ross. Recent investments include general partner interests in eight communities totaling 1,715 units in December 2025 and the 216-unit Crestwood Apartments near Orlando for $34.3 million in March 2026. Rent is collected from individual households rather than commercial tenants, and many properties operate under HUD Section 8 contracts and LIHTC rent restrictions.

Gables Residential is a privately held real estate investment trust and owner-operator headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Founded in 1982, the company operates as a vertically integrated platform focused on the development, construction, acquisition, and management of multifamily and mixed-use communities across high-growth U.S. markets. The firm owns and manages approximately 25,000 to 28,000 apartment homes and 750,000 square feet of retail space. In 2015, Clarion Partners led a consortium of 12 global institutional investors in a $3.2 billion acquisition and recapitalization of Gables, converting the company into an open-end fund structure with an initial portfolio of 54 luxury communities.
Gables operates in multiple markets including Atlanta, Austin, Boston, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Jacksonville, Orlando, Salt Lake City, Seattle, South Florida, Southern California, and metropolitan Washington, D.C. The company also provides third-party management services in Tampa, North Florida, Chicago, New York, and Phoenix. The portfolio includes both wholly-owned assets and third-party managed properties, with development projects underway in several key markets. As of August 2026, public records indicate 59 current property ownerships held through 32 confirmed entities, with $12.8 billion in total recorded mortgage volume across 161 mortgages.
The company employs over 900 associates and maintains an average employee tenure of 5.59 years. Gables' multifamily focus inherently diversifies tenant concentration risk across thousands of individual residential leases rather than reliance on a few corporate tenants. The firm has received national recognition for development excellence, property management, and sustainability practices, including multiple FGBC certifications and Fitwel ratings at various communities. Key geographic exposure includes concentrations in Texas markets (Dallas, Houston, Austin), Florida (South Florida, Orlando, Jacksonville, Tampa), and the Washington, D.C. metro area.

OBAMAX Global Services Nigeria Limited is a division of Obax Worldwide Limited. OBAMAX is a leading player in oil and Gas Facilities Operation and Maintenance. Their experience and services go beyond Nigeria and West Africa to the United States of America and the Middle East. Through their extensive experience, OBAMAX has been in the frontline of indigenous Companies in the delivery of world-class, first-class Oil and Gas Operation and Maintenance services.

At OBAMAX, they employ the combination of commercial and technical professionals in their main offices in the United States, China, Venezuela and Nigeria. These staff members encompass all upstream technical disciplines (geology, geophysics, petrophysics, reservoir engineering, drilling/completion and development planning/facilities engineering), with midstream and downstream engineering and economics, commercial, legal and business strategy professionals to complement its technical staff.

CIM Group is a real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender and developer based in Los Angeles. Shaul Kuba, Richard Ressler and Avi Shemesh founded the firm in 1994. In February 2018 it acquired Cole Capital from VEREIT. On June 24, 2026, CIM Real Estate Finance Trust (CMFT), a non-listed REIT managed by CIM affiliates, acquired the real assets management business and investment portfolio of CIM Group, LLC and renamed itself CIM Group, Inc. CIM Group Holdings, a CIM Group, LLC subsidiary, holds 67.5% of the economic and voting interest. Former CMFT shareholders hold the other 32.5%. The company ended its REIT status effective January 1, 2026. Its common stock is quoted over-the-counter under the ticker CMRF, and the company has committed to start pursuing a national exchange listing within 24 months.

CIM reports $31.8 billion in assets owned and operated across five platforms: Real Estate, Credit, Infrastructure, Opportunity Zones and Strategic Opportunities. Its real estate strategies cover core, value-add, net lease and ground-up development. Capital deployed in real estate breaks down as residential at $17.3 billion (37%), office at $11.3 billion (24%), land and horizontal development at $2.3 billion (5%), and industrial at $875 million (2%). The firm also invests in hospitality, retail and mixed-use assets. It lends against office, multifamily, industrial and hospitality properties.

At year-end 2025, the company's own net lease portfolio had 202 properties totaling 6.7 million square feet in 37 states. The largest state exposures by annualized rental income were Virginia (16%), Ohio (12%) and Wisconsin (8%). Four tenants made up 28% of annualized rental income: CVS (9%), Cabela's (7%), United Oil (6%) and Lowe's (6%). Across the wider platform, CIM has invested about $4 billion of equity in the New York metropolitan area since 2010. It also has large projects in Los Angeles, Atlanta and Chicago. Camden Property Trust is a publicly traded multifamily real estate investment trust focused on the ownership, management, development, and redevelopment of apartment communities across high-growth U.S. markets. Co-founded by Richard Campo and Keith Oden in 1982, the company went public in 1993 and has since become an S&P 500 component and one of the largest multifamily REITs in the United States. The company operates with a vertically integrated model, handling construction, leasing, maintenance, and resident services in-house rather than outsourcing to third-party managers.

Camden's portfolio is concentrated in Sun Belt and select Mid-Atlantic markets with strong employment growth, population migration, and household formation trends. Key markets include Houston, Dallas, Atlanta, Phoenix, Tampa, Washington DC, and Charlotte. The company primarily owns Class A and upper-tier Class B apartment communities positioned in suburban and urban-suburban locations. In February 2026, Camden announced plans to exit California entirely, selling 11 properties totaling approximately 3,600 units valued at $1.5 billion, with proceeds to be redeployed into higher-return Sun Belt markets where regulatory environments are more favorable.

The company pursues growth through three parallel pipelines: development of new communities, selective acquisitions of stabilized assets, and capital recycling through dispositions of older properties. Camden maintains a disciplined approach to market timing, having navigated the elevated multifamily supply deliveries of 2024 while positioning for improved fundamentals as new construction slows. The company's management team has exhibited exceptional continuity, with co-founders Campo and Oden leading strategy for over 40 years.

Founded in 1982, the company operates as a vertically integrated platform focused on the development, construction, acquisition, and management of multifamily and mixed-use communities across high-growth U.S. markets. The firm owns and manages approximately 25,000 to 28,000 apartment homes and 750,000 square feet of retail space. In 2015, Clarion Partners led a consortium of 12 global institutional investors in a $3.2 billion acquisition and recapitalization of Gables, converting the company into an open-end fund structure with an initial portfolio of 54 luxury communities.
Gables operates in multiple markets including Atlanta, Austin, Boston, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Jacksonville, Orlando, Salt Lake City, Seattle, South Florida, Southern California, and metropolitan Washington, D.C. The company also provides third-party management services in Tampa, North Florida, Chicago, New York, and Phoenix. The portfolio includes both wholly-owned assets and third-party managed properties, with development projects underway in several key markets. As of August 2026, public records indicate 59 current property ownerships held through 32 confirmed entities, with $12.8 billion in total recorded mortgage volume across 161 mortgages.
The company employs over 900 associates and maintains an average employee tenure of 5.59 years. Blackstone Inc. (NYSE: “BX”) is the largest owner of commercial real estate in the world. Blackstone was founded in 1985 in New York City by the late Peter G. Peterson and by Stephen A. Schwarzman, who serves as the current Chief Executive Officer. SecurityNational Mortgage Company was established in 1993 as part of the Security National family of companies, building on roots that began with Security National Life Insurance Company in 1965. Gables Residential is a privately held real estate investment trust and owner-operator headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Founded in 1982, the company operates as a vertically integrated platform focused on the development, construction, acquisition, and management of multifamily and mixed-use communities across high-growth U.S. markets. The firm owns and manages approximately 25,000 to 28,000 apartment homes and 750,000 square feet of retail space. In 2015, Clarion Partners led a consortium of 12 global institutional investors in a $3.2 billion acquisition and recapitalization of Gables, converting the company into an open-end fund structure with an initial portfolio of 54 luxury communities.
Gables operates in multiple markets including Atlanta, Austin, Boston, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Jacksonville, Orlando, Salt Lake City, Seattle, South Florida, Southern California, and metropolitan Washington, D.C. The company also provides third-party management services in Tampa, North Florida, Chicago, New York, and Phoenix. The portfolio includes both wholly-owned assets and third-party managed properties, with development projects underway in several key markets. As of August 2026, public records indicate 59 current property ownerships held through 32 confirmed entities, with $12.8 billion in total recorded mortgage volume across 161 mortgages.
The company employs over 900 associates and maintains an average employee tenure of 5.59 years. Gables' multifamily focus inherently diversifies tenant concentration risk across thousands of individual residential leases rather than reliance on a few corporate tenants. The firm has received national recognition for development excellence, property management, and sustainability practices, including multiple FGBC certifications and Fitwel ratings at various communities. Key geographic exposure includes concentrations in Texas markets (Dallas, Houston, Austin), Florida (South Florida, Orlando, Jacksonville, Tampa), and the Washington, D.C. metro area.

CIM Group is a real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender and developer based in Los Angeles. Shaul Kuba, Richard Ressler and Avi Shemesh founded the firm in 1994. In February 2018 it acquired Cole Capital from VEREIT. On June 24, 2026, CIM Real Estate Finance Trust (CMFT), a non-listed REIT managed by CIM affiliates, acquired the real assets management business and investment portfolio of CIM Group, LLC and renamed itself CIM Group, Inc. CIM Group Holdings, a CIM Group, LLC subsidiary, holds 67.5% of the economic and voting interest. Former CMFT shareholders hold the other 32.5%. The company ended its REIT status effective January 1, 2026. Its common stock is quoted over-the-counter under the ticker CMRF, and the company has committed to start pursuing a national exchange listing within 24 months.

CIM reports $31.8 billion in assets owned and operated across five platforms: Real Estate, Credit, Infrastructure, Opportunity Zones and Strategic Opportunities. Its real estate strategies cover core, value-add, net lease and ground-up development. Capital deployed in real estate breaks down as residential at $17.3 billion (37%), office at $11.3 billion (24%), land and horizontal development at $2.3 billion (5%), and industrial at $875 million (2%). The firm also invests in hospitality, retail and mixed-use assets. It lends against office, multifamily, industrial and hospitality properties.

At year-end 2025, the company's own net lease portfolio had 202 properties totaling 6.7 million square feet in 37 states. The largest state exposures by annualized rental income were Virginia (16%), Ohio (12%) and Wisconsin (8%). Four tenants made up 28% of annualized rental income: CVS (9%), Cabela's (7%), United Oil (6%) and Lowe's (6%). Across the wider platform, CIM has invested about $4 billion of equity in the New York metropolitan area since 2010. It also has large projects in Los Angeles, Atlanta and Chicago. The firm has more than 900 employees.

BSR Real Estate Investment Trust is a publicly traded multifamily owner and operator focused on garden-style apartment communities in the Sunbelt region of the United States. The company traces its roots to 1956 with the formation of Bailey Corporation, a commercial real estate development firm founded by Virginia M. Bailey in Little Rock, Arkansas. In the 1990s, under the leadership of John S. Bailey, the company pivoted entirely to multifamily properties. BSR was formed through a 2012 merger with Summit Housing Partners of Montgomery, Alabama, and went public on the Toronto Stock Exchange in 2018 under the ticker symbols HOM.U and HOM.UN. At the time of its initial public offering, the portfolio consisted primarily of value-add properties in tertiary Sunbelt markets. Over the following years, management executed a capital rotation strategy to reposition the portfolio into newer communities within the Texas Triangle markets of Dallas, Houston, and Austin, which now generate 90% of the REIT's net operating income.

Hanover Company is a family-owned real estate developer founded in 1982 and headquartered in Houston, Texas. Hanover operates through approximately 60 holding entities and maintains lending relationships with Truist Bank, Wells Fargo Bank, and other institutional lenders. Leadership is led by founder Murry Bowden (Executive Chairman), with second-generation family members Brandt Bowden (CEO) and Jeb Bowden (COO) overseeing operations.

At year-end 2025, the company's own net lease portfolio had 202 properties totaling 6.7 million square feet in 37 states. The largest state exposures by annualized rental income were Virginia (16%), Ohio (12%) and Wisconsin (8%). Four tenants made up 28% of annualized rental income: CVS (9%), Cabela's (7%), United Oil (6%) and Lowe's (6%). Across the wider platform, CIM has invested about $4 billion of equity in the New York metropolitan area since 2010. It also has large projects in Los Angeles, Atlanta and Chicago. Statewide’s ownership structure is privately held, with leadership led by President Marc Chopp. The firm operates under a centralized management model, offering services such as rent collection, budgeting, marketing, financial reporting, and maintenance coordination. Its operational philosophy emphasizes transparency, cost control, and long-term asset preservation.

The company’s investment strategy is focused on income-producing residential assets. Statewide targets stabilized or value-add apartment buildings in dense urban neighborhoods, particularly Koreatown, Westlake, Mid-Wilshire, and Hollywood. The firm’s approach includes enhancing operational efficiency and tenant retention through proactive maintenance and on-site personnel supervision.

Statewide Enterprises maintains a full-service maintenance crew available 24/7, which reduces reliance on third-party vendors and improves cost efficiency.

While Statewide's portfolio includes over 1,500 units across more than 30 properties. The firm’s technology infrastructure includes online portals for tenants and owners, supporting digital rent payments, maintenance requests, and financial reporting.

SOCOTEC USA is a technical services company focused on buildings and infrastructure, offering testing, inspection, certification, and consulting support across the built environment. The company's work spans geotechnical engineering, building envelope, fire and life safety, energy, code and expediting, specialty engineering, advisory, and dispute resolution. SOCOTEC USA's U.S. platform was established in 2019, and the broader SOCOTEC group was formed in 1953. The business has continued expanding its U.S. platform through acquisitions and integration of specialty firms while keeping its emphasis on asset integrity, sustainability, and technical risk management.

SKY Properties, Inc. was founded in 1997 by Kari Negri to offer hands-on, boutique level property management at a competitive price. Widely recognized within the property management industry as a leading provider of full service property management while optimizing property cash-flow and streamlining leasing and maintenance.
Malin Asset Management Inc is a premier housing provider specializing in Los Angeles & Inglewood. They deliver high-quality apartments at the most affordable prices.

Since entering the market in 1995, United Apartment Group (UAG) has expanded its managed units by more than twenty-five-fold, with the portfolio value nearing the $3 billion mark. Over 75,000 satisfied residents in 30,000 units now live in communities managed by UAG. Its presence is found in Texas, Louisiana, Arkansas, Mississippi, Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Florida. 

United Apartment Group (UAG), renowned for its excellence, has been a significant player in the real estate market for over three decades. With a robust foundation, UAG stands out as a leader in the fee management sector. Recognized as a Top 50 Company by the NMHC, UAG specializes in the dedicated management of various property types, but primarily multifamily.

Brixton Capital has had majority ownership of United Apartment Group since 2020. The Residential division of Brixton Capital in partnership with UAG launched a multifamily investment management initiative. The asset and property management expertise of the two companies will aid owners beyond traditional property management.

Which Wich® Superior Sandwiches was founded in Dallas in late 2003 by restaurant entrepreneur, Jeff Sinelli. The global sandwich franchise chain is best known for its customizable sandwiches, creative ordering system, and personalized sandwich bag. They select a sandwich from multiple categories, then choose the bread, cheese, spreads, and toppings. There are other extra options such as double meat, double cheese, bacon, and avocado. The menus have a wide variety of options which besides the aforementioned extras are all free. The sandwiches are then prepared, and delivered in the personalized sandwich bags. Guests are encouraged to draw on their bags and hang their "artwork" on the community wall.

sweetFrog is a frozen yogurt chain that lets customers build their own desserts with soft-serve yogurt and a toppings bar. The company was founded in 2009 and grew from its first shop in Richmond, Virginia, into a brand focused on frozen yogurt retail, parties, catering, and fundraising programs. The company operates a customizable self-serve format, with flavors and toppings that vary by location.

Mill Creek Residential is a privately held multifamily developer and operator based in Boca Raton, Florida. Founded in 2011, the firm functions as a vertically integrated investment manager focused on rental housing development, construction, acquisition, and management across the United States. The company operates through 21 offices covering 29 markets, with a portfolio that includes both traditional multifamily apartment communities and single-family rental developments marketed under the Amavi brand. As of February 2026, Mill Creek reported $11.3 billion in assets under management and has deployed $22.6 billion in capital since its inception. The firm maintains over 100 institutional capital relationships and structures investments through commingled funds, separately managed accounts, and programmatic joint ventures.

The portfolio consists of 153 communities representing over 43,500 rental homes either operating or under construction as of late 2025. Mill Creek's investment approach spans multiple strategies: ground-up multifamily development, build-to-rent single-family development, value-add acquisitions of existing apartment communities, and core/core+ multifamily acquisitions. Since 1993, the company has executed more than $25 billion in transactions and completed 28 value-add acquisitions. The development platform targets transit-oriented opportunities in infill and suburban locations near employment centers, with additional focus on historic redevelopment and mixed-use communities.

Geographic concentration centers on ten states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington. Public records indicate the firm operates through 47 holding entities with recorded mortgage activity exceeding $3.6 billion across 49 current property ownerships. Top lending relationships include CBRE Multifamily Capital, JPMorgan Chase Bank, and Morgan Stanley Private Bank. Leadership is headed by founding partner William C. MacDonald, who serves as Chairman, CEO, and President. The company employs approximately 1,741 associates and was recognized as the 2024 NAHB Multifamily Development Firm of the Year.

Lincoln Property Company began in Dallas, Texas in 1965 and has grown into a commercial real estate firm focused on development, leasing, property management, investment, advisory, and asset solutions. The company works across office, industrial, retail, multifamily, and mixed-use properties, serving owners, investors, lenders, and occupiers of commercial space. Lincoln maintains a broad national and global market presence, with services that support development, repositioning, and ongoing property operations. The company's business spans both real estate services and investment activity, reflecting a long-running platform built around commercial property management and development.

Verifone, formerly styled VeriFone, began in 1981 and grew from an early point-of-sale hardware business into a global payments technology company. The company now delivers a unified payments platform that connects devices, applications, gateways, processing, integrations, and services for in-person and online commerce. Verifone also offers payment processing, online ordering, customer support, account management, retail checkout solutions, and unattended commerce products such as kiosk and self-checkout systems. The business serves merchants, financial institutions, and commerce providers across a broad international footprint.

Asset Living is a third-party property management firm founded in 1986 that serves multifamily, student, and affordable housing communities across the United States. The company also works in active adult and build-to-rent housing, combining property management with services such as compliance training, financial planning, marketing, underwriting, due diligence, construction management, and data analytics. Asset Living operates as a broad real estate management platform that supports owners and institutional partners through property management, asset management, receivership, and investment services. The company maintains a national operating footprint built around residential real estate management and related support functions.

Alliance Residential is a privately held, vertically integrated multifamily developer and operator founded in 2000 and headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. The firm has developed or acquired more than 136,000 units representing over $27.2 billion in invested capital across 16 states and 39 metropolitan markets. Alliance operates through multiple brands, including Broadstone for luxury multifamily, Prose for workforce housing, Holden for senior living, and Silveray for build-to-rent communities. In 2021, the company launched Alliance Industrial to develop warehouse and distribution facilities. Alliance principals have worked together through multiple cycles since the mid-1980s and ranked #4 on the 2026 NMHC Top Developers list, up from #8 in 2025, after starting 5,501 units in 2025. The firm maintains 16 regional offices spanning the West, Southwest, South-Central, Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Northeast regions. Alliance's investment strategy encompasses ground-up development, acquisition, construction, and asset management, targeting value-add repositioning, infill core assets, and properties in high-growth submarkets. Recent acquisition activity between December 2025 and May 2026 added approximately 2,000 units across California, Texas, Florida, and Pennsylvania, with five properties acquired at discounts to replacement cost. The firm's geographic footprint includes California's Inland Empire and greater Los Angeles, Phoenix, Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Orlando, and Philadelphia's Main Line.

Greystar was founded in 1993 by Founder, Chairman, and CEO Bob Faith. Greystar is the global leader in rental housing with expertise in real estate sectors across multiple geographies. The company's business model is unique in its ability to own, operate, and develop collegiate, multifamily, corporate, and senior housing across the globe. Greystar continues to expand its geographic reach around the world, bringing a globally interconnected professional rental housing platform and industry funded with institutional capital to countries where the sector does not yet exist. With offices in more than 60 cities serving more than 200 markets globally, and more than 740,000 units and student beds under management, Greystar currently ranks first among the Top 50 US Apartment Managers according to the 2021 National Multifamily Housing Council. Greystar manages $41.3 billion in assets and oversees a global portfolio of more than 165,900 owned units across multiple strategies and geographies.

Berglas & Garfield is a California real estate company focused on the ownership, management, and redevelopment of apartment properties across Los Angeles. The company traces its roots to more than 50 years of activity and has built a residential portfolio centered on condo-quality apartment homes, property maintenance, and ongoing community improvements. Berglas & Garfield emphasizes eco-friendly operations through energy-efficient appliances, solar power, water-saving measures, recycling programs, and resident portal tools for maintenance requests and lease documents. The company operates a set of apartment communities with varied floor plans and amenities for renters in the broader Los Angeles market.

CB&A Realtors recognizes that "home" can mean different things to different people. Whether buying or selling, investing, or even an agent looking for a new home for a business, they are here to create awesome experiences for everyone they work with.

Their team of Houston Realtors represents the best and brightest in the industry, and they’re always striving to lead the field in research, innovation, and consumer education. Today’s buyers and sellers need a trusted resource that can guide them through the complex world of real estate. With their extensive knowledge and commitment to providing only the best and most timely information about Houston real estate to their clients, they are the go-to source for real estate industry insight and advice.

Founded in 1975 and headquartered in San Diego, CONAM is a privately held real estate investment and services firm specializing in multifamily housing. Over five decades, the company has built a reputation for disciplined investment strategies and operational excellence. CONAM operates as both an owner and fee-based manager, overseeing a nationwide portfolio that includes over 500 properties. Its vertically integrated platform supports acquisitions, development, repositioning, and property management.

CONAM’s investment strategy centers on multifamily assets, with a strong emphasis on value creation through operational efficiencies and targeted capital improvements. Geographically, CONAM maintains a strong presence in California, Texas, Oregon, Nevada, and Florida, with notable market exposure in Sacramento, Portland, and Dallas-Fort Worth.

For millions of patients experiencing joint pain, facing the prospect of joint replacement surgery along with all of the associated risks and potential unwanted side effects, Flexogenix provides a cost-effective nonsurgical alternative with little to no post-procedural downtime, with most patients able to resume normal activity the same day of the procedure. Treatments are physician administered, FDA approved and, in most cases, completely covered by medical insurance. We custom tailor treatment to each person’s individual needs. Flexogenix offers a no-obligation consultation. If you are a candidate, a medical evaluation will follow and you will receive a detailed treatment plan capitalizing on the latest medical technology focusing on joint viscosupplementation and regenerative therapy, helping to reduce degenerative deterioration and musculoskeletal pain without dangerous side effects or undergoing surgery. At Flexogenix, we share your view that surgery should and can be a last resor

Olympus Property is a privately held multifamily investment and property management firm based in Fort Worth, Texas. Chandler Wonderly founded the company in 1992 in Bakersfield, California, with two apartment properties. He remains Founder and Principal, and Wade Madden has been Chief Executive Officer since January 2024. The company is not publicly traded and has no ticker symbol.

Olympus buys, owns and self-manages Class A apartment communities. It concentrates on newer properties in submarkets with limited new supply, population growth and employment growth, and multifamily is its only asset class. As of September 2026, the firm reported $9.6 billion in assets under management across 144 properties totaling about 39,000 units. Its website lists more than 40,000 units in 20 states and 45 cities, with more than 800 team members.

The company raises capital from institutional partners and high-net-worth investors. Since 2024 it has also raised money through its affiliate, Olympus Capital Real Estate, which offers Delaware statutory trusts, the perpetual-life Olympus Property REIT and a preferred equity series. The firm reports 59 full-cycle events since inception and a historical average hold period of 5.5 years.

Since 2025, the company has bought properties outside its historical Sun Belt base. These include a first Tucson asset, a first Miami asset, a 216-unit community in Millville, Delaware (its first in the Mid-Atlantic) and the 166-unit Station 250 in Mundelein, Illinois (its first in the Chicago area).

Based on listed communities, the largest share of properties is in Texas (approximately 30, or 24.2%), mainly in Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio and Midland. Arizona follows with approximately 19 (15.3%) and Florida with approximately 15 (12.1%). Together these three states account for about half of listed properties, so regional rent or supply changes in Texas would affect the largest part of the portfolio. Revenue comes from individual residential leases, and the company does not disclose any tenant or customer concentration.

BioSig is a digital signal processing company that unites expertise in medical engineering, intellectual property, and workflow to deliver superior intracardiac signals with unprecedented precision.

Their technology provides a new level of clarity and resolution in arrhythmia identification and visualization, empowering physicians with actionable insights.

R.W. Selby & Company is a privately held real estate investment and property management firm founded in 1975 and headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The company transitioned from a brokerage operation to a principal investor in 1977 and has since focused exclusively on multifamily properties in Southern California and Nevada. The firm operates a portfolio of more than 5,000 apartment homes across premier urban and suburban communities, with strategic expansion into Arizona. The company's investment strategy targets submarkets with limited supply, high barriers to entry, and proximity to major residential and commercial hubs. R.W. Selby employs a vertically integrated operating platform that includes in-house leasing, property management, and design services. The company has acquired more than 7,000 apartments throughout Southern California and greater Las Vegas since its founding. Geographic concentration is focused on Los Angeles County markets including Westwood, Beverly Hills, Brentwood, Culver City, West Los Angeles, Hollywood, and Los Feliz, as well as the San Diego metro area and Las Vegas/Henderson, Nevada.

Windsor Property Management, operating as Windsor Communities, is the in-house property management subsidiary of GID, a privately held real estate investment and management firm. Founded in 1960 with the renovation of three apartment buildings in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Windsor has grown into one of the largest multifamily property management companies in the United States. The firm focuses exclusively on multifamily residential properties, owning and managing over 155 apartment communities comprising more than 58,000 units across 23 markets. Windsor operates in 16 states and Washington D.C., with concentrations in California, the Pacific Northwest, Texas, Florida, the Southeast, and the Northeast corridor. The company maintains a vertically integrated approach, owning all properties under management rather than providing third-party services. Recent expansion has been driven by GID's active acquisition strategy, with 2024 purchases totaling over $750 million in multifamily assets. The firm ranked #37 among the largest apartment managers in the 2025 NMHC rankings and has been recognized as the #1 property management company for resident satisfaction for five consecutive years.

The Guillory Group Real Estate Firm is a small group committed to delivering BIG results to both our commercial and residential clients. Our goal for all of our clients is to establish long-term relationships. Our bottom line: We want your repeat business and referrals. And the only way to make that happen is to get it right the first time!   

We're passionate about delivering an exceptional experience. When you hire us, you're hiring a team of professionals that is trained and skilled to deliver the best results in residential and commercial real estate.

From the initial meeting to closing and funding, we are consummate professionals and treat your transaction with the confidentiality it requires.

We apply the most current knowledge and expertise when assisting you with your home purchase or sale, commercial lease or even commercial property sale. You can rely on our professional team to make recommendations that make sense and save you money.

Its activities include supporting leveraged buyouts, recapitalizations, growth initiatives, and refinancing transactions. Operating under external management by OFS Capital Management, the firm functions within a broader family of investment entities associated with Orchard First Source Asset Management. Traded on the NASDAQ under the ticker OFS, the company focuses on generating income and capital appreciation through a portfolio of senior secured loans, subordinated debt, and selective equity positions.

Matra Petroleum plc (“Matra”) is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company operating in the USA where it owns 27 leases located in the Texas Panhandle region.
The company began operations in 2005 and was originally focussed on the Volga/Urals area of Russia before exiting the country following a strategic review in 2013.
The company was originally named Ming Resources and was listed on the AIM market in 2005. In April 2006, the company was renamed Matra Petroleum plc and gained readmission to AIM after completion of a reverse takeover of Inke Petroleum (a private Australian company).
In April 2007, Matra acquired a Russian subsidiary owning the rights to the Arkhangelovskoe Licence in Orenburg Russia.
In 2012, Maxim Barskiy made a strategic investment in the Company. Shortly after doing so, he took over as CEO and board member.

Safehold is creating meaningful economic opportunities for building owners and investors with a reinvented ground lease structure. They identified a widespread market inefficiency that was draining value from real estate owners, operators and developers. Building owners targeting a ~15% return should not be forced to use their expensive equity to drive low returns. Safehold® is the first publicly traded company to focus on modern ground leases. They are the only nationally-scaled platform that is focused on making ground leases value-enhancing for customers. To deliver efficient capital, backed by a high level of expertise, a superior customer experience and the integrity that has been a hallmark of their leadership team for three decades.

Founded in 2002, Concord Blue Energy is a turn-key waste management solution company and a developer of the industry leading, pyrolysis-based, waste to energy (w2e) patented technology that transforms nearly any form of waste into a variety of renewable fuels, including hydrogen & electricity, with virtually no pollutants.

Concord Blue has developed its own waste conversion technology, known as the Concord Blue Reformer (CBR). CBR is the world's most advanced waste conversion solution that is patented. The propriety developed CBR technology is cable of transforming nearly any form of local waste, such as, biomass, agriculture waste, sewage sludge, plastics, municipal solid waste into renewable fuels and energy, such as electricity, hydrogen, biofuels, etc.

ABM began in 1909 as a window-washing business and later grew into a broader facilities company. The business now provides facility, engineering, infrastructure, and mobility solutions for a wide range of industries, including commercial real estate, data centers, healthcare, education, aviation, and manufacturing. ABM also supports building maintenance, energy-related services, and transportation-focused operations across its service portfolio. The company's long history and broad mix of services have made ABM a familiar name in building operations and workplace support.

Church of God Mission International began in 1962 as a prayer group called Calvary Fellowship and later expanded into a wider Christian ministry. The church was formally inaugurated in the mid-1960s and grew into a denomination centered on evangelism, worship, and spiritual outreach. Its work now spans church ministry, training through the International Leadership Resource Institute, education, and publishing through Above Only Publishers. The church also supports media and online services as part of its broader religious and educational presence.

The Swig Company is a privately held real estate investment and management firm with a long-standing presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company focuses on owning, operating, and managing a portfolio of commercial office properties, emphasizing sustainability and tenant-focused services. Its holdings include a mix of high-rise office buildings and mixed-use assets in key urban markets. The Swig Company is known for its commitment to modernizing and repositioning properties to meet evolving workplace needs while maintaining strong relationships with tenants and partners. Privately owned and independently managed, the firm continues to play a significant role in the region’s commercial real estate landscape through strategic acquisitions and property enhancements.
Redwood Partners Inc. offers boutique apartment properties located in premier Los Angeles neighborhoods.

Here at Ashford Communities, it is their honor to own and manage thriving, unparalleled communities in South Texas. Ashford Communities commitment to their residents and themselves is to be the best multi-family company in their market. Ashford Communities is on a mission to help you find a place to belong. Ashford Communities values of Pride, Connection, Care and Belonging serve as their compass.

Vero Sade designs, develops, builds and operates Class-A residential real estate, custom homes, member clubs, lifestyle gyms, retail and hospitality across the US. Their vertically-integrated model is centered around a core mission to build sustainably and promote a culture of wellbeing for their residents, employees and partners.

Vero Sade has brought expertise in-house to increase quality and maximize efficiency throughout the design, development, construction and property management process. This results in an expedited development timeline, more attention to detail and lower risk – all creating wins for debt and equity partners.

European Wax Center began as a family-owned business in 2004 and grew from a single waxing concept into a national brand focused on professional hair-removal services. The company offers facial and body waxing, including eyebrow, bikini, Brazilian, leg, arm, and male waxing, along with skin care and post-wax products designed for use after appointments. Its business centers on a franchised salon model supported by proprietary wax and a standardized guest experience across a broad U.S. network. The company also sells a product line for waxed skin that includes aftercare and skin-smoothing items.

In less than three years. Seoul Sausage Company has become the premier force behind cutting edge Korean BBQ.  What began as a tiny catering company run out of their apartment kitchen, Seoul Sausage is now a multi-faceted culinary enterprise comprised of two acclaimed restaurants (West LA and Downtown LA), two food trucks, a customized grilling scion and an in-demand catering company.

Founded by brothers Ted and Yong Kim alongside Chef Chris Oh, Seoul Sausage Company broke onto the public’s awareness when they won Season 3 of The Great Food Truck Race, Food Network’s second highest rated show. Now, food celebrities such as Alton Brown, Giada De Laurentis and Bobby Flay frequent their store during TV shoots to munch on their favorite dishes.

Greysteel was founded in 2012 as a commercial real estate advisory firm built to combine investment sales with debt and structured finance services. Greysteel has since developed a national platform that serves private, middle-market, and institutional investors across the United States. Greysteel's core business centers on investment sales, debt placement, and structured finance, with sector-specific advisory across property types such as healthcare, affordable housing, multifamily, office, retail, industrial, and other asset classes. Greysteel is a national commercial real estate and capital markets services firm continuing to expand its advisory footprint.

Rockwell Management was founded in 1994 through the consolidation of two property management firms, Garden Property Management of Texas and Garden National Properties of New Jersey. The company focuses on full-service property management, with work centered on multifamily apartments, condominiums, single-family rental homes, and commercial office space. Rockwell Management also provides related support such as leasing, maintenance, construction management for capital improvements and tenant projects, financial reporting, and property operations oversight. Its portfolio and service lines show a business built around managing residential and commercial real estate assets for owners and residents across the Houston market.

Commerce Capital Partners, LLC is a private real estate management and investment firm focused on commercial real estate in the Sun Belt – primarily Texas. At ComCapp, they actively search out opportunities with value-add components, little or no competition, and undercapitalized ownership structures. Their principles have been active in commercial real estate since 1984 and currently have ownership interest in more than sixty properties comprising over 16,000 apartment units and 3.5 million square feet of commercial space in eight states. Over the last eighteen months, they’ve been active in this most recent downturn in commercial real estate and have purchased over $40,000,000 of multifamily properties in Texas.

Comcapp is pleased to be recognized year over year with the SatisFacts Resident Satisfaction National Company Award. This award recognizes management companies with multiple properties that have received outstanding resident satisfaction ratings on ApartmentRatings.com.

Farmers Insurance began in 1928 as the Farmers Automobile Inter-Insurance Exchange, created to serve drivers with affordable coverage. The company now offers insurance and financial products across home, auto, life, business, recreational vehicle, and device protection categories. Farmers Insurance uses a wide distribution model that includes exclusive agencies, independent agents, and direct sales channels, and it serves households and businesses across the United States.

FedEx Office began as Kinko's in 1970 and later became part of FedEx after the company acquired Kinko's and rebranded the business. FedEx Office now focuses on copying, digital printing, professional finishing, signs, computer rental, corporate print solutions, packing services, shipping services, and Hold at FedEx Location support. The business serves consumers and organizations through retail print-and-ship services that connect with the broader FedEx transportation network. FedEx Office remains part of the FedEx operating-company structure, giving the company a place within a larger logistics and business-services platform while keeping its print and shipping offerings centered on everyday document and package needs.

Cold Stone Creamery began in 1988 in Arizona and was built around a custom ice cream concept centered on mix-ins and a frozen granite stone. The company offers premium ice cream, ice cream cakes, smoothies, shakes, and other frozen treats, with fresh in-store preparation as part of its core format. Over time, Cold Stone Creamery expanded through a franchise model and now maintains a market presence in the United States and abroad. The business also extends its format through specialty locations and co-branding arrangements with other quick-service concepts.

Neighborhood Markets offer a convenient shopping experience for customers who need groceries, pharmaceuticals and general merchandise. Generally, they are located in markets with Wal-Mart Supercenters, supplementing a strong food distribution network and providing added convenience while maintaining Wal-Mart’s Every Day Low Prices. First opened in 1998 Neighborhood Markets, averaging 42,000 square feet, feature a wide variety of products, including fresh produce, deli foods, fresh meat and dairy items, health and beauty aids, one-hour photo and traditional photo developing services, drive-through pharmacies, stationery and paper goods, pet supplies, and household chemicals.

AOG Living provides marketing and management operations consulting to financial institutions and other owner-clients. The company's investment strategy targets value-add opportunities in multifamily properties, with particular emphasis on Texas markets. Over its history, the firm has transacted more than 100,000 units. Geographic concentration is centered in Houston and other Texas markets, with Florida representing secondary market exposure.

DIJ Group develops a stylish, sophisticated portfolio of residential homes serving an elite consumer in Southern California's most affluent zip codes. Their homes provide an ideal atmosphere for individuals seeking to manifest their way of life.

I Squared Capital is an independent global infrastructure investment manager focusing on energy, utilities, telecom and transport in North America, Europe, and select high growth economies. The Firm has offices in Miami, New York, Houston, London, New Delhi, Hong Kong and Singapore.

Founded in 2005, Entrada Partners is a real estate investment firm headquartered in Los Angeles, California with regional offices in Dallas and San Antonio, Texas. Entrada’s current portfolio consists of industrial, office, retail, market-rate, and affordable housing properties. Their mission is to provide a high level of service to their tenants and residents, and superior risk-adjusted returns to their investors, with an emphasis on integrity, professionalism, and sound business practices.

Shriners International is a fraternity based on fun, fellowship and the Masonic principles of brotherly love, relief and truth.

The possibilities for having fun as a Shriner are endless. Their local Shrine Centers (chapters) around the world have thousands of activity-based clubs, units and events that provide ways for members to connect with each other in a fun environment. A unique aspect of their local chapters is that creativity is encouraged, and if a club for a particular activity doesn’t exist, members are empowered to create one.

They seek to attract men of different backgrounds, career paths, ages and interests, and the unique ideas, beliefs and perspectives they bring to their global Shriners family. Their  members are known for their loyalty, camaraderie and their steadfast support of each other, their communities and their philanthropy, Shriners Children's.

First Choice Management Group is a property management firm specializing in multifamily properties. The company was formed in April 1992 by a group of talented and experienced team of real estate management professionals. On May 1, 2011, First Choice became affiliated with Juniper Investment Group and its principal, Mr. Jay Rippeto. With the strength and stability of Juniper behind it, First Choice is able to further enhance the development of personnel and provide cutting edge technology and systems for all their clients, old and new.

We at Higher Education strive to create a professional and fun environment where people look forward to work. This is a place for collaboration, inspiration, and support. We continuously push ourselves to solve simple and complex issues as a way to advance Higher Education’s success, as well as our own professional learning.

The Fix Ur Gadget concept was founded in the Fall of 2010 when a family member came home from high school with a cracked iPhone 4 screen.  When frustrated mounted from the lack of places to repair the phone, a business opportunity was born.  Five years later and 5 stores have transformed Fix UR Gadget into a major player in the Gadget Repair market.  At Fix Ur Gadget, we have seen and repaired, nearly every type of damaged smartphone, tablet, game console and laptop computer. Fix Ur Gadget is a leader in the market with the combination of affordability, quality and speed. Let our team at Fix Ur Gadget handle your gadget repair needs.

Founded in 1990, Statewide Enterprises is a privately held property management firm headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Statewide’s ownership structure is privately held, with leadership led by President Marc Chopp. The firm operates under a centralized management model, offering services such as rent collection, budgeting, marketing, financial reporting, and maintenance coordination. Its operational philosophy emphasizes transparency, cost control, and long-term asset preservation.

The company’s investment strategy is focused on income-producing residential assets. Statewide targets stabilized or value-add apartment buildings in dense urban neighborhoods, particularly Koreatown, Westlake, Mid-Wilshire, and Hollywood. The firm’s approach includes enhancing operational efficiency and tenant retention through proactive maintenance and on-site personnel supervision.

Statewide Enterprises maintains a full-service maintenance crew available 24/7, which reduces reliance on third-party vendors and improves cost efficiency.

Scribe Rule is a timber framing building technique that dates back to the early Middle Ages. It is the practice of marking, in advance of assembly, irregularly shaped wooden timbers with enough accuracy to ensure a structurally sound fit at a later date.

The Scribe Rule process, still practiced today, allows timbers to remain in their unassembled form until reaching their assembly point, permitting easier handling during storage and transport. To the uninitiated, in their unassembled form, the timbers provide no indication or hint at what they are to become. However, once at the assembly point, the transcribed codes on each of the timbers and at each of the points of linkage reveal the design, allowing for assembly into a three dimensional, recognizable structure.

ERISA is an acronym for the Employee Retirement Income Security Act. The act was originally passed to protect the rights of employees who were denied their promised pensions due to lack of funds and unnecessarily complex vesting requirements. While ERISA did not force employers to offer pension plans, it did subject such plans to strict oversight and regulation once they were established.

ERISA did not stop at regulating pension and retirement plans, however. With very few exceptions, the act governs all “employee welfare benefit plans,” including group disability insurance. It is important to note that disability policies purchased privately by individuals are not governed by ERISA, nor are most group disability policies provided by church or governmental entities.

To understand the advantages of Differential GPS, an explanation of GPS is first necessary. The GPS system, designed and implemented by the US Department of Defense, became fully operational with 24 satellites in the mid 1990’s. These satellites orbit the earth in a medium earth orbit, which is approximately 23,000km above the earth’s surface.

Satellites in the GPS system continuously transmit messages containing information on timing, their position in the orbit, and the general health of the system and estimated location of other satellites in the orbit. A GPS receiver works by receiving this message from a minimum of four satellites and performs a trigonometric calculation. Based on the information in the satellites message and transmission time of this message, a GPS receiver is able to calculate its position.

Services include firm and interruptible storage service, park and loan service, swing service and wheeling and pooling. Their storage facilities serve an important role in helping natural gas market participants manage pipeline imbalances and daily and seasonal price volatility.

Doeren Mayhew began in Michigan in 1932 and has remained rooted in Metro Detroit while expanding into a broader accounting and advisory practice. The company has expanded its role in pharmacy and retail health to include delivery, vaccination, digital care tools, and other services connected to community pharmacy care.

The Chicago Mercantile Exchange began in 1898, and CME Group took shape through later mergers that brought together major U.S. futures exchanges. The company operates financial derivatives exchanges and offers futures, options, cash, and OTC markets across interest rates, equity indexes, foreign exchange, energy, agricultural products, and metals. CME Group also provides benchmark products, market data, and risk management tools that support trading and portfolio analysis across major asset classes. The business serves individuals, companies, and institutions through a broad market presence in the United States and abroad.

The company has grown into a large restaurant franchise built around made-to-order sandwiches, wraps, salads, and other quick-service menu items. Subway restaurants are owned and operated by a broad franchise network, and the brand emphasizes fresh bread, customizable meals, and convenient service for everyday dining. The company continues to serve guests across a wide international restaurant system while remaining focused on its core sandwich-shop format.

H&M Group began in Sweden as Hennes, a women's clothing retailer that later expanded into Hennes & Mauritz and evolved into a multi-brand fashion business. The company focuses on apparel, accessories, home furnishings, beauty, and other fashion and design offerings through H&M and portfolio brands such as COS, Weekday, & Other Stories, ARKET, and Singular Society. H&M Group operates as a global fashion and design company with a broad store and e-commerce presence, and the business combines physical and digital retail around its fashion, design, and sustainability goals.

State Farm began in 1922 when G.J. Mecherle launched a mutual auto insurer to offer farmers fairer rates. The company has since grown into a mutual insurance organization with a broad business mix that includes auto, home, life, health, commercial coverage, and banking and investment services. State Farm's operations center on agent-based distribution, claims handling, and policy servicing for customers across the United States. The company maintains a long-running Good Neighbor brand identity and positions itself as a customer-focused mutual insurer.

Founded in 1999, Synergy HomeCare operates as a national franchise network providing non-medical home care services. The company specializes in assisting seniors, those with memory impairments, and individuals needing transitional care after hospitalization. Their services focus on enabling clients to remain in their homes while receiving personalized support. Synergy emphasizes quality of life through various care programs tailored to individual needs. The franchise model allows local owners to deliver consistent care standards across numerous communities.

DIRECTV began in the mid-1990s as a satellite television service and has since expanded into a broader video business focused on live TV, sports, movies, and entertainment. The company offers satellite, streaming, and IP video services, along with channel packages and access to local, national, and regional sports programming. In 2021, DIRECTV became a standalone video company after separating from AT&T and TPG Capital's ownership structure. The business continues to position its service around a unified television experience that can be delivered through satellite or streaming.

New Century Software began in 1994 as a provider of GIS consulting, data conversion, and software applications for the oil and gas pipeline industry. The company now focuses on pipeline integrity management software and professional services for energy transportation companies, with GIS-enabled tools for data loading, mapping, reporting, asset management, and regulatory compliance. New Century Software also supports pipeline operators and engineering firms involved in new construction, gas transmission, production pipelines, and tank facilities. The UCLA Center for Health Policy Research was founded in 1994 and has developed into a research center focused on improving public health through objective, evidence-based data and policy analysis. The center advances that mission through policy-relevant research, public service, community partnership, media relations, and education. Its work covers health insurance, health economics, health disparities, chronic disease, data disaggregation, and survey methodology, and it also conducts the California Health Interview Survey. The center serves policymakers, community advocates, public and private health organizations, and media with research and data designed to inform health policy decisions.

Solar Turbines serves oil and gas production, processing, and pipeline transmission, as well as electricity and thermal energy generation for industrial processing uses. Solar Turbines has built a global market presence through installed equipment, lifecycle support, and energy solutions focused on natural gas, crude oil, and lower-carbon power applications.

The U.S. Air Force began as a separate military service in the late 1940s and grew from earlier U.S. military aviation efforts into the air arm of the Department of the Air Force. The service's mission is to fly, fight, and win through airpower anytime, anywhere, and its work centers on air superiority, global strike, rapid global mobility, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, and command and control. The Air Force also supports readiness, base infrastructure, and talent management as part of its broader force structure. Beyond traditional aviation, the service includes space and cyber capabilities and remains a major component of U.S. national defense.

Originally founded in 2004 as Goldman Sachs Reinsurance Group, it became an independent entity in 2013 and was fully acquired by KKR in 2024. The company provides annuities, preneed life insurance, and institutional reinsurance solutions, leveraging KKR’s investment capabilities to enhance client value. Global Atlantic operates through subsidiaries such as Accordia Life and Forethought Life Insurance Company and maintains strong financial strength ratings from major agencies. Headquartered in New York City, the company serves millions of policyholders and institutional clients across the United States and Bermuda.

The Lanier Law Firm is a nationally recognized litigation firm founded in 1990 by attorney Mark Lanier. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with offices in New York and Los Angeles, the firm focuses on complex civil litigation, including pharmaceutical and medical device liability, asbestos and toxic exposure, business fraud, and catastrophic personal injury cases. Known for securing landmark verdicts, the firm achieved multi-billion-dollar awards in cases involving defective drugs, talc-related cancer claims, and opioid litigation. The Lanier Law Firm operates as a privately held entity and employs a team of seasoned trial lawyers with board certifications in personal injury and appellate law. Its reputation for high-profile mass tort litigation has positioned it among leading U.S. firms in plaintiff representation.

SVN International Corp. (SVNIC), a full-service commercial real estate franchisor of the SVN® brand, is comprised of over 1,600 commercial real estate Advisors and staff, in more offices in the United States than any other commercial real estate firm and continues to expand across the globe.

Kumon began in 1958 after Toru Kumon developed worksheet-based study materials to help a child build stronger math skills. Kumon grew from that origin into a structured education business centered on self-learning, individualized instruction, and steady daily practice. The company now operates learning centers and offers after-school math and reading programs for preschool through high school students, with materials designed to strengthen foundational skills and independent study habits. Kumon remains focused on workbook-based instruction and educational services that support long-term academic development.

Currently owns and operates its own title plants located in Maverick, Jim Wells, McMullen, Starr, Nueces and Duval counties. Their data goes back to the early 1800’s, which considers us a Texas Sovereignty Plant. They are able to provide professional service concerning commercial, residential, farm and ranch title transactions, as well as for the oil, gas and wind farm industry.

Custard Insurance Adjusters began in 1962, when A.R. "Rick" Custard opened the first office in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and the business expanded from a regional operation into a national loss-adjusting firm. The company provides nationwide claims adjusting across property, transportation, catastrophe, and specialty losses, along with field services, desk handling, and hotline support. Custard also offers third-party administration, risk management, and specialized services that include cargo, heavy equipment, environmental, and special investigation work. The company maintains a broad U.S. network of company-owned adjuster locations and prioritizes immediate response for claims handling.

Lincolnshire Management was founded in 1986 as a private equity firm focused on investing in lower middle market companies. The firm makes control investments and also participates in recapitalizations, corporate divestitures, management buyouts, and growth equity transactions for public and private businesses. Lincolnshire Management works with management teams and uses an in-house operations approach to support portfolio companies across business and industrial services, niche manufacturing, consumer goods and services, and other sectors. The company has built its market presence through a wide range of transactions and acquisitions over multiple business cycles.

TriNet Group, Inc. began in 1988 in the San Francisco Bay Area as a provider of human resources support for small and medium-sized businesses. The company now offers full-service HR solutions that include payroll processing, employee benefits, risk management, compliance support, workers' compensation, and retirement plan administration through its PEO and HR services platform. TriNet serves businesses across a wide range of industries and focuses on helping clients manage HR administration, workforce support, and regulatory obligations so core operations can stay central. The company also emphasizes a technology-enabled service model and long-running industry accreditation tied to its professional employer organization business.

Weitz & Luxenberg has a track record of successfully fighting for clients injured by the negligence of others. Their firm is a leader in areas of litigation including: asbestos and mesothelioma, dangerous drugs and defective devices, environmental pollution, consumer protection, and personal injury. Clients' cases are very important to them. At Weitz & Luxenberg their goal is to achieve the largest verdicts and settlements possible for their clients to ensure they receive the compensation they deserve.
