The company emphasizes trend-driven collections and seasonal designs to meet the needs of boutique buyers and fashion resellers. CAPSULLE has positioned itself as a niche supplier in the apparel and accessories sector.

K TOO is a women’s fashion wholesaler headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Established in 1999, K TOO specializes in contemporary women’s apparel, offering a range of trendy and casual styles designed for boutique retailers and fashion-forward consumers. The company focuses on creating garments that balance style and practicality, catering to diverse fashion preferences. Over the years, K TOO has built a reputation for delivering quality products at competitive prices while maintaining a commitment to ethical and sustainable practices. Its collections include dresses, tops, pants, and coordinated sets, often featuring bold prints and modern silhouettes. K TOO serves a nationwide customer base through its wholesale platform and showroom presence.

Miss Love is a wholesale apparel company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Founded in 2014, the company specializes in women’s young contemporary and junior fashion, offering a range of tops, dresses, outerwear, and seasonal collections. Operating from the Los Angeles Fashion District, Miss Love serves boutique retailers through its showroom and online wholesale platforms. The company focuses on trend-driven designs and competitive pricing to meet the needs of independent fashion businesses.

N°1 is a wholesale apparel distributor specializing in women’s fashion. The company provides a curated selection of contemporary styles to boutiques, online retailers, and department stores. Its product range typically includes dresses, tops, outerwear, and seasonal collections designed to meet market trends and retailer demands. Operating primarily in the wholesale sector, N°1 focuses on delivering quality garments at competitive prices to support businesses in the fashion industry. The company serves as a key link between manufacturers and retailers, ensuring timely distribution and consistent inventory for partners.

Taba is an apparel wholesaler based in Los Angeles, California. Founded in 2017, the company focuses on supplying women’s clothing, including skirts, tops, and plus-size collections, to retailers and boutiques. Its business model emphasizes fast fashion at competitive prices, leveraging decades of experience in the garment industry. Taba serves the wholesale market through online platforms and maintains its operations in the Los Angeles Fashion District.

Spur Energy Partners was formed in 2019 and focuses on acquiring and developing oil and gas assets with base production and low-cost development inventory across the Lower 48. The company's work centers on upstream oil and gas operations, including horizontal development programs in the Delaware Basin and efforts to expand its Permian footprint through additional asset opportunities. Spur Energy Partners maintains business development and royalty relations functions, providing service for interest owners and online access to payment information and ownership materials. The company operates as part of the broader energy sector, with a focus on operational efficiency, technical execution, and asset acquisition rather than retail or consumer services.

Bean & Bottle is a specialty coffee and boutique wine shop that first opened in Houston in 2022. The company serves espresso drinks, retail coffee, and a rotating wine program, and it also offers an expanded kitchen menu for coffee and wine service. Bean & Bottle sells bottles from its cellar, hosts private events in its Bloom Room space, and roasts coffee under the Brotherly Coffee brand for cafe and online sales.

Masraff's began as a father-and-son concept launched by Tony and Russell Masraff in the late 1990s, and the restaurant has since built a long-running presence in Houston dining. The business also offers private events and catering, and remains among Houston restaurants used for lunch, dinner, and special-occasion dining.

The kitchen serves flatbreads, salads, risotto, burgers, and cocktails, while also offering reservations, takeout, and private events. The company has expanded its concept beyond a single dining room through online ordering and a broader restaurant presence in the city.

The company maintains a broad financial-services platform that combines retail banking, business banking, and capital markets activity.

Together, they strive to create and deliver reliable tool systems that bring a fresh, new take on increasing completion operation efficiencies.

JFAK believes in architecture that communicates and inspires, expresses identity, and encourages social interaction. Their design process integrates intuition, play, and dialogue with close analysis of each project’s physical, programmatic, and cultural context, as well as the underlying intentions of those who initiate it. Architecture, after all, is for people, and its creation is always collaborative. Recognizing a common desire to create architectural environments that are simultaneously joyful, meaningful, and sustainable, John Friedman and Alice Kimm founded their design practice in 1996 in Los Angeles, where they discovered fertile ground for their ideas and aspirations. Since then, JFAK has completed a wide range of projects with notable public and private clients. In the process, they have been recognized with numerous distinctions including not one, but two, Rudy Bruner Silver Medal for Urban Excellence awards, the only firm to be so honored.

Founded in Midwood, Brooklyn by Samuel Lemberg, Midwood Investment & Development has grown and evolved with New York City for over ninety years. Today, the company is a sophisticated vertically-integrated investment, development and management platform that owns over 130 properties across the US, and has several million square feet in its development pipeline.

At the intersection of architecture, urbanism, technology, and data, Midwood’s mission is to acquire, develop, and manage best-in-class mixed-use commercial and residential properties that improve neighborhoods and enrich lives.

Salient Partners has emerged as a leading Houston wealth-management firm with a geographic reach that spreads across the country and world. Investors in their funds and services represent nearly every state in America and many foreign countries, and their investment portfolios are structured to capture returns across the globe. Their roots date back to the 1990’s when wealth managers who later became Salient’s principals were among the first to recommend and allocate investment in alternatives. The strategy worked well until 2001-2002, when interest rates reached their historical lows.  At about that time, Haag Sherman, Jeremy Radcliffe, and Andrew Linbeck founded Salient Partners, and were later followed by John Blaisdell, Matthew Newtown, John Price, and Adam Thomas. A year later, Salient merged with Pinnacle Management & Trust, a subsidiary of the Southwest’s largest independent banking investment firms. The merger brought Stephen Reckling, Stephen Strake, and their team to Salient.

Dippin’ Dots is a novelty ice cream company recognized for its unique flash-frozen beaded ice cream products. Headquartered in Paducah, Kentucky, Dippin’ Dots distributes its products through a variety of channels, including amusement parks, stadiums, movie theaters, and retail outlets, as well as online ordering. The brand has expanded its offerings to include ice cream cakes, frozen treats, and specialty beverages. In 2022, Dippin’ Dots was acquired by J&J Snack Foods, a leading manufacturer of snack and frozen novelty products, further strengthening its market presence. The company remains a prominent name in the frozen dessert industry, leveraging its innovative approach and strong brand recognition to maintain a global footprint.

The firm's investment approach centers on deploying capital during market dislocations. Between 2021 and 2022, Lyvwell sold $10 billion of U.S. multifamily assets at an average in-place cap rate of 3.7 percent. Starting in 2024, the company reversed course and deployed $3.7 billion to acquire or contract multifamily properties, capitalizing on distressed sales and valuation declines from 2022 peaks. Recent purchases have averaged cap rates nearly 200 basis points higher than prior dispositions. The portfolio includes both market-rate and rent-controlled properties, with concentrations in gateway cities and Sun Belt markets.
In November 2024, Lyvwell Apartments acquired eight properties totaling 4,143 units from Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust for $845 million, with assets located in Las Vegas, Phoenix, Columbus, Charlotte, and Chapel Hill. In early 2024, Lyvwell acquired a portfolio of approximately 2,100 multifamily apartments in San Francisco. The development pipeline includes 8,000+ units in planning and active construction stages, with an additional 15,000 units under development as of early 2026. Top market exposure includes Seattle, Phoenix, Houston, New York, Washington D.C., East Bay (San Francisco Bay Area), Atlanta, and Inland Empire (Southern California).

CIM Group is a real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender and developer based in Los Angeles. Shaul Kuba, Richard Ressler and Avi Shemesh founded the firm in 1994. CIM Group Holdings, a CIM Group, LLC subsidiary, holds 67.5% of the economic and voting interest. Former CMFT shareholders hold the other 32.5%. The company ended its REIT status effective January 1, 2026. Its common stock is quoted over-the-counter under the ticker CMRF, and the company has committed to start pursuing a national exchange listing within 24 months.

CIM reports $31.8 billion in assets owned and operated across five platforms: Real Estate, Credit, Infrastructure, Opportunity Zones and Strategic Opportunities. Its real estate strategies cover core, value-add, net lease and ground-up development. Capital deployed in real estate breaks down as residential at $17.3 billion (37%), office at $11.3 billion (24%), land and horizontal development at $2.3 billion (5%), and industrial at $875 million (2%). The firm also invests in hospitality, retail and mixed-use assets. It lends against office, multifamily, industrial and hospitality properties.

At year-end 2025, the company's own net lease portfolio had 202 properties totaling 6.7 million square feet in 37 states. The largest state exposures by annualized rental income were Virginia (16%), Ohio (12%) and Wisconsin (8%). Four tenants made up 28% of annualized rental income: CVS (9%), Cabela's (7%), United Oil (6%) and Lowe's (6%). Across the wider platform, CIM has invested about $4 billion of equity in the New York metropolitan area since 2010. It also has large projects in Los Angeles, Atlanta and Chicago. The firm has more than 900 employees.

Its multifamily work covers conventional, affordable, new-build, value-add, and active-adult communities, with a focus on operational performance and resident experience. Harbor Group Management Company also supports commercial assets and positions its work around long-term asset value and nationwide operations.

Alliance Merchant Services, Inc is a California-based company serving businesses of all sizes in their payment processing needs. Alliance Merchant Services is committed to excellence in all aspects of the merchant services/customer relationship. They offer industry-low rates for your credit card processing needs and a selection of top-of-the-line card reader terminals.
Customer support is available 24/7/365 to ensure issues resolve quickly and merchant productivity and satisfaction remain high.

Annabelle is an apparel wholesaler based in Los Angeles, California. Incorporated in 2010, the company specializes in importing and distributing women’s and children’s clothing to retailers and boutiques. Its product range includes fashion-forward garments sourced internationally for the U.S. wholesale market. Annabelle conducts import activities and maintains its operations in the Los Angeles Fashion District.

YK Bargain operates as a wholesale apparel and fashion goods retailer in Los Angeles, California. It primarily serves the apparel and piece goods sector, offering discounted clothing and related merchandise to retailers and resellers. The company focuses on providing cost-effective solutions for fashion inventory sourcing. Its operations are centered in the Los Angeles Fashion District, a major hub for wholesale garment trade.

Azura is a wholesale apparel company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The business specializes in distributing fashion-forward clothing and accessories to retailers and boutiques. Founded in 2014, Azura has positioned itself within the garment district, serving as a supplier for contemporary and seasonal collections. The company operates primarily through online wholesale platforms and maintains a physical showroom in Los Angeles to support its retail partners. Azura’s focus on trend-driven merchandise has enabled it to cater to a diverse clientele in the fashion industry.

Must Have is a wholesale apparel company based in Los Angeles, California. Established in 2010, the business specializes in women’s ready-to-wear clothing and accessories, serving retailers and boutiques primarily through the Los Angeles Fashion District. The company operates from its showroom at 800 E 12th Street and focuses on providing trend-driven styles for the wholesale market.
Blue Leopard is a plus size wholesale store located on Downtown Los Angeles Fashion District. They have many varieties of clothing, such as dresses, tops, pants, shorts, and skirts.

SHIR Capital is a vertically integrated real estate investment group with a niche focus on Multifamily real estate. SHIR has done business in the Texas, Colorado, South Carolina and Pennsylvania markets, and seeks to expand throughout the United States. SHIR Capital and its related entities, Ava’s Construction and Nexus Signature Communities, collaborate with real estate investors to evaluate, acquire, reposition, manage, and create an exit strategy for each property based on its highest value and best use. SHIR Capital has a track record of repositioning its acquisitions to secure steady cash flow while maximizing upside potential for disposition.

American Landmark was founded in 2016 following the sale of Landmark Apartment Trust, building on a long operating history in multifamily real estate. The company owns and operates apartment communities across the Sun Belt and focuses on acquisition, repositioning, and professional property management. American Landmark emphasizes resident services, investor returns, and team development as part of its business model. The company maintains a broad portfolio and a market presence that spans several states, with the business centered on multifamily housing rather than a single local market.

Southwest Funding is a privately held mortgage banking firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company originates residential mortgage loans through retail branches, wholesale lending, and correspondent channels. Its portfolio includes FHA, VA, USDA, Conventional, Jumbo, and Non-QM loan products, as well as refinancing options. Southwest Funding transitioned from a brokerage to a full-service mortgage banker in 2012, enabling in-house underwriting, closing, and funding.

Bozzuto Management Company is the property management arm of the Bozzuto Group, focused on multifamily and luxury apartment communities nationwide. Founded in 1988 by Tom Bozzuto and partners, the broader Bozzuto business grew into a real estate platform with property management, construction, development, and homebuilding operations. The company supports apartment communities through resident services, client services, and strategic property operations, while maintaining a significant presence along the East Coast and in select Midwestern markets.

Sungold Studio began as a Los Angeles-based photography and motion studio focused on creating rentable spaces for shoots and related creative work. The company’s official site describes studio lofts with natural light, vintage furnishings, and flexible setups, and it also presents booking options and products tied to photography and motion production. Sungold Studio’s services center on studio rentals and support for visual projects, while its online materials show a business built around photographers, brands, and content creators seeking usable production space.

Jonathan A. Logan began in 1978 as a luxury leather brand in Los Angeles and has since expanded beyond leather into custom-made, made-to-measure clothing. The company designs and produces apparel for men and women, with work that includes garments in wool, denim, cotton, and accessories. Jonathan A. Logan also serves film, television, and stage production needs, while continuing to offer public custom clothing requests and made-in-USA craftsmanship.

Greystar was founded in 1993 by Founder, Chairman, and CEO Bob Faith. Greystar is the global leader in rental housing with expertise in real estate sectors across multiple geographies. The company's business model is unique in its ability to own, operate, and develop collegiate, multifamily, corporate, and senior housing across the globe. Greystar continues to expand its geographic reach around the world, bringing a globally interconnected professional rental housing platform and industry funded with institutional capital to countries where the sector does not yet exist. With offices in more than 60 cities serving more than 200 markets globally, and more than 740,000 units and student beds under management, Greystar currently ranks first among the Top 50 US Apartment Managers according to the 2021 National Multifamily Housing Council. Greystar manages $41.3 billion in assets and oversees a global portfolio of more than 165,900 owned units across multiple strategies and geographies.

Cirrus Asset Management is a privately held real estate management firm founded in 2007. The company specializes in multifamily property management and advisory services, overseeing a portfolio that includes more than 22,000 apartment homes across multiple states. Its operations encompass property management, consulting, and financing solutions, with additional expertise in construction management for client projects. Cirrus emphasizes a process-driven approach, integrating technology and operational strategies to enhance property performance. The firm is licensed by the California Department of Real Estate and has facilitated transactions involving billions in real estate assets. Headquartered in Woodland Hills, California, Cirrus continues to expand its presence in the multifamily sector through strategic partnerships and a focus on operational excellence.

Walden Investments, LLC is a privately held real estate investment and management company based in West Los Angeles. Founded in 1998, the firm focuses on the ownership, operation, and management of multifamily and mixed-use residential properties, primarily in West LA, Culver City, Marina del Rey, and surrounding neighborhoods.
Operating under the Walden Realty / Walden Investments name, the company manages day-to-day leasing, tenant relations, and property operations for its portfolio. Walden Investments is manager-led and closely held, with a long-term ownership approach rather than institutional asset turnover.

Terra Coffee operates as a coffee kiosk located within the lobby of 1415 Louisiana Street in downtown Houston, Texas. Designed as an amenity for tenants and visitors of the building, the kiosk provides a selection of coffee, tea, and light food options. The concept was developed to enhance the building’s communal spaces and create a convenient refreshment point for office occupants and passersby. The design of Terra Coffee was executed by Abel Design Group, which integrated materials and lighting elements consistent with the building’s renovated lobby to maintain a cohesive aesthetic. The kiosk is part of a broader repositioning effort for the property, formerly known as Wedge Tower, aimed at improving its competitiveness in the downtown office market. Terra Coffee reflects a trend toward incorporating hospitality-style amenities in commercial office environments to support tenant engagement and convenience. Hines is a global real estate firm founded in 1957 that invests in, develops, and manages real assets. The company works across investment management, development, and real estate services, with offerings that include asset management, property management, engineering, and private wealth solutions. Its portfolio spans a broad mix of property types, including residential, logistics, retail, office, and mixed-use assets, reflecting a business built around long-term stewardship and value creation.

Kamel & Associates is a full-service defense law firm that focuses on legal representation for health care providers, dental and medical practices, nonprofit organizations, and companies facing civil disputes. The firm's practice areas include medical and dental malpractice, board licensure defense, premises liability, labor and employment law, and homeowners association matters. Brian P. Kamel & Associates has built its work around defending health care facilities and related professionals, with a practice history that spans more than two decades. Brian Patrick Kamel is associated with the firm and specializes in medical malpractice and health care law, reinforcing the firm's long-standing concentration in those verticals.

RPM is an Austin, Texas-based multifamily property owner-operator, investment, and development firm active across the United States. Founded in 2002 as Roscoe Property Management by Jason Berkowitz, the company began with just 10 units under management. Through both organic growth and strategic mergers, RPM Living has evolved into one of the nation's largest multifamily operators. 

The firm manages 226,169 units across 26 states. RPM operates through a vertically integrated platform encompassing property management, investment acquisitions, and development. The company maintains 12 regional offices. In 2021, RPM merged with Atlanta-based CF Real Estate Services, expanding its footprint across the Southeast and Midwest. This transaction added approximately 26,000 units to the portfolio. The merger with CF Real Estate Services brought together leadership from both organizations under the RPM brand. 

RPM's assets total a portfolio valued at $3 billion. The company's operations span conventional multifamily, student housing, senior living, and affordable housing sectors. In 2023, RPM Living experienced its largest year of growth, adding 75,000 units to its portfolio and achieving the second-largest portfolio increase among the Top 50 apartment managers.

Condon & Forsyth LLP began in 1935 as an aviation law firm in New York City. The company has developed expertise in aviation accident litigation and regulatory compliance. Over time, they expanded their practice areas to include product liability, insurance coverage disputes, and complex commercial litigation. They serve a diverse clientele across various industries including transportation and manufacturing. The firm maintains multiple offices across the United States while handling international cases.

Westside Habitates, a multifamily residential property management company, was established in 2005. The firm is a subsidiary of Xenon Investment Corporation, providing management to the parent organization's real estate portfolio. Westside Habitats manages properties in desirable neighborhoods of Los Angeles, California, including Santa Monica, Brentwood, Westwood, and West Hollywood.

TAM Residential, formerly Topaz Asset Management, provides property management services to the multifamily investment community and supports ownership through consulting, due diligence, acquisition and disposition support, repositioning, staffing, training, marketing, and financial analysis. The company traces its current brand to a rebrand announced after operating under the Topaz Asset Management name and now focuses on apartment rental housing across a multi-state portfolio with a mix of affordable, workforce, luxury, senior, and mixed-use communities. TAM Residential operates an ownership-minded model built around operational excellence, customer service, and property-level value creation in multifamily housing.

Geosyntec was founded in 1983 and has grown into a consulting and engineering firm serving private and public sector clients on environmental, natural resource, energy, and civil infrastructure challenges. The company works across verticals that include contaminated site assessment and cleanup, water and wastewater services, coastal and waterfront engineering, dams and levees, energy transition, solid waste, and civil infrastructure planning and design. Geosyntec also supports clients in manufacturing, government, mining, and other sectors through multidisciplinary scientific, engineering, and technical services. The business operates with a broad geographic presence and a staff of engineers, scientists, and related technical professionals supporting projects in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Australia.

Ascension is a vertically integrated investment and management firm that specializes in realizing the operational and economic potential of multifamily assets through proven value-add strategies and hands-on management. Founded in 2008, Ascension has acquired or developed more than 8,000 units across Texas and has experience managing multifamily assets through all stages of the real estate cycle.

In February 2000 John and Evelyn Redden formed Devonshire Real Estate and Asset Management. The company was born through the dissolution of Hartex Property Group, a Dallas based multi-family acquisition and management company, in which Mr. Redden was the President. Devonshire brought together the key employees from Hartex Property Group in the knowledge that their proven performance would be invaluable to the success of Devonshire.

Loncar Lyon Jenkins is a Texas-based personal injury law firm founded in 1988 by attorney Brian Loncar. Headquartered in Dallas, the firm operates multiple offices across the state, including Houston, El Paso, Lubbock, McAllen, Odessa, Tyler, and Wichita Falls. It focuses on representing individuals in cases involving car accidents, truck accidents, wrongful death, and other personal injury matters. The firm is privately held and currently owned by Clay Jenkins and Ted Lyon. Over the years, Loncar Lyon Jenkins has built a reputation for handling complex litigation and providing statewide coverage while maintaining personalized legal services.

ROM Commercial Properties is a leading commercial real estate firm based in Houston, Texas. They specialize in providing their clients with comprehensive real estate services, including project leasing, tenant representation, development, and investment sales.

Their mission is simple, to help their clients achieve their real estate goals by providing them with the highest level of service, expertise, and professionalism.

They have a deep understanding of the Houston real estate market and have built strong relationships with landlords, tenants, and investors in the area. This enables clients to access a wide range of properties and investment opportunities from value-add assets to core products that is not available to the general public. ROM Commercial properties can assist in all facets of real estate from redeveloping to repositioning, they offer all services to meet their valued client’s needs.

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech-enabled, pediatrician-led medical group delivering 24/7 virtual and in-home care to children with complex and chronic medical conditions. Founded in 2022, the company operates under a value-based care model designed to supplement, not replace, a child’s existing care team. Its multidisciplinary approach integrates pediatricians, nurses, behavioral health specialists, social workers, pharmacists, and care coordinators to provide continuous medical, behavioral, and social support.
The organization partners with Medicaid managed care organizations and commercial health plans to reduce avoidable hospitalizations and emergency department utilization while improving care coordination and caregiver support. Imagine Pediatrics expanded its geographic footprint rapidly following venture capital funding and now serves families across multiple U.S. states. In 2025, the company completed a Series B financing round to support further clinical expansion, technology development, and market growth. Imagine Pediatrics is privately held and does not trade under a public ticker symbol.

Midway is a privately held, Houston-based real estate investment, development, and leasing firm founded in 1968. The company operates as a fully integrated platform, providing investment management, development, construction oversight, and leasing services across a broad range of asset types, including mixed-use, office, retail, multifamily, hospitality, industrial, and master-planned communities. Midway specializes in transformational real estate projects with an emphasis on mixed-use developments featuring office, retail, hospitality, and residential components. The firm's notable developments include CITYCENTRE, a 2 million-square-foot walkable urban development in Memorial City; East River, a 150-acre tract on Houston's east waterfront near downtown; Watermark, the redevelopment of the old ConocoPhillips campus in the Energy Corridor; and Levy Park adjacent to the Kirby Grove tower on Richmond Avenue.

Midway’s portfolio includes approximately 45 million square feet of completed or active projects located primarily throughout Texas, as well as other U.S. markets and Northern Mexico. Headquartered in Uptown Houston, the firm focuses on long-term ownership and value creation through both ground-up development and the repositioning of existing assets.

In May 2023, Midway partnered with Orlando-based Parkway Property Investments to form Parkway Ventures, a joint venture with 45 million square feet of assets under management and 300 employees. However, in December 2024, the partnership dissolved, with Midway selling its interest back to Parkway and bringing property operations back in-house. The company now focuses exclusively on development and acquisitions as a separate entity.

CVS Pharmacy began in 1963 as Consumer Value Stores, a health and beauty retailer that later adopted the CVS name, and pharmacy services were added in Rhode Island in the 1960s. The company now operates as part of CVS Health's pharmacy business, with services that include prescription dispensing, vaccinations, counseling, prescription delivery, mail-order pharmacy, and specialty pharmacy. CVS Pharmacy also serves as a neighborhood retail brand with a broad U.S. presence and a business mix that combines pharmacy care with consumer health and convenience merchandise.

Solaris Energy Infrastructure, formerly Solaris Oilfield Infrastructure, was founded in 2014 to provide oilfield products, services, and infrastructure for drilling and completion activity in North American shale plays. The company now delivers proprietary power generation and distribution solutions, along with logistics equipment and services, to customers in the data center, energy, commercial, and industrial sectors. Solaris Energy Infrastructure also offers turnkey systems that combine rapidly deployable power infrastructure with automated equipment and field services for wellsite logistics, and its business is organized around power solutions and logistics solutions.

The company now operates as a restaurant chain and franchise system centered on carryout and delivery service. Marco's Pizza offers pizzas, specialty pizzas, subs, salads, wings, desserts, beverages, and catering for everyday meals and group orders. The company positions itself as a national pizza brand built around fresh-made food and a menu that extends beyond pizza.

Sixth Street is a private global investment firm founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Co-founding partner and CEO Alan Waxman and a group of former Goldman Sachs colleagues launched the firm in a strategic partnership with TPG, and the two firms formally separated in May 2020. Sixth Street is not publicly traded. An affiliate advises Sixth Street Specialty Lending, which trades on the NYSE under the ticker TSLX. The firm reports over $140 billion in assets under management and committed capital and more than 750 team members, including approximately 300 investment professionals.

Sixth Street runs multiple platforms covering growth investing, direct lending, insurance, asset-based finance, infrastructure, sports and live entertainment, public markets and real estate. Its real estate group has invested over $8 billion since 2009. Individual investments range from $50 million to more than $1 billion and take the form of asset-level and platform-level equity, joint ventures, preferred equity and debt. Asset classes of interest include residential, hospitality, office, industrial, retail, data centers and healthcare.

Recent U.S. activity centers on hospitality. Since April 2025 the firm has acquired four hotels totaling 1,290 keys in Dallas, San Francisco, Beaver Creek and Key West.

Preylock is an owner, operator and developer of high technology R&D and HQ office, industrial and multi-family real estate strategically located throughout the US. They utilize a relative value approach to real estate investing, identifying unique investment opportunities in highly targeted, supply constrained markets. Generally, they seek to acquire assets that trade at a discount to replacement cost and/or comparable assets in neighboring sub-markets. 

Preylock’s portfolio consists of over 17 million square feet of office and industrial assets totaling more than $4 billon of assets under management. Since its founding in 2016, Preylock has grown and diversified its investor base to include sovereign wealth funds, international banking institutions, US publicly traded insurance companies, and ultra high net worth families.

They at Prospera Law are committed to enabling deals and solving problems. They were founded in 2010 by lawyers, all of whom previously practiced at large international law firms, with the mission to deliver top quality sophisticated service in a highly personal boutique setting. They tackle difficult deals and issues on behalf of their clients and pride themselves in achieving results. They close finance and M&A transactions for both public and private company clients.

Their clients include the most active venture capital firm in Southern California, one of the largest utilities in the United States, and some of the largest companies in the world. Their lawyers with foreign language skills have completed cross-border transactions including those that have never been done before. In short, they are a boutique law firm with a top-notch practice.

Pearlman and Tishbi, LLP represents many different types of people and businesses. In 1996, Apolis founders Rita and Amar Shokeen created RJT Compuquest, a small IT consultancy devoted to matching talented IT engineers with companies in need. Over the years, RJT grew and branched into RJT Compuquest, RJT Solution Beacon, and RJT Compusolutions to meet the evolving technology needs of SMB and enterprise-level organizations.

In 2018, RJT came together to form Apolis, a 360° IT consultancy. For their clients, they provide a full spectrum of managed services and IT staffing solutions, along with investments in leading-edge technologies. For their global IT talent, they provide specialized training and full-service support. At Apolis, they partner with the brightest hearts and minds of today to face the challenges of tomorrow.

Target Corporation began in 1902 as the Dayton Company and later launched Target stores in the 1960s; Dayton Hudson Corporation adopted the Target Corporation name in 2000. The company operates a broad retail business centered on discount general merchandise, everyday essentials, apparel, beauty, home goods, food and beverages, plus digital shopping, fulfillment, and loyalty services. Target serves guests through stores and digital channels across the United States, with a business model built around curated assortment, value, and integrated shopping experiences.

Asset Living is a third-party property management firm founded in 1986 that serves multifamily, student, and affordable housing communities across the United States. Asset Living operates as a broad real estate management platform that supports owners and institutional partners through property management, asset management, receivership, and investment services. The company maintains a national operating footprint built around residential real estate management and related support functions.

Founded in 2021, Dunmor is a privately held financial services company focused on providing business-purpose financing to residential and multifamily real estate investors across the United States. The company operates as a direct lender, offering loan products that support property acquisition, renovation, construction, refinancing, and rental stabilization. JRK's core business focus is the acquisition, ownership, and operation of multifamily apartment communities, supplemented by a hotel division and a smaller commercial holdings segment. The firm pursues value-add and core-plus investment strategies. It operates two primary vehicles: its $1 billion Platform 5 Fund, which targets apartment assets built after 1990, and its MF Opportunities III fund, which targets vintage properties built in or before 1989. The company's asset classes of interest span multifamily (its primary focus), hospitality/hotels, and commercial properties including office complexes, storage facilities, and industrial parks.

In 2025, JRK ranked as the 50th largest apartment owner in the United States per the National Multi Housing Council, with 26,938 units. The company's residential portfolio spans 28 states, giving it a nationally diversified footprint that reduces exposure to any single market. Its 2025 acquisitions concentrated in gateway metros including Los Angeles, Seattle, Washington D.C., and Hoboken. Top markets by recent deployment include Southern California (Los Angeles), the Pacific Northwest (Seattle), and Washington D.C. Because its multifamily cash flows are distributed across tens of thousands of individual residential leases, the company carries limited single-tenant concentration exposure.

WinnCompanies is a privately held, family-founded national real estate development and property management firm. WinnCompanies was founded in 1971 when Arthur Winn recognized the opportunity to develop high-quality affordable housing that would be exceptionally well-managed, beginning work on a 250-unit affordable housing community in Salem, MA, which remains part of its portfolio to this day. The company operates through three affiliates: WinnDevelopment (property development), WinnResidential (property management), and WinnResidential Military Housing Services (privatized military housing). As a privately held company, WinnCompanies has no ticker symbol.

The firm's core business focus is residential housing. WinnCompanies acquires, develops, and manages affordable, senior, mixed-income, market rate, military, and mixed-use properties. Its development strategy emphasizes affordable housing, historic rehabilitation, and adaptive reuse. Since the company's inception more than 50 years ago, WinnDevelopment has earned a national reputation for real estate development, acquiring and developing holdings across the U.S.

Geographically, its holdings are concentrated in the Northeast, with a heavy footprint in Massachusetts, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, plus expanding activity in the Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, and West. Winn operates across 30 states, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico. The company's largest single tenant relationship is with the U.S. military. At Westwood Minds, they strive to treat the whole patient — not just their symptoms. Their Los Angeles clinic offers transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), a safe, effective, non-invasive treatment for clinical depression and anxiety. 
Transcranial magnetic stimulation therapy uses short pulses of magnetic fields to stimulate nerve cells in the area of the brain thought to control mood. It is sometimes referred to as rTMS which stands for repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation. TMS patients receiving TMS Therapy remain awake and alert during the treatment.
NeuroStar Advanced Therapy TMS is an outpatient procedure available to Los Angeles and the surrounding communities. The typical depression treatment course consists of at least 5 depression treatments per week over a 4-6 week period for 20-30 depression treatments. Each depression treatment session lasts approximately 19-37 minutes, depending on what the doctor determines is the correct protocol.

The firm emphasizes accessibility through online case tracking and direct attorney contact.

Posivak & Joffe LLP is a California-based tax practice established by Todd I. Posivak, a CPA and IRS-registered tax preparer. The firm provides tax preparation, planning, and accounting services to individuals and small businesses. Originally founded as a tax consultancy, it expanded into bookkeeping and business advisory services. Posivak serves as both a tax expert and registered agent for multiple companies. The company maintains a presence in the Los Angeles area and focuses on delivering comprehensive financial solutions to local clients.

The Law Office of Hedy Golshani, APC is a Los Angeles–based law firm specializing in workers’ compensation defense on behalf of employers and insurance companies. Founded by Hedy (Hediyeh) Golshani, the firm focuses on the efficient and cost-effective resolution of workers’ compensation claims through expedited handling, structured settlements, and proactive case management. The practice emphasizes regulatory expertise, technology-driven workflows, and employer education to reduce claim frequency and overall workers’ compensation costs.

Netshares Financial Services is a U.S.-based broker-dealer registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and a member of FINRA and SIPC. The company provides investment banking and corporate advisory services, including capital formation, mergers and acquisitions, leveraged finance, and equity financing solutions. Netshares operates as a funding portal under Regulation Crowdfunding and focuses on connecting private companies with investors through a digital platform. The firm is privately held and serves small to medium-sized businesses and emerging growth companies across multiple industries.

Elevated Med Solutions is a personal injury medical clinic in Houston that focuses on care for patients recovering after auto accidents and traumatic injuries. The company operates with an integrated, multidisciplinary model that includes neurology, chiropractic care, pain management, and physical rehabilitation, along with diagnostic testing and legal documentation support for accident-related cases. Elevated Med Solutions was formerly known as Westside Physicians, and the rebrand kept the same injury-care focus while presenting the business under a new name. The company also serves attorney referral relationships as part of its accident-injury care model.

Leaders in gastroenterology care, GI Specialists of Houston, LLP, has multiple office locations, which includes multiple areas surrounding the Houston area. The team of gastroenterologists uses the most advanced diagnostic tools and treatment options to help their patients get the answers and care they need.

The team specializes in diagnosing and treating many gastrointestinal symptoms and conditions, including abdominal pain, constipation, bloating, colorectal cancer, hemorrhoids, and gastritis. The practice also provides ongoing treatment and management of chronic conditions such as inflammatory bowel disease, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Melland Consulting was established in 2016 in Houston, Texas. The company specializes in process engineering and project management for the energy industry. Services include operation evaluations, design work, and project execution for midstream and production companies. Melland Consulting also provides technical solutions for engineering firms and fabrication shops. The company serves various sectors including oil and gas, chemicals, and manufacturing, focusing on delivering process optimization and safety solutions through engineering expertise.

Digital Fusion began in 1999 as a digital photography alternative to chemical processing. The company provides high-end digital capture and retouching services. They serve professional photographers needing studio rentals and post-production support. Over time they expanded into cloud solutions for photo management. The company remains focused on digital imaging technology for commercial photography clients.

aliases: Joint Rehabilitation & Sports Medical Center Inc

profile.locationBio: Joint Rehab and Sports Medical Center is a regenerative medicine clinic focused on non-surgical care for joint, tendon, ligament, back, neck, and sports-related conditions. The company offers treatments such as platelet-rich plasma, stem cell therapy, prolotherapy, and other image-guided regenerative procedures for musculoskeletal disorders. Its service mix also includes care for chronic pain and related orthopedic concerns, with patient information and condition-specific guidance available to patients.
