profile.locationBio: AmTrust Financial Services is a privately held multinational insurance company headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1998, the company began as a niche warranty insurer and has grown into a major provider of property and casualty insurance solutions for small and mid-sized businesses. AmTrust operates through three primary segments: Small Commercial Business Insurance, Specialty Risk and Extended Warranty, and Specialty Program Insurance. The firm offers products such as workers’ compensation, general liability, business owners policies, and cyber liability coverage. In 2018, AmTrust completed a go-private transaction through Evergreen Parent, L.P., backed by Stone Point Capital and the Karfunkel-Zyskind family.

Cullen Jewellery began in 2018 after Jordan Cullen's search for an engagement ring led to a business built around clearer information and more considered choices in bridal jewellery. Cullen Jewellery creates lab-grown diamond, lab-grown sapphire, and moissanite pieces, with a focus on engagement rings, wedding bands, and fine jewellery. The company combines online ordering with showrooms and personalised virtual appointments, and operates as a global premium-jewellery brand. Cullen Jewellery also emphasizes ethically sourced materials, custom design, and pieces intended for long-term wear across milestone occasions.

Mutual of Omaha is a privately held mutual insurance and financial services organization founded in 1909 and headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. The company provides life insurance, Medicare supplement insurance, long-term care insurance, annuities, retirement planning, and investment solutions to individuals, families, and businesses across the United States. As a policyholder-owned company, Mutual of Omaha focuses on long-term financial security, customer service, and helping clients achieve their financial goals.

OroCommerce began in 2012 when Yoav Kutner, Jary Carter, and Dima Soroka created an open-source B2B platform. The founders previously worked at Magento and saw a need for specialized B2B solutions. OroCommerce serves various industries including manufacturing, distribution, and wholesale sectors. The platform offers CRM integration, advanced workflows, and customization options. It focuses on complex B2B transactions and scalability for growing businesses.

Premier Directional Drilling, L.P. is a Houston-based oilfield services company specializing in directional drilling solutions for land-based and offshore projects. Founded in 2012, the company provides directional planning, drilling, downhole performance motors, rotary steerable systems, and measurement-while-drilling (MWD) services. Premier operates across major North American shale plays and supports extended-reach horizontal drilling through advanced electromagnetic and pulse telemetry technologies. In October 2017, Premier was acquired by Tally Energy Services, a private equity-backed firm focused on oilfield technology and services. The company is classified under support activities for oil and gas operations and continues to serve exploration and production companies with precision drilling solutions.

Rivera Law Group was founded by Gabriel Rivera after experience at several Texas law firms, and the firm grew from a background in personal injury litigation. Rivera Law Group focuses on personal injury matters, including serious injury and wrongful death cases, and also handles immigration law and family law. The firm represents clients in disputes arising from motor vehicle accidents, workplace injuries, premises liability, and other negligence claims, while also guiding clients through deportation, removal, and family-based immigration matters. Rivera Law Group maintains a bilingual presence and serves clients across Texas and nearby markets through consultations and case support.

80:20 were formed in 2004 with the aim of adding real value to a previously neglected area of the Supply Chain through novel procurement product offerings. 

Having previously held senior procurement positions and developed procurement strategies for a number of organisations across a range of industries Paul Dorward and Tony Bannon the company founders recognised that the tail of the supply chain was not being managed effectively.

Sri Balaji Development is a privately held company based in Houston, Texas, specializing in design, construction, and remodeling solutions for both residential and commercial projects. The company offers services ranging from interior renovations and space planning to full-scale building development. Known for its customized approach, Sri Balaji Development integrates design concepts with construction management to deliver tailored solutions. The firm was founded in 2023 and operates primarily within the Texas market. It employs fewer than 25 people and focuses on projects such as kitchen and bathroom renovations, office redesigns, and branding-related construction. The company emphasizes quality materials and innovative techniques to meet client objectives.

Texas Lutheran University is a private institution located in Seguin, Texas, affiliated with the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America. Founded in 1891 in Brenham, Texas, the university relocated to Seguin in 1912 and adopted its current name in 1996. It offers undergraduate and graduate programs across liberal arts, sciences, and professional fields, including nursing, business, and education. The campus spans approximately 184 acres and serves a student body of around 1,400. Texas Lutheran University is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges and maintains additional program-specific accreditations.

Seal Building Enclosure provides consulting and engineering services focused on building enclosure systems for both new construction and existing structures. The company offers services such as enclosure commissioning, performance testing, diagnostics, and drone-based inspections. Founded in 2021, Seal operates as a privately held firm and is certified as a Woman-Owned and Minority-Owned Business. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with an additional office in Austin, the company serves projects across the United States. Seal is also a licensed engineering firm in Texas and emphasizes compliance with standards such as LEED v4.1, ASHRAE, and ASTM guidelines.

Altman Solon is a strategy consulting firm focused on telecommunications, media, and technology, with services that include strategy, go-to-market, M&A and private equity, operations and transformation, and network planning. The company was formed in 2020 through the combination of Altman Vilandrie & Company and Solon Management Consulting, creating a firm centered on TMT advisory work. Altman Solon advises operators, investors, and technology-focused businesses on growth, performance, investment decisions, and sector-specific transformation across the broader TMT market.

Tarantino Properties began in 1980 as a Texas-based real estate firm. The company provides services across multiple sectors including commercial, multifamily, and senior living properties. Their offerings encompass property management, brokerage, leasing, and construction oversight. Over the years, they've developed a national presence while maintaining regional expertise. Tarantino serves both institutional and private clients through customized real estate solutions.

Dream Live Prosper Communities is a property management division of DLP Capital, founded in 2006 by Don Wenner in the Lehigh Valley of Pennsylvania as a residential real estate firm. The company manages multifamily, single-family, and commercial properties across the United States, operating as an affiliate of DLP Capital, a private real estate investment firm. Based in St. Augustine, Florida, Dream Live Prosper Communities manages nearly 30 properties totaling over 9,900 units, representing approximately $5.3 billion in assets under management as of June 2025. The company focuses on providing rental housing communities for working families. As part of DLP Capital's broader platform, the organization participates in financing, developing, and operating attainable housing solutions, including multifamily apartments, single-family rentals, and related community investments.

Millennium Management began in 1989 as an alternative investment firm founded by Israel Englander, and the business has grown into a global platform for managing capital across public markets. The company operates a multistrategy hedge fund model that supports independent investment teams and spans verticals such as equities, fixed income, commodities, foreign exchange, and derivatives. Millennium also combines investment activity with technology and core infrastructure functions, using a risk-managed platform built to pursue returns for investors across a wide international network.

Westwood Village Synagogue is a Modern Orthodox congregation with roots in a small minyan started by three families near the UCLA campus, and the community was once known as the "Village Shul." The congregation emphasizes hospitality, a welcoming atmosphere, and a strong interest in Judaic study, while presenting itself as an open, warm, and friendly community. Its offerings include Shabbat services, weekday and Shabbat learning, membership activities, donations, and kosher resources for observant ??????.

Anh's Tailor & Alterations has served the Houston community for over thirty years. The company specializes in clothing alterations and tailoring for all garment types, including wedding gown adjustments, suit tailoring, and repairs for various apparel. Anh's Tailor & Alterations offers same-day service and works with diverse fabrics and materials. The business has built a reputation for quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction.

CMI Brokerage is a commercial real estate firm that provides brokerage, leasing, property management, development, facility management, consulting, property rehabilitation, and construction coordination services. CMI Brokerage was founded in 1978 by Houston real estate professional Vic Vacek and has built its business around commercial property owners, investors, buyers, and sellers. The company focuses on office, retail, industrial, land, and multifamily properties, with work spanning commercial sales, land disposition, tenant representation, and asset management across the Houston and Dallas markets.

FilipinianaToo HTX is a Filipino buffet-style restaurant in Houston, Texas, offering an authentic taste of the Philippines. Known for its wide selection of traditional dishes, the restaurant provides a warm, family-friendly atmosphere where guests can enjoy classic favorites like adobo, pancit, and lechon. With a focus on quality, flavor, and cultural heritage, FilipinianaToo HTX has become a go-to destination for those craving genuine Filipino cuisine in the heart of Texas.

One Wall Partners drives value for their investors and communities through in-depth analysis and research, sound acquisition strategy, innovative asset management and hands-on property management.

Founded in 2010, OneWall Partners® is a vertically integrated real estate firm that focuses on transit and lifestyle-oriented workforce housing in the northeast US. We locate regional offices at or within close proximity to all of our assets and are uniquely positioned to fully leverage our in-house property management group, OneWall Management®, to control 100% of our value chain while simultaneously realizing significant operational efficiencies.

Eurenco Additives, Inc. operates as part of the Eurenco Group, a European leader in energetic materials. The company specializes in fuel additives, notably 2-ethylhexyl nitrate (2-EHN), which improves diesel fuel performance. Established in 2011, Eurenco Additives serves strategic sectors including oil and gas, defense, and industrial applications. The firm functions as the U.S. distribution arm for Eurenco’s fuel additive products and maintains its headquarters in Houston, Texas.

Athene began operations in 2009 during the financial crisis when market demand created opportunities for well-capitalized firms in the retirement sector. The company specializes in retirement services, offering fixed and indexed annuities designed to help clients build retirement income. Athene serves both retail customers and institutional partners through various distribution channels, including direct sales and reinsurance agreements. Over the years, the business has expanded its product offerings and market presence while maintaining a focus on retirement savings solutions. The company operates as a major player in the retirement annuity market with a substantial portfolio of retirement assets under management.

Legacy Community Development Corp is a nonprofit organization founded in 2006 to address housing stability and financial education needs in Southeast Texas. Headquartered in Port Arthur, the organization operates as a HUD-approved Housing Counseling Agency serving Hardin, Jefferson, and Orange counties. Legacy CDC provides programs such as homebuyer education, down payment assistance, disaster recovery, and tenant-based rental assistance. It also engages in community revitalization projects and property rehabilitation to expand affordable housing options. Certified as a Community Housing Development Organization since 2009, Legacy CDC collaborates with local governments to promote homeownership and financial literacy. The organization is privately held and continues to focus on creating stable, self-sufficient families through housing and supportive services.

Maldonado Legal is a Houston-based law firm specializing in U.S. immigration law. Founded by attorney Cynthia Maldonado, the firm focuses on guiding clients through complex immigration processes, including visa applications, residency, and citizenship matters. Built on principles of empathy and integrity, Maldonado Legal emphasizes personalized legal strategies for individuals and families navigating federal immigration systems. Maldonado Legal’s approach centers on transparency and structured decision-making, aiming to simplify legal challenges for clients.

aliases: Sandler Training Houston, Impassioned Sales Solutions, LLC

profile.locationBio: Founded in 1967 by David Sandler, the company began with a sales training system built around a more respectful, consultative approach to selling. Sandler provides sales training, leadership development, business coaching, certification programs, and online learning for individuals and organizations. The firm serves a wide range of industries and supports a network of training centers across North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. Sandler's programs center on the Sandler Selling System and related methodology for sales performance and management development.

name: Sandler

profile.locationBio: Clay Consulting provides medical disability exams, separation health assessments, and Reserve Health Readiness Program evaluations for veterans and other service members through a network of licensed, board-certified professionals. The company offers occupational and behavioral health examinations, including general medical, audiology, labs, EKG, pulmonary function testing, ABI, x-ray, and echo support. The firm is a healthcare services provider focused on federal and veteran-related evaluation work, combining clinical examinations with compliance-oriented portals and equipment to support contracting programs and timely delivery.

Wells Fargo Advisors traces its modern brand to a rebranding from Wachovia Securities after Wells Fargo acquired Wachovia, and the current brand dates to 2009. The company provides financial advisory services, brokerage services, investment products, retirement planning, estate planning guidance, and online trading. As part of Wells Fargo & Company, the business serves investors nationwide and combines advisory support with access to banking, lending, and trust services through affiliated businesses. The firm publishes market commentary and educational content for clients.

Jackson Vaughn Ltd Co, trading as Society by Jackson Vaughn, is a privately held Dallas-based retailer specializing in handcrafted candles, home fragrances, and curated home goods. Established in 2000 and structured as a Texas Domestic LLC, the firm operates from a flagship location in the Bishop Arts District and a second boutique in Preston Center Plaza. With a small team of approximately three employees, the company emphasizes quality through a limited, carefully curated product line inspired by timeless European design.

Evidence Based Therapy Partners was founded by a team of female psychologists focused on high-fidelity evidence-based treatment for teens, adults, and couples. The company provides outpatient therapy and teletherapy, with clinical services that include cognitive behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, prolonged exposure, cognitive processing therapy, exposure and response prevention, and emotionally focused couples therapy. Evidence Based Therapy Partners also offers consultation and training for other professionals and agencies, including support for program development, curriculum development, implementation of evidence-based therapy, and therapist case consultation. The business serves patients through multiple office locations and maintains a broad practice centered on structured, data-driven care and collaborative treatment planning.

Right Place Counseling is a California counseling practice focused on mental health support for adults, teens, couples, and families. The company offers individual, couples, family, and walk-in counseling, with in-person sessions in West Los Angeles and El Segundo and online care across California. The business operates as Right Place Counseling, Inc. in California, serving clients in the Los Angeles area. The firm centers its work on therapy, consultation, and accessible intake options for people seeking support with personal, relational, and family concerns.

Trulo Capital is a direct business funding firm that provides merchant cash advance and other commercial financing products for small businesses and independent partners. The company serves restaurants, retail stores, auto repair shops, salons, day cares, and similar businesses, and offers funding tools for business lines of credit, SBA loans, term loans, cash-flow planning, and working-capital analysis. Trulo Capital operates as a business intermediary focused on small-business funding, with an emphasis on fast underwriting, direct funding, and repayment structures tied to sales performance.

neuro8connect is a Los Angeles practice focused on psychoeducational and trauma-informed assessment and support for children, adolescents, and adults. The business centers on evaluations, counseling, autism-related intervention, social communication skills, mindfulness coping strategies, and EMDR-informed work. The practice is led by Marisa Romano Perry, a Licensed Educational Psychologist with more than two decades of experience in schools and private practice, and the service mix also includes bilingual Spanish-English support and tools such as the Box of Now. The practice balances assessment results with practical strategies for home, classroom, and broader care teams.

Gotfredson & Associates is a Los Angeles-based law firm focused on business and real estate legal matters. The firm traces its origins to 1972, when E. Jay Gotfredson established his practice after completing his legal studies. Over time, the practice expanded to address a range of business and property-related issues, including litigation, transactional work, and contract disputes. The firm later incorporated additional attorneys, including Everett Gotfredson, who joined after gaining experience in the financial sector and subsequently transitioned into legal work.

GWR Management is a property management firm serving multifamily apartment communities and rental residents. The company presents apartment homes, leasing information, photos, amenities, and an online portal for payments and resident support. The business operates as a property management company in the real estate industry with a focus on the multifamily sector. The company maintains a portfolio of apartment properties with services such as maintenance, pet-friendly living, and resident tools designed for day-to-day community management.

Texas Choice Home Finance is a mortgage brokerage focused on helping first-time buyers and underserved communities access homeownership. The firm offers a range of financing options, including FHA, VA, conventional, ITIN, bank-statement, and new construction loans. Licensing and compliance details reinforce its role as a broker. The company emphasizes statewide service and outreach tailored to diverse borrower needs, including programs for immigrant and veteran buyers.

Innova Realty Group began as a Texas real estate firm serving Houston-area buyers, sellers, and renters. The company focuses on residential brokerage services, including home search, listing support, rental assistance, and guidance through the buying and selling process. Innova Realty Group also offers agent matching, home appraisal support, and market guidance across Greater Houston and nearby communities. The firm maintains multilingual service in Spanish and English and employs a broad roster of agents handling residential transactions.

Spectrum Real Estate Consultants Team is a real estate team operating under Keller Williams Realty Leading Edge and has built its business since 2015. The firm focuses on residential, commercial, and rental services, and its work includes helping buyers, sellers, and investors navigate property transactions. Spectrum Real Estate Consultants Team also handles property ownership, renovation, and management activities across its service area. The broader Keller Williams platform was founded in 1983 and remains a large real estate franchise network, which frames the team's market presence within a well-established brokerage system.

Overture 3D, based in Houston, provides high-quality 3D printing filaments and accessories designed for makers, professionals, and hobbyists. Founded in 2019, the company offers a wide range of materials including PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, and specialty filaments. Overture 3D is committed to innovation, reliability, and supporting the global 3D printing community with products that inspire creativity and precision.

Raymond Realty Group is a privately held real estate services firm headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Established in 2007, the company focuses on the management and disposition of residential and commercial bank-owned properties, as well as short sale transactions. Its services cater primarily to asset managers and lenders, providing a streamlined process for property sales and community revitalization efforts. Raymond Realty Group has been recognized for its role in supporting neighborhoods impacted by foreclosures and economic challenges. The company operates within the real estate services sector and maintains a strong presence in California.

Vertika Structural Engineers, LLC, founded in 2013 and privately held, is a Houston-based structural engineering consultancy licensed in Texas. The firm provides a wide range of services—design, retrofits, forensic analysis, seismic and blast design, peer review, and value engineering—for commercial, institutional, and industrial clients. Originating as a principals-driven practice led by Dr. P.V. Banavalkar, Vimal Parikh, and Thomas A. Bellace, Vertika leverages over 110 years of combined engineering experience.

CCS Facility Services began in 1988 as Commercial Cleaning Systems and later adopted its current brand name while expanding beyond cleaning into building engineering services. The company provides commercial janitorial, building maintenance, facility engineering, and specialty cleaning services for clients in healthcare, education, corporate campuses, commercial real estate, industrial settings, and other sectors. CCS Facility Services operates an integrated model that combines staffing, supervision, quality control, and preventive maintenance to keep facilities clean and operating smoothly. The company has grown through regional expansion and acquisitions while maintaining a broad presence across the United States.

City Wide Facility Solutions, formerly City Wide Maintenance Company, began in 1961 as a janitorial service and later expanded into a facility-solution management model. The company manages commercial cleaning, janitorial work, disinfecting, landscaping, handyman, plumbing, and other interior and exterior maintenance services through one point of contact. City Wide serves businesses across a wide range of property types, including offices, healthcare facilities, schools, logistics sites, and other commercial properties. The brand emphasizes coordinated vendor management and customized service planning for building owners, operators, and property managers.

Texas Children's is creating a healthier future for children and women across their global community through their leadership in patient care, education and research. They're proud of the daily efforts that build into cumulative medical results and discoveries accomplished by each of their institutions.  

Texas Children's Hospital, located in Houston, Texas, is recognized as one of America's best children's hospitals.

At Texas Children’s Hospital, they are aware of the health care industry’s effect on the health of the earth, which directly affects their patients and their families. Their industry contributes almost 10% of the annual greenhouse gas emissions in this country. 

They know that those emissions are harmful to children and families – the very children and families that they care for, from Texas and across the world. 

Texas Children’s mission is to create a healthier future for children and women throughout their global community.

With more than two decades of experience, Allmand Law Firm has developed into a Texas consumer bankruptcy practice serving clients across the state. The firm focuses on Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 matters and handles related issues such as creditor harassment, foreclosure, repossession, wage garnishment, tax debt, and student loan debt. Allmand Law Firm also emphasizes individualized solutions for people seeking relief from burdensome debt and a fresh financial start.

People Inc. (formerly Dotdash Meredith) is the largest digital and print publisher in America. More than 175 million people trust them each month to help them find inspiration, make decisions, and take action. People Inc.'s more than 40 iconic brands include PEOPLE, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, Allrecipes, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, and Southern Living. People Inc. is based in New York City and is an operating business of IAC (NASDAQ: IAC).

My Baby Hair is a hair care company brand that specializes in scalp-first, gender-neutral hair care products designed for diverse hair textures and generations. Its offerings include shampoos, conditioners, growth oils, and beard care under the Beards & Bourbon line. The company emphasizes natural ingredients and clean formulations free from harsh chemicals. Beyond product development, My Baby Hair integrates social impact into its mission by supporting domestic violence survivors through donations and complimentary salon services. This commitment to inclusivity and empowerment has positioned the brand as a notable player in multicultural hair care.

Wavsys is a privately held technology services company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. The firm operates through two primary divisions: Professional Services and Staff Augmentation. Its offerings include network deployment, operations and maintenance, IT support, application development, and engineering services for telecommunications and related sectors. Wavsys partners with major carriers and equipment manufacturers to design and implement multi-technology wireless networks across North America and Europe.

HPI Real Estate Services & Investments is a Texas commercial real estate firm that began in the early 1990s and focuses on leasing, tenant representation, asset and property management, development, and investment services. The company works across office, industrial, retail, and warehouse properties, serving owners, tenants, and investors through a full-service platform. HPI maintains an active market presence in Texas through recent property acquisitions and financing work tied to major office assets. The firm operates a broad commercial real estate business built around management, leasing, development, and strategic investments.

J&M Brothers is a Houston-based metal fabrication company specializing in commercial construction components. The firm provides services including fabrication and installation of non-insulated and insulated wall panels, metal roofing, commercial awnings, walkway canopies, and standing seam systems. The company focuses on delivering structural and architectural metal solutions for diverse commercial projects. J&M Brothers has built a reputation for its hands-on approach and technical expertise in metal fabrication and finishing.

Modern Home Supply specializes in providing contemporary building and design materials for residential and commercial spaces. The company offers a curated range of products, including PVC marble sheets, acoustic panels, WPC wall panels, ceramic floor tiles, and MDF thermo wall coverings. Modern Home Supply focuses on delivering durable and stylish solutions for interior and exterior applications. The company emphasizes innovative design options for homeowners, contractors, and designers.

Cecil Perry & Associates operated as a full-service dealer and installer of new, refurbished, and used office furniture. The company specialized in office design, furniture installation, delivery, and maintenance services, serving businesses in the Greater Houston area. It partnered with recognized brands such as DMI, Friant, Flexsteel, and Cherryman to provide ergonomic and executive office solutions. During its operation, the company was known for offering both new and pre-owned furniture options for offices and conference spaces.

Victoria Project Cargo is a freight-forwarding company headquartered in Houston, Texas. The firm specializes in project cargo and offers comprehensive logistics services including air and ocean transportation, customs clearance, and cargo insurance. Its operations focus on complex supply chain solutions for oversized and specialized shipments, with expertise in routes to South and Central America and CIS countries. The company provides tailored import and export services and maintains partnerships for risk and insurance coverage. Victoria Project Cargo serves diverse industries and emphasizes compliance with international shipping standards.

Staff Solve is a full-service employment agency that places skilled professionals in temporary, temp-to-hire, direct placement, and payrolling roles. The company serves employers and job seekers with recruiting, screening, interviewing, background checks, skills testing, SSA verification, and drug testing as part of its hiring process. Staff Solve also operates Staff Logistics for logistics personnel in professional, industrial, warehouse, and administrative positions, and Staff Energy Resources for personnel in the oil and gas market. The business has helped thousands of people and organizations for over 30 years.

Gaspy Hospice, Inc is a privately held healthcare organization headquartered in Houston, Texas. Established in 2020, the company provides hospice and palliative care services focused on comfort and quality of life for patients with terminal illnesses. Its offerings include pain and symptom management, emotional and spiritual support, and family counseling. Care is typically delivered in patients’ homes, assisted living facilities, or nursing homes rather than at the corporate address. Gaspy Hospice, Inc is registered as a community-based hospice provider and was Medicare-certified in October 2022 under its affiliated entity Gaspy Palliative & Hospice Care LLC.

Marco's Pizza began in Oregon, Ohio in 1978, when Pasquale Giammarco started the brand with a focus on Italian-American pizza. The company now operates as a restaurant chain and franchise system centered on carryout and delivery service. Marco's Pizza offers pizzas, specialty pizzas, subs, salads, wings, desserts, beverages, and catering for everyday meals and group orders. The company positions itself as a national pizza brand built around fresh-made food and a menu that extends beyond pizza.

Concord Wilshire began in 1992 and has focused on developing, constructing, and investing in real estate assets across major and emerging markets in the United States. The company works across residential, resort, mixed-use, office, industrial, and hospitality development, along with construction management, and it also handles acquiring, marketing, and selling real estate assets. Concord Wilshire's project history includes ground-up communities, mixed-use developments, and resort or hotel transactions, reflecting a business centered on large-scale property creation and repositioning. The firm has built its business around a broad mix of development and investment activities in the residential and commercial real estate sectors.

Johnson O'Connor Research Foundation is a nonprofit scientific research and educational organization focused on studying human abilities and helping people understand their aptitudes for career and education decisions. The organization traces its research roots to 1922, and it was incorporated as a nonprofit educational and scientific organization in 1939. Its work centers on aptitude testing, research, and score interpretation, with a service model built around helping clients identify natural potential through a battery of tests and follow-up evaluation.

profile.locationBio: Wanhua Chemical Group was founded in 1998 and has grown into a chemical company focused on innovation-driven industrial materials. The company's core business spans polyurethanes, petrochemicals, and fine chemicals, with additional activity in performance chemicals and emerging materials. Wanhua Chemical Group serves customers through product and solution offerings for applications such as coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers, construction, transportation, medical care, resources, and energy. The business operates internationally and has manufacturing sites in China and Hungary, supporting a broad industrial and customer base.

Welcome to Wellcom Realty LLC, where we take pride in being a family-owned business dedicated to providing high-quality office spaces and services to our valued clients and tenants. With over 15 years of experience serving the Texas market, our team is well-versed in the nuances of real estate in the region.
Wellcom Realty LLC was founded with a vision to create a real estate experience that prioritizes customer satisfaction, safety, and service quality. We began as a small family-owned business, and our journey has been one of continuous growth and improvement.
Our commitment to excellence has propelled us to become one of the fastest-growing management companies in the region. Today, we proudly own and manage three prime properties in the Houston area, offering approximately 260,000 square feet of premium office spaces.

TaxAidUSA started with everyday taxpayers in mind and has grown into a nationwide firm serving entrepreneurs, individuals, and tax professionals. The company provides accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation, strategic tax planning, payroll, entity formation, IRS compliance, and IRS problem resolution services. TaxAidUSA also supports business owners through advisory packages, coaching for tax professionals, and a private community designed to provide year-round guidance on taxes and business operations.

Westside Estate Management was built around Bakhrom Yakubov's background in customer service and property management, bringing more than two decades of experience into the business. The company focuses on luxury and high-end residential spaces and provides full-service property and lifestyle management designed to preserve and improve investment properties. Service lines include property care, vendor coordination, private concierge support, domestic staffing, transportation management, travel coordination, and related estate services. Westside Estate Management also handles home-automation and engineering-system oversight, along with premium transportation and private air travel arrangements for clients who need broader lifestyle support.

Montierra Minerals & Production began in 2004 as a Houston-based oil and gas company focused on royalty and mineral interests. The company built a business around ownership and operation of fee minerals, royalties, and working-interest properties in North America. In 2007, Eagle Rock Energy Partners acquired the company's assets, and Montierra was subsequently acquired or merged. The company's business centered on upstream energy and mineral holdings rather than consumer or retail operations.

Dr. John Sharp is a board-certified psychiatrist with over 35 years of clinical experience, based in Brookline, Massachusetts. He graduated from Columbia University College of Physicians and Surgeons in 1987 and completed his residency at UCSF Medical Center, where he served as Chief Resident. Dr. Sharp specializes in mood disorders, anxiety, addiction, and psychosomatic medicine, providing integrated psychotherapy and psychopharmacology. He is on faculty at Harvard Medical School and the David Geffen School of Medicine at UCLA, and has been recognized in Best Doctors in America for more than a decade. In addition to his clinical work, Dr. Sharp is an author of two books—The Emotional Calendar and The Insight Cure—and a frequent speaker on mental health topics. His practice operates as a privately held entity and offers concierge psychiatric care, including telehealth and in-office consultations.

Project One Logistics was established to meet the growing demand for project logistics services delivered by experienced professionals, with a strong focus on transporting manufactured goods via inland, cross-border, and air cargo. The company understands that every project has unique needs and carefully analyzes each one to identify its supply chain requirements and challenges.
Project One Logistics prides itself on being customer-oriented, working collaboratively with clients and vendors to provide the best logistics solutions tailored to specific requirements while staying within budget. The company was created to serve as a trusted partner in professional freight forwarding, specializing in oversized cargo transportation. Its goal is to design supply chains that align with customers’ needs and project requirements.

Daily Transcription is a privately held company specializing in transcription and translation services for a wide range of industries, including entertainment, legal, academic, and corporate sectors. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, the company has been operating for over a decade, offering services such as closed captioning, subtitling, audio description, and interpreter support. Daily Transcription emphasizes accuracy and quality by employing U.S.-based transcribers rather than outsourcing overseas or relying on automated voice recognition systems. This approach has enabled the company to maintain high standards for its deliverables across various media and business applications. Over the years, Daily Transcription has supported thousands of clients and processed millions of hours of content, establishing itself as a trusted partner for transcription and localization needs.

CVS Pharmacy began in 1963 as Consumer Value Stores, a health and beauty retailer that later adopted the CVS name, and pharmacy services were added in Rhode Island in the 1960s. The company now operates as part of CVS Health's pharmacy business, with services that include prescription dispensing, vaccinations, counseling, prescription delivery, mail-order pharmacy, and specialty pharmacy. CVS Pharmacy also serves as a neighborhood retail brand with a broad U.S. presence and a business mix that combines pharmacy care with consumer health and convenience merchandise.

Barnes & Noble began in 1971 when Leonard Riggio acquired the Barnes & Noble trade name and flagship bookstore in Manhattan, building on a much older New York bookselling tradition. The company operates as a bookseller with an online store and retail stores that offer books, eBooks, magazines, toys and games, music, movies, Blu-ray, and related services. Barnes & Noble sells NOOK digital reading products and supports content purchases, lending, and account access through its digital platform, giving the business a mix of physical retail and online media sales.

profile.locationBio: UpKeep began in the mid-2010s as a mobile-first maintenance software company focused on making work orders easier for technicians and managers. The company now builds a cloud-based CMMS and asset operations platform that brings together work orders, preventive maintenance, asset management, parts inventory, inspections, safety, and reliability workflows in one system. UpKeep serves facilities and industrial maintenance teams with software designed for phone-based reporting, collaborative task handling, and data-driven maintenance decisions. The company's market presence centers on asset-heavy organizations that need maintenance, compliance, and operational workflows connected in a single platform.

Advanced Diagnostics Healthcare System began as a physician-led medical practice and expanded into a network of hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centers in Texas. The company provides emergency care, urgent care, primary care, specialty treatment, advanced imaging, outpatient surgery, and coordinated care through a shared medical record and unified care plans. Advanced Diagnostics Healthcare System also supports physician groups through administrative services such as billing, credentialing, scheduling, supply chain, marketing, analytics, compliance, and IT support. The business continues to emphasize care guided by practicing physicians, combining medical expertise with a broad mix of inpatient, outpatient, and diagnostic services.

FIX Foreign Exchange operates as a financial services provider based in Texas, USA. The company focuses on delivering foreign exchange services and international payment solutions to corporations and financial institutions. Established as part of GroupEx Financial Corporation, they emphasize regulatory compliance through state licenses and federal registration. Their service model centers around providing secure currency exchange transactions while maintaining operational efficiency and risk management protocols. The company serves a professional client base requiring international treasury management.

247 Oil and Gas Equipment is a privately held oilfield services company based in Houston, Texas. The business was founded in 2018 and operates as a Texas domestic for-profit corporation. It focuses on providing equipment and related services used in oil and gas field operations, with activity centered on equipment supply and leasing. Public business records indicate the company supports upstream and field-level operations within the energy sector.

Refund Maxx is a tax preparation firm based in Houston, Texas. The company provides income tax planning and filing services for individuals and businesses, focusing on maximizing refund outcomes. It offers assistance with federal and state tax returns and related compliance needs. The business operates under the name Refund Maxx and serves clients through multiple service channels.

TBG Financial & Insurance Service Corp. began in 1980 and later operated under the Gilbertson Financial name, building its business around personalized financial strategies for clients. The company provides financial planning, investment advisory, brokerage, and insurance-related services, with a focus on helping clients manage retirement, distribution, rollover, and estate-planning needs. The firm is a broker-dealer connected to the broader Nationwide organization and offers insurance and investment advisory services.

Merricks Co is a heating and air conditioning contractor providing residential and commercial HVAC services. The company focuses on the installation, maintenance, and repair of air conditioning and heating systems for both homes and businesses. Its service offerings cover routine maintenance, system replacements, and repair work across residential and light commercial applications.

Fuel Exchange LLC is a Houston-based energy brokerage firm specializing in wholesale petroleum products and natural gas transactions. Established in 2012, the company operates primarily as a trading and brokerage organization, facilitating transactions in physical fuels and energy commodities for industrial, commercial, and institutional clients. Its activities are office-based and centered on market analysis, deal execution, and client relationship management rather than fuel storage or retail distribution.

Purcell International Group is a privately held executive search and recruitment firm founded in 1969. The company specializes in retained executive search services, focusing on officer, senior executive leadership, and director-level positions across multiple industries. With a global reach, Purcell International Group has successfully completed thousands of searches for clients in North America, Latin America, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. The firm emphasizes confidentiality and offers tailored solutions to meet client needs, including diversity-focused recruitment strategies. Its approach combines rigorous research, industry expertise, and a commitment to delivering high-quality candidates for critical leadership roles. Purcell International Group operates independently and maintains a strong reputation for its ability to identify and attract top-tier talent for complex and high-level positions.

Pacific Oak Capital Advisors is a Costa Mesa, California-based real estate investment management firm founded in 2018. The company is a registered investment adviser focused on sponsoring, acquiring, managing, and operating commercial real estate investments on behalf of individual and institutional investors. Pacific Oak traces its roots to an executive team that previously built and managed large-scale alternative investment platforms and non-traded real estate programs over multiple market cycles. The firm oversees a diversified portfolio that includes office, multifamily, land, hospitality, and other commercial property types across U.S. markets.

Pacific Oak manages a range of investment vehicles, including private real estate programs, Delaware Statutory Trust (DST) offerings, opportunity zone investments, and real estate investment trusts. The firm's investment strategy has historically emphasized value-oriented and opportunistic real estate investments, including acquisitions of discounted debt, distressed assets, and properties with repositioning potential. Pacific Oak also serves as an advisor to affiliated investment programs and has managed assets across numerous metropolitan areas throughout the United States. Its portfolio has included multifamily communities, office buildings, mixed-use developments, and development-oriented investments located in both established and emerging markets.

Choosing an address today means more than just renting an apartment. It's an investment in a lifestyle and the comforts of true community living. Simpson Property Group understands that everyone wants the most out of life.

Since 1948, their goal has been to provide superior customer satisfaction and quality apartment homes. They provide not only a place to live, but a way to live, with luxuries that combine technology, amenities and personalized services - which adds up to more convenient living for our residents.

At Amada they understand that caring for relatives can be rewarding but also stressful, time consuming and emotionally exhausting. It is difficult for families to juggle work, children and other obligations and still find time to properly care for an aging parent or loved one. Amada takes care of the caregiving so you can focus on just being a son, daughter or friend again.

Amada Senior Care is committed to enriching lives by providing nurturing, compassionate senior home care and by guiding families through the many senior housing options available for assisted living. Healthcare professionals and families look to Amada to help them navigate the complexities of the senior care system.

Center for Healthy Sexuality began in 1990 as a Houston-based practice founded by Barbara Levinson. The company provides outpatient treatment for individuals, couples, and families, with services centered on sex therapy, sexual addiction and compulsivity, pornography addiction, sex abuse and trauma, relationship therapy, and related intimacy concerns. Center for Healthy Sexuality offers comprehensive assessments, couples and group therapy, court-requested evaluations, guest speaking, training for professionals, and self-help resources. The business serves clients seeking structured behavioral health support across a broad range of sexual and relationship issues.

Açaí Brasil USA is a privately held hospitality company headquartered in Bellaire, Texas. Founded in 2016, the business introduced authentic Brazilian-style açaí bowls to the Houston market and has since expanded through franchising. The concept focuses on serving 100% fruit-based açaí bowls, smoothies, juices, and Brazilian finger foods, targeting health-conscious consumers. The company emphasizes educating customers on the texture and taste of traditional açaí, positioning itself as a pioneer of Brazilian açaí in Houston. Over the years, Açaí Brasil USA has grown its footprint across Texas and into other states, including Arizona, while maintaining its commitment to quality and authenticity.

Grand Law Firm is a Louisiana-based legal practice offering services in bankruptcy, debt relief, personal injury, and estate planning. Established in 1992, the firm has built a reputation for assisting individuals and businesses in managing financial challenges and legal disputes. With offices in Baton Rouge and New Orleans, Grand Law Firm provides tailored legal solutions that include Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 bankruptcy filings, debt settlement, and litigation support. The firm also handles personal injury claims and estate planning matters, reflecting a diversified practice aimed at addressing both financial and personal legal needs. Grand Law Firm operates as a privately held entity and emphasizes client-focused representation supported by decades of experience in the legal sector.

Energy Texas is a Texas retail electricity provider serving residential and business customers in the state's deregulated power market. The company offers fixed-rate electricity plans, account management tools, a 30-day Test Drive, and a rewards program built around bill credits and other customer perks. Energy Texas also provides support for switching service, billing questions, and service transfers, which places the business squarely in the retail power and customer-service side of the energy sector. The company emphasizes Texas-focused electricity plans and straightforward account management for customers choosing a provider in the ERCOT market.

Fengwan Q | Makeup Artistry is a freelance makeup business built around special effects and beauty makeup for film, television, weddings, and live entertainment. Fengwan Qing has developed the craft through years of work in the entertainment and beauty industries, with experience on independent films, music videos, and large event collaborations. The company's portfolio includes character-driven special effects work, bridal makeup, and beauty looks that support storytelling and on-camera presentation. The business also offers classes and appointment-based services, reflecting a mix of service work and education within the broader makeup artistry field.

7 Hills Productions began as a boutique video studio and has grown into a corporate video production company serving brands across Los Angeles and beyond. The company produces brand videos, testimonial videos, product videos, event coverage, recruitment videos, explainer videos, video podcasts, and promotional content for businesses in healthcare, education, finance, technology, software, retail, and other sectors. 7 Hills Productions also supports commercial video production, social media ads, photography, and studio-based filming, with projects designed for marketing, internal communications, and brand storytelling. The company works with clients across Southern California and nationwide, combining production planning, filming, editing, and final delivery into one workflow.

Trident Fitness is a Los Angeles–based personal training company founded in 1998. The firm operates a private training studio and provides customized fitness programs tailored to individual goals, physical ability, and performance needs. Its services primarily center on one-on-one personal training, strength and conditioning, and sport-specific fitness programming.
The company was established by Michael Shenkman, who transitioned from an engineering background into the fitness industry. Since its founding, Trident Fitness has focused on developing individualized training approaches rather than standardized group-based fitness models. The company’s training philosophy emphasizes adaptability across a range of fitness levels, from recreational participants to competitive athletes.

RDP Creative is a global promotional product and creative solutions agency delivering innovative designs and premium branded merchandise for leading companies worldwide. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in London, Hong Kong, and Shenzhen, RDP Creative partners with clients to elevate brand experiences through tailored promotional programs. The team specializes in strategic sourcing, custom product design, and cutting-edge packaging solutions while ensuring compliance and quality across all projects. With a focus on creativity, precision, and reliable execution, RDP Creative helps Fortune 500 companies, entertainment brands, and retailers amplify their marketing campaigns and build impactful connections with customers. Passionate about innovation and customer service, RDP Creative continues to set the standard for excellence in global promotional marketing and brand engagement solutions.

Club Pilates began in 2007 as a Pilates studio brand built around reformer-based group workouts and a modernized version of Joseph Pilates' Contrology method. The company operates through a franchise system centered on low-impact, full-body classes that use expanded studio equipment and a group training format. Club Pilates also connects its business to instructor training and franchise ownership opportunities, while serving members through recurring studio memberships and class-based fitness offerings. Club Pilates is part of Xponential Fitness' portfolio of boutique fitness brands and maintains a significant studio presence in the Pilates market.

GSR Construction Group is a commercial construction firm specializing in general contracting and construction management services. The company focuses on delivering projects across multiple sectors, including corporate interiors, healthcare, retail, and institutional spaces. Its services encompass preconstruction planning, design-build solutions, and project execution, ensuring that client objectives are met through efficient scheduling and cost management. GSR Construction Group emphasizes collaboration with architects, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality results tailored to client needs. Operating as a privately held company, it continues to serve as a trusted partner for businesses seeking comprehensive construction solutions.

Van Sharks is a Houston-based company specializing in custom van conversions and fleet upfitting solutions. Established in 2023, the company focuses on transforming standard vans into tailored vehicles for both commercial and personal use. Its services include interior customization, installation of specialized equipment, and performance enhancements to meet the needs of businesses such as mobile service providers, contractors, and logistics operators. Van Sharks also caters to individuals seeking lifestyle conversions for travel and recreational purposes. The company emphasizes quality craftsmanship and offers nationwide delivery of its customized vans. Operating as a privately held entity, Van Sharks positions itself within the automotive customization and repair industry, providing solutions that combine functionality with design flexibility.

BMO began in 1817 as Bank of Montreal and later adopted the BMO brand, building a long history in Canadian banking. The company operates as a North American financial institution with personal and commercial banking, wealth management, global markets, and investment banking services. BMO serves clients in the United States and in select global markets through integrated business lines. The company maintains a broad financial-services platform that combines retail banking, business banking, and capital markets activity.

Howley Law was founded in 2019 as a boutique law firm built around cost-effective, client-centric legal service for individuals and companies. The firm handles legal and financial problems across corporate and contract law, finance and debt agreements, liability management, governance matters, bankruptcy, wind-down work, and liquidation trustee roles, with a particular emphasis on distressed situations and small business reorganizations. Howley Law also serves as conflict counsel, local counsel, and referral counsel for larger firms, and the firm has developed a niche advising trial law firms and clients involved in workouts, restructurings, insolvency-related litigation, and distressed M&A transactions.

Into Action is an addiction treatment center specializing in personalized treatment for drug and alcohol abuse, conveniently located in Houston, Texas and led by experienced master’s level counselors and medical professionals.

Pontem Energy Capital began as an energy investment and operating firm founded by Jeff Bartlett, building around experience in oil and gas finance, engineering, and asset operations. The company invests in operated and non-operated upstream production assets, extends into midstream energy assets, and provides advisory services to operators. Pontem pursues asset-based strategies that emphasize acquisitions, development, and scale-up potential, with a focus on principal preservation and capital appreciation. The company maintains continued activity in non-operated oil and gas investing and other energy-sector opportunities across the United States and North America.

Founded in 2012, Royal Moving & Storage provides relocation assistance and a whole range of other related services. They include necessary supplies into the quotes, perform packaging and safe loading, transport all kinds of valuable goods, clean houses after relocation, and provide insurance. In addition, Royal Moving will assist you in long-distance moving, office moves, apartment moves, and so on. This service is also available if you want to use your own car.

Royal Moving’s strategy is aimed at providing high-quality services and maximizing returns: once working with them, customers no longer try another company but become loyal clients. The latter, by the way, enjoy discounts and services from their partners.

Their philosophy is simple: they offer quality services and do their best to make customers’ relocations stress-free and flawless.

Bowe House is a retail business centered on a curated selection of gifts, home decor, independently published books, and zines. The company's assortment also extends into candles, stationery, art prints, jewelry, ornaments, and tea-related accessories, giving the business a broad lifestyle-goods focus. Bowe House positions itself as a shop built around comfort and thoughtful home pieces, and the business offers events and tea tastings as part of the customer experience. The company's origin is tied to that curation-first retail concept, with the Bowe House name used for the shop's broader mix of products and in-store programming in Houston.

Blank Space Studio began as Blank Space LLC and operates as a photography studio focused on a naturally lit workspace for creatives in Houston. The studio provides hourly rentals, membership access, workshops, photography events, and a residency program, with services designed for photographers, content creators, artists, illustrators, and designers. Blank Space Studio also supports creative work with lights, props, and equipment access, while building community through classes and programs for photographers at different experience levels.

Thrive Align Wellness is a Houston-based wellness practice focused on integrative sessions and holistic coaching. The company's services center on biomagnetism, somatic grounding, emotional release, energetic alignment, and nervous system reset work, with offerings designed to support physical ease and emotional regulation. The business operates as a calm, client-centered wellness service built around helping people reconnect with balance and reduce stress through gentle, structured sessions. The company maintains an active Houston presence and a service mix that combines coaching with alternative wellness practices.

Knue Laser is a Houston-based business focused on laser hair removal, tattoo removal, electrolysis, microneedling, and related skin treatments. The company serves a wide range of skin types and identities, with an emphasis on personalized care and an inclusive treatment environment. Knue Laser also offers professional training classes in laser hair removal, extending the business beyond client services into education. The company has more than nine years of experience and has built its work around precision laser treatments and related aesthetic services.

profile.locationBio: Her Way Studio began as Her Way by Jessica Chapa and focuses on personalized lash extensions. The company offers tailored lash sets designed to enhance natural features and centers the service experience on a customized, appointment-based approach. The business sits within the beauty and personal care vertical, with services built around licensed lash work and individualized styling.

profile.locationBio: The Nava Law Firm is a Houston-based immigration law practice focused on helping individuals, professionals, and families navigate the U.S. immigration process. The firm handles matters involving federal immigration agencies, including DHS, ICE, and USCIS, and provides immigration guidance and representation. Marco Nava earned a law degree from South Texas College of Law Houston and became an immigration attorney before serving as managing partner of the firm. The firm specializes in immigration-related legal services rather than adopting a broad general-practice model.

JWB Insurance Group is a Medicare insurance agency founded by Jorge W. Briones and built around helping seniors understand coverage options and avoid fraud. The company provides free consultations, offers bilingual Medicare education through a podcast, blog, and newsletter, and maintains a content hub with guidance on enrollment windows, rights, and benefits. JWB Insurance Group also recruits Medicare brokers and serves clients in Houston and beyond, with services centered on Medicare guidance and related insurance education.

Superb Studio is a Houston-based photography studio that provides bookable creative spaces for photo sessions and related projects. The company offers White Canvas, White Canvas Pro, Raw Canvas, and other studio rooms designed for natural light, props, lighting add-ons, and flexible session use. Superb Studio also sells memberships and hourly access, along with a small merch store and services such as digitals for modeling. The business has grown around creative studio rentals and session bookings, with a market presence centered on photographers, models, and other visual creators.

Pestaña Beauty Spa has been active since at least 2023 and serves Houston as a beauty and wellness spa focused on skincare and cosmetic treatments. The company offers custom facials, deep-cleansing facials, back treatments, skin-lightening services, body contouring treatments, brow lamination, brow waxing and tinting, eyelash extensions, lash lifts, and body waxing. The business provides customizable service packages and Spanish-language service support. The company maintains a market position centered on personal care, beauty maintenance, and relaxation services for local clients.

Slayology is a Houston-based beauty business centered on salon appointments and personalized consultations. The company focuses on hair health and detail, and its service menu includes hair extension consultations, makeup services, and waxing. The company offers bridal glam makeup alongside body and facial waxing options, reflecting a mixed beauty-services model built around appointment-based care. The business operates as a salon experience built around artistry, consultation, and routine service visits.

Slay Beauty Teeth Bar is a Houston-based business focused on teeth whitening and tooth-gem services. The company provides personalized smile treatments, including whitening options for different stain levels, sensitive teeth care, teen whitening, and mobile appointments in the Houston area. Its service menu includes tooth-gem options in basic, crystal, and gold styles, offering a mix of cosmetic smile enhancements rather than general salon services. The brand centers on a tailored, appointment-based experience for clients seeking brighter smiles and cosmetic tooth accents.

StoneManor Homes was founded by industry veterans John Tucker and Scott Sparks with one clear goal: to build homes that reflect the way people actually live today. After nearly 30 years in leadership roles with regional and national homebuilders, the two recognized a need for more inspired, design-forward homes that still feel attainable. So they created StoneManor, a Houston-based builder focused on thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship and flexible living.

Mashcole Property Management, Inc. is strictly a third-party property management company focused on the Southern California markets. The company is hired by a variety of third-party clients ranging from institutional level investors to “mom and pop” investors. Their goal is to oversee the day-to-day operations and management responsibilities of their multi-family portfolios/properties.

Mashcole’s key personnel have extensive experience in the management of assets. These include projects requiring repositioning, due diligence, strong resident retention requirements and lease ups. Mashcole also coordinates renovation projects, which have ranged from $2,500 per unit to $25,000 per unit and up. The company was formed in 2004 and currently manages over 175 apartment communities totaling more than 4,000 units.

Houston Methodist began as a small Methodist hospital and grew into a nonprofit health care system and academic medical center serving the Greater Houston area. Founded in 1919, the organization traces its origins to a church-affiliated hospital that became the first Texas hospital owned and operated by the Methodist church. Today, Houston Methodist provides hospital care, primary care, specialty physician services, emergency care, imaging, laboratory services, and outpatient care through a broad network of locations. The company also operates an academic institute and participates in research, education, and global health care services while maintaining a strong focus on clinical care and patient support.

Prestige Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy located in Houston, Texas, serving the local community with a range of pharmaceutical and health-related services. The pharmacy provides prescription fulfillment, medication therapy management, and immunization services. Additional offerings include compounding services and blister packaging to support medication adherence. Prestige Pharmacy emphasizes personalized care, assisting patients with consultations and health screenings to promote wellness. The pharmacy also offers delivery services for added convenience. While the exact year of establishment is not publicly listed, Prestige Pharmacy functions as a privately held business focused on meeting the healthcare needs of its surrounding neighborhoods.

Houston Center for Clinical Research is an independent clinical research organization based in Sugar Land, Texas. Established in 2014, the center specializes in conducting Phase II, III, and IV clinical trials across a range of therapeutic areas. Its mission is to advance medical knowledge and improve patient care by partnering with pharmaceutical companies and sponsors to evaluate new treatments and therapies. The facility provides participants with access to investigational medications and medical oversight at no cost, while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and ethical guidelines. Houston Center for Clinical Research emphasizes patient safety and data integrity throughout the research process. The organization operates as a privately held entity and serves as a resource for both sponsors seeking reliable trial execution and individuals interested in contributing to medical advancements.

Leidos QTC Health Services delivers medical examination and clinical support services for government, military, veterans, employers, and civilians, with offerings that include disability evaluations, independent medical exams, occupational health services, diagnostic testing, and case management solutions. The company collaborates with customers across public-sector programs and supports readiness and benefits access through specialized services for military, veteran, and occupational health needs. QTC traces its roots to the early 1980s and later became part of Leidos, after which the brand transitioned to Leidos QTC Health Services. The business now operates as a health-services platform centered on examinations, reporting, and case management for a broad national client base.

Heart of Houston Birth and Wellness Center is a healthcare organization based in Houston, Texas, specializing in midwifery and holistic wellness services. Founded in2020, the center provides a comprehensive range of care options for individuals and families, including prenatal, labor, and postpartum support, as well as gynecological and primary care services. The facility emphasizes evidence-based practices and a personalized approach to childbirth, offering an alternative to traditional hospital settings for low-risk pregnancies. In addition to birth services, the center supports family planning, fertility care, and wellness programs designed to meet the needs of diverse families. Heart of Houston collaborates with physicians, lactation consultants, and other healthcare professionals to ensure integrated care. The organization operates as a privately held entity and serves as a resource for education and community engagement through classes and support.

Modern Eye Vision & Surgery is an ophthalmology practice based in Houston, Texas, providing advanced eye care and surgical solutions for patients seeking improved vision and ocular health. The clinic offers a full spectrum of services, including routine eye exams, cataract surgery, LASIK, PRK, implantable contact lenses (ICL), and other refractive procedures. With a focus on personalized treatment plans, Modern Eye combines state-of-the-art technology with evidence-based practices to address a wide range of vision needs. The practice operates multiple locations in the Houston area, including its Bellaire office at 6550 Mapleridge Street, which serves patients from surrounding neighborhoods such as River Oaks, Galleria, and West University. Led by experienced ophthalmologists, the clinic emphasizes patient education and individualized care to ensure optimal outcomes for both surgical and non-surgical treatments.

opSolutions, operating under the legal name Synbio LLC, is a healthcare supplier specializing in prosthetic and orthotic devices. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, the company provides a range of services including patient evaluation, custom fabrication, fitting, and modification of prosthetic and orthotic devices to restore function and mobility. Established in 2016, opSolutions is a Medicare-enrolled supplier and offers products such as limb prostheses, custom-fabricated orthoses, prefabricated orthoses, and off-the-shelf orthotic solutions. The organization serves patients with neuromusculoskeletal disorders, limb loss, and other conditions requiring supportive or corrective devices. In addition to its Houston location, opSolutions maintains multiple offices across Texas, including San Antonio, Humble, Austin, and Corpus Christi, to ensure accessibility for patients statewide. The company operates as a privately held entity and emphasizes compliance with healthcare standards and insurance requirements, including Medicare participation.

Permanent Makeup by Kim is a beauty service provider located in Houston, Texas, specializing in advanced semi-permanent makeup techniques. The business focuses on enhancing facial aesthetics through procedures such as microblading for eyebrows, eyeliner application, lip tinting, and tattoo removal. Founded and operated by Kim Phan, the studio emphasizes precision and artistry, offering customized treatments tailored to individual client preferences. With a strong reputation for quality and attention to detail, the practice has become a trusted destination for clients seeking long-lasting cosmetic enhancements. Services are provided by appointment only, ensuring personalized care in a professional setting. Permanent Makeup by Kim operates as a privately held business and serves clients from its Houston location, catering to those seeking both corrective and aesthetic solutions in the beauty industry.

Alliance Rehab and Wellness is a privately held healthcare organization based in Houston, Texas, specializing in rehabilitation and wellness services. The company operates within the hospital and health care sector, providing therapeutic and recovery-focused programs tailored to patient needs. While specific service details are limited, the organization is known to focus on physical rehabilitation and related wellness solutions. Alliance Rehab and Wellness has been active for several years and maintains a small operational footprint, serving clients in the Houston metropolitan area. The company emphasizes personalized care and aims to support patients in achieving improved mobility and overall health outcomes.

Mofan Salon features passionate stylists from Asia who understand the unique characteristics of Asian hair. The salon offers a range of services designed to create healthy, beautiful styles for all clients. Its haircut expertise focuses on Asian hair textures, crafting flattering cuts for straight, wavy, or thick hair. For those seeking a dimensional glow, Mofan Salon provides balayage techniques tailored specifically for Asian hair, with stylists hand-painting subtle highlights to add natural depth without harsh lines. The team also specializes in customized highlights, enhancing natural beauty while considering the specific needs of Asian hair.

Glorious Smiles & Dental Implants is a privately held dental practice based in Houston, Texas. Founded in 2022, the clinic provides a comprehensive range of dental services, including cosmetic treatments, dental implants, veneers, Invisalign, root canals, and emergency care. The practice emphasizes advanced dental technology and personalized treatment plans to address both aesthetic and functional needs. Glorious Smiles operates as a Texas Domestic Limited Liability Company and is registered with the Texas Secretary of State. The clinic is led by Dr. Aunce Abdullah, who serves as owner and dentist, and is licensed to practice general dentistry. TransMedics was founded to address the growing need for healthier organs for transplantation. They are focused on transforming the standard of care – increasing organ utilization, improving patient outcomes, and reducing transplant costs.
