profile.locationBio: State Farm began in 1922 when G.J. Mecherle launched a mutual auto insurer to offer farmers fairer rates. The company has since grown into a mutual insurance organization with a broad business mix that includes auto, home, life, health, commercial coverage, and banking and investment services. State Farm's operations center on agent-based distribution, claims handling, and policy servicing for customers across the United States. The company maintains a long-running Good Neighbor brand identity and positions itself as a customer-focused mutual insurer.

Woody's Furs began as a Houston-based retailer focusing on luxury fur and leather products. The company offers a wide selection of fur, leather, cashmere, and shearling garments. In addition to retail sales, they provide fur storage, cleaning, and repair services. Their expertise includes maintaining and restoring fur items while updating older pieces. Woody's Furs has built a reputation for quality products and personalized customer service in the luxury apparel market.

De Lara Law Firm, PLLC is a Houston-based law firm focused on U.S. immigration and personal injury matters, including naturalization, family-based immigration, deportation defense, immigration bonds, and injury claims. The firm serves families through legal guidance on immigration procedures, green cards, asylum, waivers, and related court matters, while also handling personal injury representation. The business operates under the De Lara Law Firm name and is a professional limited liability company formed in Texas.

Truly Title is a title insurance and settlement services company focused on real estate closings. The company pairs traditional title and escrow work with digital tools for quotes, net sheets, buyer estimates, remote deposit, and secure transaction communication. Truly Title operates as a modern title-tech business serving residential and commercial transactions with an emphasis on transparency and streamlined closing workflows. The company was organized in Wyoming and filed in 2018, then expanded into a broader multi-state title-services footprint.

Windstar began in 2005 as Windstar LPG, built around moving propane and gasoline between the United States and Mexico. The company focuses on propane and refined fuels, with services that include distribution, logistics, storage, transportation, trading, branded retail fuel support, unbranded retail delivery, and last-mile delivery. Windstar also serves wholesale customers and works across the U.S. and Mexico, with activity tied to North America's fuel and cross-border supply chain. The company is a commercial fuel partner for retail suppliers and other businesses that need steady product movement and coordinated delivery.

Cintas began in 1929 as a family business collecting used rags, laundering them, and selling them back to businesses, and the company later operated under the Acme name before adopting Cintas. The company now provides workwear and business essentials for image, safety, cleanliness, and compliance needs. Cintas' business lines include uniforms and work apparel, facility services, first aid and safety products, training and compliance services, and fire protection services. The company serves business customers across North America and focuses on keeping workplaces clean, safe, and ready for the workday.

WasteLinq was established in 2017 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company provides technology solutions specifically designed for the waste management industry. WasteLinq offers software that streamlines processes like waste tracking, electronic manifest generation, and compliance reporting. Their services cater to environmental service providers, waste brokers, and disposal facilities. The platform uses AI to enhance waste profiling accuracy and e-manifest submissions. WasteLinq continues to expand its digital tools for waste management professionals.

Highlands Residential Mortgage began in 2010 when industry veterans created a company focused on employee culture and customer service. Starting in Texas, they've expanded nationally while maintaining local expertise. The company offers home loans for purchases, refinances, and renovations through experienced loan officers. Their services include conventional, FHA, and VA loans plus digital tools for borrowers. Highlands emphasizes personalized service throughout the mortgage process.

SK hynix began its semiconductor business in 1983 and has operated under earlier names before adopting the current brand, with a history tied to South Korea's memory-chip industry. The company manufactures and sells memory semiconductors including DRAM, NAND flash, and multi-chip packages, with products used in SSDs and applications across mobile, server, networking, consumer, and automotive markets. SK hynix focuses on high-bandwidth memory and next-generation memory technologies as part of its current business operations, supported by a global network of production sites, sales subsidiaries, and research and development centers.

Pinnacle Risk Solutions is an independent insurance agency that works with businesses, families, and individuals on commercial, personal, specialty, and employee benefits coverage. The company also offers claims support, policy service tools, and workforce solutions that connect insurance advice with payroll, HR, and workers' compensation support. Its legacy agencies include Geisenheimer Agency, founded in 1972, and ABA Insurance Agency, established in 2009, reflecting the firm's long-running presence in insurance and risk management. The company represents a broad group of insurance carriers and serves clients across New Jersey and beyond through a national independent-agency model.

One80 Intermediaries is a privately held firm with offices throughout the US and Canada. As a leading insurance wholesaler and program manager, the company offers placement services and binding authority for property and casualty, life, travel/accident and health, affinity and administrative services and warranty business. One80 serves commercial companies, non-profits, public entities, individuals and associations and unions, and has access to all major insurance markets in the US, Canada and UK. One80 has offices in many locations throughout the US and Canada.

InterMat LLC is a consulting firm that works in planning, engineering, and project support for truck, rail, marine, and inland terminal facilities. The company provides strategic planning, engineering and construction solutions, and owner's representation, with a focus on bulk material handling systems and terminal commodity handling across transportation and logistics projects. InterMat's project portfolio includes work on cement terminals, rail and truck loadout systems, and marine facility upgrades, reflecting a business centered on complex infrastructure for moving and storing bulk products. InterMat expanded its offerings through a merger with Douglas Planning Group, bringing that team into the company's current structure.

Trinity Logistics began as a family transportation business whose roots trace back to the early 1930s, and the company has grown into a freight brokerage and third-party logistics provider. Trinity Logistics arranges truckload, less-than-truckload, warehousing, intermodal, drayage, expedited, international, and managed transportation solutions for businesses with varied shipping needs. The company also supports customers with technology such as transportation management systems and works across industries including food and beverage, chemical, construction, and manufacturing. Trinity Logistics operates as a Burris Logistics company and delivers people-centric freight solutions built around logistics problem-solving and supply chain support.

The David J. Joseph Company began as Joseph Joseph and Brothers Company in Cincinnati and later adopted its current name, building a long history in scrap metal trading and recycling. Today, the company focuses on ferrous and non-ferrous scrap trading, metal recycling, international scrap and substitute marketing, pig iron trading, industrial scrap management, and railcar leasing, engineering, inspection, and dismantling. DJJ operates a broad recycling and brokerage network, with services that support industrial customers and the supply chain for recycled metal materials. The company is now part of Nucor and specializes in scrap metal brokerage, recycling, transportation, and related mill services.

Tecovas began in 2015 as a direct-to-consumer western goods brand built around cowboy boots and a simpler buying experience. The company now offers cowboy boots, work boots, hats, denim, outerwear, accessories, and other western apparel, with products sold through its online shop and physical stores. Tecovas positions its assortment around handmade western wear and boots, while also extending into ranch wear and other everyday western styles. The business has since grown into a broader western lifestyle retailer with a significant presence in the United States.

Western Alliance Bank began in 1994 as a regional banking business and has since grown into a national banking brand focused on business clients. The company provides commercial banking, consumer products, deposit services, lending, treasury management, international banking, and online banking through its banking platform and related businesses. Western Alliance Bank also includes mortgage-related services through AmeriHome Mortgage and serves a broad mix of industries and sectors. Recent company materials describe the business as operating under one unified brand with offices nationwide and a focus on tailored banking solutions for businesses and individuals.

Benji Personal Injury is a California personal injury law firm founded by Daniel Benji. The firm handles car accident, truck accident, motorcycle accident, rideshare injury, wrongful death, dog bite, slip and fall, and product liability matters. Benji Personal Injury represents injured clients in claims against drivers, insurers, property owners, and other responsible parties, with case work that includes investigation, negotiation, and trial preparation. The practice emphasizes contingency-fee representation and serves clients across California through its personal injury and accident-focused legal services.

Lee Law Offices began as a legal practice centered on employment and labor disputes and has built experience over decades in California legal matters. Lee Law Offices handles wage and hour disputes, whistleblower claims, employment contract issues, compliance advice, commercial litigation, and church disputes, with representation for both employees and employers. The firm has published work addressing joint employment, labor enforcement, and business liability topics, demonstrating a broader focus on workplace and commercial conflict.

Read to a Child is a national mentoring and literacy nonprofit built around volunteer read-aloud mentoring for elementary students in under-resourced schools. The organization was founded on the belief that every child deserves to be read to by a caring adult, and its mission is to foster a love of reading, improve literacy skills, and support socio-emotional well-being in students from under-resourced communities. Its Read Aloud Mentoring Program pairs adults one-on-one with students for weekly reading sessions, with support from program coordinators and corporate and community partners. Read to a Child serves school communities in the Boston, Detroit, Hartford, and Los Angeles metro areas through long-term school partnerships and a broader network of volunteer mentors.

Founded in 1979, The Muller Company is an opportunistic real-estate investment, development, and management firm focused on acquiring and repositioning commercial properties. The company's business verticals include acquisitions, asset management, financing, accounting, leasing, property management, dispositions, construction management, and project management. The Muller Company has worked across office, industrial, and retail assets in Northern and Southern California, Arizona, and Utah. The company also handles land acquisition, entitlements, ground-up development, tenant improvements, and capital projects as part of its real-estate services.

Angeleno Smile operates as a dental practice in Los Angeles that is led by Dr. Sanaz Parsi, a USC graduate with family dentistry experience. The practice presents itself as a full-service office focused on patient comfort and care, and its website highlights general dentistry, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, restorative dentistry, oral surgery, and prosthodontic services. Angeleno Smile also lists treatments such as teeth whitening, tooth-colored fillings, porcelain veneers, Invisalign, cosmetic bonding, inlays and onlays, dental implants, crowns, and bridges. Current site materials show a practice built around routine care, cosmetic smile improvements, and restorative treatment for patients with a wide range of oral health needs.

Latitude Food Allergy Care was founded in 2018 by parents of children with food allergies after a personal search for better care and collaboration with food allergy researchers at Stanford. The company focuses on food allergy assessment, diagnosis, oral immunotherapy, Xolair-based treatment, and ongoing support for children and adults. Latitude also provides patient resources and clinician referral support, while maintaining an evidence-based model centered on food allergy care.

No parent organization or affiliated multi-clinic network has been identified. The practice functions as a single-location outpatient professional services office.

Its programs include individual and group therapy, intensive outpatient programs, psychiatric evaluations, and holistic wellness services designed to promote long-term recovery and emotional well-being. Ethos Wellness emphasizes a personalized approach, integrating clinical expertise with compassionate care to address the unique needs of each client. Douglas Emmett is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol DEI. Between 1971 and 1991, Dan Emmett and partners formed three real estate companies, which collaboratively engaged in the acquisition, development, redevelopment, operation and management of real estate assets within supply-constrained markets in Los Angeles County. While the early focus was on multifamily properties, the Company's investment focus evolved to include office properties and complementary retail space in California and Honolulu, Hawaii. Between 1993 and 2006, Douglas Emmett acquired a substantial majority of its portfolio through nine institutional funds, and in 2006, the company went public.

The company owns and operates two asset classes: Class A office and multifamily apartments. Through its interest in its Operating Partnership and its subsidiaries and consolidated JVs, it owns and operates approximately 18 million square feet of Class A office space and over 5,000 apartment units within the coastal submarkets of Los Angeles and Honolulu. The business strategy is to select submarkets that are supply constrained, with high barriers to entry, key lifestyle amenities, proximity to high-end executive housing and a diverse economic base, then follow an acquisition strategy of gaining substantial market share.

The Bay Ltd. legacy began over 65 years ago when Mr. Marvin L. Berry founded the family-owned Berry Contracting, Inc. in 1953. A man of integrity and vision, Mr. Berry was committed to producing quality construction services that supported the growth and future of South Texas. Through diligence and hard work, the team at Berry Contracting, Inc. saw their operations at the forefront of major cutting-edge construction projects that extended far beyond the Coastal Bend.

Since his passing in 1997, Mr. Berry’s legacy continues on through the thousands of individuals who support Bay Ltd. each day with pride, quality craftsmanship and a commitment to excellence in all areas of service. Guided by the principles of honesty and integrity, their organization continues to enjoy unprecedented growth and an unparalleled record of safety and service that drives our reputation internationally and in their own community.

Enhabit Home Health & Hospice provides home health and hospice services focused on care for patients in the home and support for loved ones. The company began as Encompass Health's home health and hospice business before becoming Enhabit in 2022. Enhabit expanded as a national provider of home-based care, with services centered on home health and hospice delivery rather than hospital-based treatment. In 2026, Kinderhook Industries acquired the company, and Enhabit became a private company.

Evolve Health is a physician-owned and physician-led healthcare organization specializing in podiatry and expanding into multi-specialty services across Florida and Texas. The company originated as Modern Foot & Ankle and rebranded in 2025 to reflect its broader care model. Founded in 2019, Evolve Health operates as a privately held entity with a growing network of clinics offering advanced diagnostics, minimally invasive procedures, and integrated care solutions. The organization emphasizes innovation and accessibility, recently introducing physical therapy services and expanding its footprint in key markets such as Tampa, Orlando, Palm Beach, and Sarasota. Evolve Health continues to strengthen its provider roster and clinical capabilities to deliver comprehensive, patient-centered care throughout the Southeast.

They strive to deliver consistency in the high quality of their product, with the utmost attention to quality and detail in the design and material selection process. The design team assists their home buying clients through the selection process, allowing homeowners to create and achieve a better vision of what they want in their new home to look like.

Beacon Builders has many beautiful new home communities in Houston and the surrounding metropolitan area. Their selection of new homes and floorplans allows new home buyers to have a choice that best fits their lifestyle and living requirements. Beacon Builders’ unique and luxurious new home design is created to show high-quality craftsmanship and attention to detail from floor to ceiling with some floorplans to include a 4th-floor roof-top terrace that is special in their building process

Crown Bags LLC is a U.S.-based provider of high-performance bulk packaging solutions for demanding industries, with a focus on petrochemicals, chemicals, food, and dairy. The company designs and distributes FIBC bulk bags, food-grade bags, woven polypropylene bags, paper bags, container liners, flexitanks, and related specialty packaging for dry bulk solids and bulk liquids. Crown Bags LLC describes itself as a manufacturer’s representative with direct manufacturing control, including food-grade production and industrial packaging capabilities backed by certified quality systems. Company materials also say Crown Bags LLC has operated for over a decade and built its business around consistent performance, traceability, and supply chain reliability.

profile.locationBio: Westlawn is a private investment firm focused on long-term investment in the global oil and gas industry.

MELS Insurance Agency began as an independent insurance agency serving Houston and has focused on helping individuals, families, and business owners compare coverage from multiple carriers. The company offers personal lines such as auto, homeowners, mobile home, renters and condo, motorcycle and boat, umbrella, and pet insurance, along with business coverage including commercial auto, commercial property, commercial umbrella, general liability, professional liability, and workers' compensation. MELS Insurance Agency also supports clients with insurance claims, policy updates, payment options, and quote comparisons, combining personal and commercial coverage guidance in one place.

Consortium For Therapeutic Recreation/Activities Certification, Inc. began in 1995 as Texas professionals developed a voluntary certification program for therapeutic recreation and activity work. The company serves as a credentialing body for people seeking certification in therapeutic recreation and activity settings in Texas and certifies activity director, therapeutic recreation associate, and therapeutic recreation specialist levels. CTRAC also provides application, examination, and recertification processes, along with forms and continuing-education requirements that support maintenance of credentials. The business remains focused on professional standards intended to protect consumers and help employing agencies assess competence in the field.

House of JV describes itself as a wellness consultancy built around energy, movement, and intentional self-betterment. The company’s services center on conSOULting, Reiki healing, and dance-based embodiment practices, with offerings that also include meditations, rituals, and spiritual tools for reflection and grounding. House of JV presents itself as a space for energy work and personal transformation, and its Substack publication was launched as part of that broader platform.

The Essential Credentials is a healthcare credentialing support business created from more than 25 years of nursing and industry experience. The company helps healthcare professionals pursue certifications and licensing by offering credentialing guidance, application assistance, documentation support, and recertification help. Service offerings also include preparation for credentials such as CPR, Basic Life Support, Certified Nursing Assistant, and Medical Assistant, along with study tips, resources, and sample questions. The business focuses on helping professionals understand requirements, organize paperwork, and work through exam and certification steps with a practical, hands-on approach.

Medical Supply Source LLC is a Houston-based supplier of durable medical equipment and medical supplies, with federal provider records classifying the organization under the durable medical equipment and medical supplies taxonomy. Public records show the organization appeared in the National Provider Identifier system in 2024, pointing to a recent market entry for the business name. The company’s operating profile centers on home-health and patient-supply needs, with services aligned to the distribution of extended-use medical equipment and related products used in everyday care settings.

Body & Lashed by Bae LLC began in 2018 and has built a beauty and wellness offering centered on body contouring and eyelash services. The company provides body contouring treatments, detox services, eyelash extensions, brow and lip aesthetics, and related beauty care. Body & Lashed by Bae LLC also offers certification and online training for eyelash and body contouring techniques, extending its business beyond consumer services into professional education. The firm further sells related products and training materials through its online shop, supporting both service clients and industry learners.

Zytech Consulting, LLC is a Houston-based information technology services firm that was established to help businesses build a technology strategy for secure and efficient operations. The company focuses on businesses of all sizes and provides consulting, outsourced IT support, cloud services, backup and disaster recovery, network security, video surveillance, and voice and video conferencing solutions. Zytech Consulting presents its work as customized to each client’s culture, budget, and situation, with an emphasis on proactive management, secure infrastructure, and practical support across core IT functions.

Andara Solutions LLC is a Texas-organized limited liability company with public filings listing a Houston principal office and a 2023 filing year. The company’s official materials describe a business focused on NOVOC resins for coatings, composites, casting, urethanes, epoxies, and custom formulations.

Restorations By Sabra is a Houston-area automotive restoration business focused on classic cars and trucks, custom restomods, and factory-correct rebuilds. The company offers in-house services that include paint and body work, restoration rescues, engine and performance upgrades, custom upholstery, and concierge support for project coordination. Its public materials describe the business as built around Sabra Johnson’s long background in the collector-car and restoration field, along with a signature 25-step build process used to organize each project. Restorations By Sabra also presents itself as serving collectors and enthusiasts through a broad portfolio of full restorations and custom builds.

Jackie O' Management LLC is a Texas-based firm focused on bookkeeping, tax preparation, payroll services, sales tax compliance, financial statements, IRS representation, and business advisory support for small businesses and individuals. Company materials also describe custom bookkeeping packages, business entity selection guidance, and resources aimed at improving financial management and tax readiness. Jackie O' Management LLC is organized as a Texas limited liability company, with public business records showing formation in Texas and a Houston-area operating presence.

AHRMDCO International, LLC began in 2002 as a business development firm focused on consulting services for clients in the United States and abroad. The company provides management consulting, business process outsourcing, change management, customer relationship management, project management support, and vendor management services. AHRMDCO also works in facility management and related business services, including SBE, DBE, WBE, MBE, and veteran participation support for projects. The firm helps clients improve processes, administration, and project coordination across commercial and organizational settings.

Onsite Global Logistics is a Houston-based logistics company that focuses on time-sensitive shipping and personal shipment handling. The company says it was built around the idea that business is personal, and it emphasizes 24/7 access with a dedicated specialist managing each shipment from quote to delivery. Its service mix includes critical and expedited transport, international air and ocean freight forwarding, domestic freight, project cargo, warehousing, and supply chain consulting. Onsite Global Logistics serves industries such as oil and gas, power, mining, manufacturing, trade shows, and construction, reflecting a market presence centered on specialized freight and supply chain support.

Texas Care Bammel is part of Texas Care Center’s behavioral health network and focuses on mental health services for children, teens, adults, and families. The company says its clinical team has been serving communities since 1998, building experience in counseling, therapy, psychiatric care, case management, and community-based behavioral health support. Current service pages describe a Medicaid-oriented offering that includes family therapy and related care for the Bammel area and surrounding community. The public site also presents appointment-request and contact resources, reflecting a patient-facing model centered on access and ongoing support.

Hamda Chiropractic Clinic Inc was founded with a mission to help people live healthier, pain-free lives through natural chiropractic care. The company offers chiropractic and wellness services that include spinal adjustments, pediatric chiropractic care, sports injury support, auto injury care, nutrition guidance, cold therapy, and physical therapy. Its website describes a patient-focused approach centered on relieving pain, restoring mobility, and supporting overall wellness through personalized treatment plans.

Strategic Training and Consulting is a Houston-based company that provides registered agent services, Texas LLC formation support, nonprofit formation, annual report filing, franchise tax filing, beneficial ownership information filing, website development, self-publishing, social media content creation, and workshop space rental. The company’s public materials also emphasize compliance reminders and client portal access for handling business documents, which points to a service model built around helping entrepreneurs and small business owners stay organized and maintain entity compliance. Public-facing pages show that Strategic Training and Consulting combines business formation, compliance support, and digital services, giving the firm a broad small-business support profile rather than a single-service focus.

The Clinic Neuropsychology & Psychology Services is a mental health practice focused on neuropsychological and psychological care for individuals ages sixteen and older and families. The clinic provides assessments and evaluations for cognitive and memory concerns, brain injury, ADHD, learning disabilities, emotional functioning, forensic matters, chemical dependency, immigration cases, FAA matters, workers' compensation, competency, and fitness-for-duty needs. The practice also offers life and success coaching, hypnotherapy, and support tied to treatment planning and symptom management. Based around a neuropsychological approach to mental health and well-being, The Clinic Neuropsychology & Psychology Services combines evaluation services with counseling-oriented support for a broad range of clinical and administrative needs.

Dignified Tech emerged as a Texas-based healthcare organization and is listed in public records with a Houston mailing address. Public provider records identify Dignified Tech as an assisted living facility focused on mental illness support, placing the company within the nursing and custodial care sector. The business presence is tied to residential treatment and adult care home services, showing a care model centered on supervision, assistance, and structured support for individuals with behavioral health needs.

RBS Aftermarket & Motorsports Group was established in 2024 as a Texas business focused on motorsports and the aftermarket. The company is an investment group that helps business owners and managers scale operations through system implementation, leveraged buyouts and acquisitions, and strategic reengineering. Its work spans aftermarket solutions for luxury and performance vehicles, motorsport investment services, consulting, and automotive event venues, alongside franchise concepts and training programs tied to restoration and industry operations.

Mimi's Caring Angels is a Texas-licensed in-home care provider that has served the Houston area for more than 25 years, with caregiving experience that the company says spans more than 35 years. The business focuses on private-duty support for older adults and other clients who need help at home, offering companionship, sitting services, personal care, bathing and showering assistance, light housekeeping, shopping help, transportation, and support with therapist-recommended exercises. Mimi's Caring Angels also states that its care team includes RNs, LVNs, CNAs, NAs, and sitters, and that service is built around dependable, compassionate home support.

A-1 Affinity Care is a Houston-based provider of Home and Community-based Services for individuals with intellectual developmental disabilities and related conditions. The company’s service lines include day habilitation, dental care, minor home modifications, nursing, professional therapies, residential assistance, respite care, and supported employment. A-1 Affinity Care says its mission is to serve, empower, and integrate individuals with IDD/RC by supporting health, safety, welfare, and community inclusion. The company’s leadership page says A-1 Affinity Care was founded after years of healthcare and educational work supporting people with intellectual developmental disabilities.

Public business records identify Luxury Tax Empire Clothing, LLC as a Texas clothing company. The company’s filing history shows a limited liability entity organized under Texas law, with records later listing the business as forfeited existence. Available public profiles point to an apparel-focused operation rather than a diversified business, which places the company within the clothing and fashion retail vertical.

Blackstone Industries was established in 1976 and has grown into a family of brands centered on quality tools and service for a broad customer base. The company focuses on precision tools and related products for artisans, with a portfolio that includes brands such as Foredom Electric Co., Zona Tool Co., Olson Saw Company, and Handler Manufacturing. Its business spans tool manufacturing and brand management, and its public materials describe a wide customer reach that serves makers and craftsmen through specialized product lines.

Infinity Fuels Inc. began in early 2024 as a woman-owned fuel supplier founded by two entrepreneurs with combined experience in the fuel sector. The company focuses on fuel delivery and refueling services, including emergency fueling, fleet fueling, marine fueling, aviation fueling, construction and pipeline fueling, generator fueling, tank and equipment rental, and on-site diesel refueling. Infinity Fuels Inc. also offers gasoline, diesel, red diesel, bio-diesel, and DEF services through its commercial fueling operations. The business presents itself as serving Houston and surrounding areas while emphasizing reliability and customer service in industrial and commercial fuel supply.

Turnkey PMC LLC is a Texas real estate firm focused on brokerage services for residential and commercial properties. The business supports buying, selling, rentals, leasing, and property marketing, and actively represents clients across for-sale and for-rent transactions. Turnkey PMC LLC maintains a market presence around Houston, with services centered on helping clients navigate property transactions and market access.

THV Insurance was established in Houston in 2020 as an independent insurance agency. The company focuses on personal and commercial coverage, including auto, home, commercial, flood, life, and health insurance products. Public materials also describe licensing in Texas and Georgia, along with services aimed at helping residents compare and manage coverage options. The company presents a broad insurance-services profile centered on policy placement, customer support, and agency offerings for households and businesses.

PHH Mortgage, a wholly owned subsidiary of Ocwen Financial Corporation, is one of the largest subservicers of residential mortgages in the United States. PHH Mortgage provides servicing solutions to companies who own mortgage servicing rights and offers portfolio retention services to extend and enhance customer relationships. The company has been providing mortgage lending and servicing solutions since 1984 and is dedicated to maintaining responsible and ethical practices while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

PHH Mortgage strictly focuses on subservicing and portfolio retention. This allows their diverse professional clients – representing some of the largest and most recognizable financial and wealth management institutions, investors of MSRs, regional and community banks, and credit unions – to concentrate on their core businesses, while providing borrowers with exceptional customer service throughout the life of their loans.

Noble Psychiatry is a mental health practice centered on psychiatry, psychotherapy, and medication management. The practice website presents Eric Noble, MD, MPH, as the physician behind the service and describes an approach built around a trusting, collaborative patient relationship. Areas of training and expertise listed by the practice include anxiety, depression, OCD, ADHD, PTSD, mania, psychosis, addiction, transcranial magnetic stimulation, mindfulness meditation, maternal mental health, sports psychiatry, motivational interviewing, public health employer-sponsored health programs, and insomnia care. The company also offers telepsychiatry visits through a HIPAA-secure platform and states that appointments are handled on a self-pay basis with superbill receipts available for possible insurance reimbursement.

Lighthouse Mental Health Counseling, PLLC is a mental health counseling practice that was started to support people navigating mental health challenges and life difficulties. The practice offers telehealth appointments, online payment options, and new-client scheduling, with services that include therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, LGBTQIA+ concerns, ADHD, panic disorders, stress, and suicidal ideation. Lighthouse Mental Health Counseling also lists approaches such as cognitive behavioral therapy, family and marital therapy, person-centered therapy, motivational interviewing, multicultural psychotherapy, and trauma-focused care, showing a broad counseling focus across individual and couples services.

E.A. Insurance & Income Tax presents itself as a bilingual insurance agency and tax preparation company with more than 18 years of experience. The business focuses on personal and business tax services, including personal tax preparation, business tax preparation, partnerships and corporations, franchise and sales tax, notary public services, and business formation support. On the insurance side, the company offers coverage options for auto, home, commercial, business, life, flood, motorcycle, boat, and pet insurance, reflecting a broader financial-services mix built around insurance placement and tax support.

Sage3 Insurance Group, LLC was organized in Texas as a limited liability company and has operated from Houston since its formation in 2017. Public business directories describe the firm as part of the insurance agents, brokers, and related services segment, with a focus that includes fire, marine, and casualty insurance. Available listings also indicate that Sage3 Insurance Group serves customers through an independent-agency model, providing access to policies from multiple carriers and covering personal and commercial insurance needs.

Independent AV & Video began in 1992 and has built its business around audio visual and multimedia support for organizations, businesses, conferences, projects, and training. The company’s services include corporate event audio visual production, streaming, content creation, consulting, virtual meetings, hybrid events, hosting and moderation, back-room support, presenter coordination, and post-event distribution of recorded meetings. Its website describes a focus on mission-critical AV and multimedia work, with an emphasis on planning, equipment selection, and support tailored to event needs rather than one-size-fits-all packages. Public listings and the company’s site both present the business as a long-running provider of AV, video, audio, and media production services for professional event use.

Advantis Medical Imaging began in 2016 as a developer of AI-driven MRI analysis software. The company specializes in creating automated tools for brain and prostate MRI exams that assist radiologists with diagnostic processes. Advantis Medical Imaging's cloud-based platform integrates with existing healthcare systems and provides quantitative imaging analysis. The company serves multidisciplinary medical teams by streamlining workflows and enabling more accurate pathology detection. Advantis Medical Imaging operates in the medical technology sector with a focus on improving diagnostic imaging through innovation.

Stori began as a mental health therapy practice built around accessible, compassionate support and a storytelling-centered approach to care. The company offers individual therapy, couples therapy, family therapy, child and teen support, and EMDR-informed services, with care available online across California and in-person in several Los Angeles-area communities. Stori describes a focus on people who are often overlooked by mainstream systems, including BIPOC, LGBTQ+, veterans, seniors, undocumented immigrants, and health care workers. The business presents itself as a collaborative practice that helps clients work through anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, relationship concerns, life transitions, and other common mental health challenges.

Olive Street Capital Partners provides discretionary investment management and consulting services for high-net-worth individuals, family offices, pooled investment vehicles, and institutional clients. The company's advisory work includes portfolio analysis, asset allocation, portfolio construction, securities selection, and ongoing monitoring. Olive Street Capital Partners began as a California investment adviser and later expanded its regulatory footprint through SEC registration, building a market presence centered on fee-based wealth management and investment advisory services.

Callas & Carlson was founded in 1990 as a full-service business management firm focused on clients in the entertainment industry. The firm provides general bookkeeping, bill paying, tax preparation, planning and representation, coordination of investment and estate planning, insurance monitoring, guild reporting, cash budgeting, and financial reporting. Callas & Carlson has grown around a boutique model that keeps client relationships selective and personal while maintaining a broad mix of accounting and financial management services. The business operates from Los Angeles and serves entertainment professionals through advisory and administrative support across multiple financial functions.

Westside Music Conservatory is a West Los Angeles music school that offers private, semi-private, and group lessons in piano, strings, winds and brass, percussion, voice, and guitar. The company also provides theory group classes, chamber music, master classes, recital events, and preparation for external music examinations, while supporting students through a sheet music shop and parking validation for visitors. The conservatory runs lessons, theory classes, and master classes, demonstrating a focus on music education, ensemble work, and performance programming in the Los Angeles area.

Nelson Duffie Interests has a proven track record in the acquisition of existing "value add" improved properties and the turnkey development of multi-tenant and freestanding industrial facilities. Their collective experience allows them to offer a full range of services, including site selection, land acquisition, project design, project financing, construction, utility coordination, marketing, management and much more. They have strong ties and strategic relationships with the brokerage community, lenders, contractors, engineers and architects as well, as key corporations and individuals in the community.
What does all this add up to? Intellectual Capital. It’s hard to put in words all that they have gained in their collective 60 years working in the Houston real estate market, but each day, all that knowledge, experience, insight and creativity is put into practice on behalf of their projects and clients.

Chateau Construction is a Houston-based construction firm associated with residential building and remodeling work. Public business listings place the company in the 77057 area and describe its services in single-family home construction and site work, indicating a focus on home-oriented projects and related contractor services. Directory profiles also describe the business as long established in Houston, suggesting a sustained presence in the local construction market.

Perdenales Production was established in 2006 in Houston, Texas. The company specializes in oil and gas exploration and production, with operations targeting the Ardmore Basin of Oklahoma, South Louisiana, and South Texas regions. Perdenales Production concentrates on acquiring and developing oil and gas properties while maintaining a strategic presence in key energy-producing areas.

profile.locationBio: The Law Offices of Solis Cooperson is a boutique law firm based in Los Angeles, California, serving clients throughout Southern California for more than 35 years. The firm provides legal services across a range of practice areas, including tax law and tax preparation, estate planning and trust and estate litigation, business formation and transactions, family law, and civil litigation. The firm assists individuals, professionals, business owners, and clients in the entertainment industry with both personal and business-related legal matters. Led by founding attorney Solis Cooperson, the practice is known for its depth of experience in taxation matters, supported by advanced education in business, accounting, and economics, as well as prior experience with a large CPA firm and the Internal Revenue Service. The firm emphasizes a personalized, client-focused approach, developing tailored legal strategies designed to meet client objectives efficiently and cost-effectively.

Immco Investments LLC is a privately held financial services and investment firm founded in 2011 and headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The firm specializes in EB-5 financing and private real estate investment, serving as a lender and investment principal for hospitality, residential, and mixed-use development projects across the United States. Immco provides end-to-end capital solutions, including project structuring, due diligence coordination, and compliance oversight related to the EB-5 Immigrant Investor Program. The firm has facilitated investments from a global investor base and reports having over $600 million in capital invested across multiple projects. In addition to EB-5 financing, Immco Investments is active in private equity and real estate financing, supporting developers with alternative capital sources. The company operates as a for-profit investment entity and maintains international relationships to support cross-border capital deployment into U.S. projects.

SELG, formally known as Smith Entertainment Law Group, is a boutique entertainment law firm founded in 2021 with offices in Los Angeles and New York. The firm provides legal representation across all major segments of the entertainment and media industry, including television, film, music, live events, technology, and new media. SELG is particularly known for representing producers and production companies in television variety and awards shows, scripted and unscripted series, live music events, and large-scale media productions. The firm also offers in-house general counsel services for entertainment, technology, and startup companies, covering business affairs, intellectual property, labor and employment, and day-to-day legal advisory needs. Additional practice areas include copyright and trademark matters, music publishing and recording agreements, film finance, name-image-and-likeness (NIL) transactions, and digital content and licensing deals. SELG operates as a full-service legal partner to entertainment creators and companies across traditional and emerging platforms.

TRIO-US (Translational Research in Oncology – United States) is a national clinical research network that brings advanced cancer clinical trials to patients through community-based oncology practices across the United States. The organization connects independent medical oncology practices with academic researchers, industry partners, and clinical investigators to accelerate access to innovative cancer therapies while allowing patients to receive care close to home. 
TRIO-US partners with more than ten participating oncology practices nationwide and maintains a long-standing affiliation with UCLA, enabling collaboration with clinician-scientists on early-phase and translational cancer research. The network supports the development, execution, and oversight of oncology clinical trials, working closely with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical research partners. 
Through its collaborative model, TRIO-US aims to advance scientific discovery, expand patient access to cutting-edge treatments, and contribute meaningful research outcomes to the broader oncology community.

Intellectual Property Group (IPG) is a Los Angeles–based entertainment and intellectual property management firm. The company specializes in representing film and television rights for authors, screenwriters, and creative properties, facilitating the optioning and development of intellectual property for adaptation across media platforms. IPG works closely with studios, networks, and producers to package and monetize literary and creative assets for film and television production.

Braunstein & Braunstein, PC is a full service boutique law firm that provides a wide range of legal services, covering both transactional and litigation matters. Braunstein & Braunstein, PC has a broad transactional practice that cuts across many different industry lines. Major practice areas include entertainment, healthcare, intellectual property, real estate and trusts and estates. However, through cross-practice and collaboration, their attorneys have the knowledge and expertise to cover any area of law. The attorneys at Braunstein & Braunstein, PC also offer extensive litigation experience spanning various areas of substantive law.

Corridor Capital is a Los Angeles–based private equity firm founded in 2005 that invests in lower middle-market, owner-operated companies, primarily within the business services and distribution sectors. The firm partners closely with entrepreneurs and management teams, taking an operationally intensive approach to value creation by supporting strategy, infrastructure development, financial controls, and scalable growth initiatives. Corridor Capital typically acquires controlling interests through its private equity strategy, while also offering structured equity solutions designed to provide liquidity, flexibility, and growth capital for founders and family-owned businesses. With a dedicated in-house operations team, the firm collaborates with portfolio company leadership to professionalize operations and pursue organic and acquisition-driven expansion. Corridor Capital is recognized for its hands-on partnership model and long-term focus on building durable, institutionally ready businesses.

Alan K. Rubin, CPA, APC is a certified public accounting firm located in Los Angeles. The firm provides personalized accounting and tax services to individuals, families, and businesses, with an emphasis on accuracy, compliance, and practical financial guidance. Led by Alan K. Rubin, CPA, the practice focuses on delivering dependable professional service while building long-term client relationships based on trust and responsiveness. Through a client-centered approach, the firm supports ongoing financial planning, tax strategy, and regulatory needs with attention to each client’s specific circumstances.

The Seaver Institute is a private philanthropic foundation founded in 1955 and based in Los Angeles, California. The Institute is dedicated to providing early-stage “seed” funding to highly regarded organizations and individuals pursuing innovative, high-risk projects with the potential to significantly advance research, knowledge, or societal outcomes. Rather than offering long-term operating support, The Seaver Institute typically funds the initial two to three years of a project to help establish proof of concept, with the expectation that successful initiatives will attract additional funding from other sources. The Institute supports a broad range of fields, including scientific research, education, and other charitable endeavors, and operates as a private, non-operating foundation. Its grantmaking approach emphasizes creativity, interdisciplinary thinking, and novel ideas that may not yet qualify for traditional funding channels.

Endeavor began in 2009 through the merger of the William Morris Agency and Endeavor Talent Agency, creating a company built around talent representation and media services. The business later expanded across film, television, music, theater, digital media, publishing, and sports, reflecting a broad mix of entertainment and agency verticals. Endeavor has also operated platforms and businesses tied to sports and entertainment content management, adding technology-enabled services alongside its agency and media operations. The company operates under the WME Group branding, while the core business remains centered on representing talent and managing media and sports-related assets.

Little Wing World is an independent creator of interactive, music-driven educational entertainment for children and families. The company develops immersive digital experiences—including mobile apps, e-books, and virtual worlds—designed to help children connect across cultures through a shared language of music. Founded by Nicolle Ruetz, Little Wing World is best known for its flagship universe, Whistlers World, which blends storytelling, music composition, and global cultural exploration to promote creativity, empathy, and collaboration among young users. 
At the core of Little Wing World’s offerings is a patented Words-to-Music translation technology, which allows children speaking different languages to communicate and create music together. Through its interactive products, including music-composition apps and multiplayer virtual environments, the company focuses on educational play that encourages respect for cultural diversity, environmental awareness, and emotional development.

Selva Ventures is a venture capital firm founded in 2019 that invests in early-stage branded consumer companies focused on healthier living and wellness-oriented products. The firm partners with founders at the Seed and Series A stages, typically backing companies with under $10 million in annual revenue, and provides both growth capital and operational support. Selva Ventures concentrates on categories such as food and beverage, beauty and personal care, wellness, pet products, apparel, and home goods, with an emphasis on product quality, efficacy, and consumer trust. The firm’s investment approach is centered on long-term brand building, leveraging deep sector specialization, fundamental diligence, and hands-on strategic resources across retail, supply chain, and operations. Selva Ventures operates as a private investment partnership and positions itself as a founder-aligned investor focused on sustainable growth within the global consumer economy.

KB&T Tax and Consulting, Inc. was established in 2013 with the goal of delivering the highest quality professional services combined with exceptional personal attention.
The firm recognizes that every client is unique and fosters individualized relationships built on trust and responsiveness. KB&T’s growth reflects the success of its clients, which the firm views as the most meaningful measure of service quality. A commitment to continuous innovation and creative problem-solving ensures ongoing value for those it serves.
KB&T Tax and Consulting, Inc. offers a full spectrum of accounting, tax, and business management services. By blending the technical capabilities of a large firm with the accessibility and responsiveness of a smaller practice, the firm develops long-standing and successful client relationships.
The firm’s professionals are active members of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the California Society of Certified Public Accountants, and they adhere to the organizations’ professional rules and standards. These affiliations ensure clients receive objective, ethical, and high-quality professional guidance and advice.

My Meal Cafe began as a neighborhood eatery in Los Angeles, California. The company focuses on providing wholesome, homemade meals with Russian culinary influences. The menu features breakfast items, lunch specials, and snacks. My Meal Cafe operates through both delivery and pickup models, serving the Los Angeles area with a menu built around fresh ingredients and traditional recipes.

Rosenberg Law is a California law firm built around Alexander Rosenberg's long-running legal practice, and the firm focuses on personal injury, workers' compensation, employment law, criminal defense, and related dispute work. The firm handles motor vehicle accidents, truck and pedestrian collisions, premises liability, wrongful death, elder abuse, uninsured and underinsured motorist disputes, and DUI, misdemeanor, and felony defense, reflecting a broad litigation focus across injury and defense matters. The firm maintains a wider practice history across multiple states, with legal experience spanning more than three decades and a client base centered on accident, injury, and defense representation.

profile.locationBio: Buchholz, Harris, Levine & Brennan operates as a civil litigation firm with concentration in healthcare provider defense. The firm represents medical professionals in malpractice claims and administrative hearings. Practice areas extend to employment disputes, commercial litigation, and business contracts. The firm serves healthcare facilities and various business clients while maintaining a focus on healthcare law.

Salem & Associates LLP has been providing professional legal services for over a decade, focusing on delivering quality representation and personalized attention. The firm maintains a lean structure to serve clients efficiently in diverse legal matters.

Fairbank, Maslin, Maullin is a political consulting firm established in 1981. The company specializes in campaign management and strategic consulting for political and governmental issues. Douglas Emmett is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol DEI. Between 1971 and 1991, Dan Emmett and partners formed three real estate companies, which collaboratively engaged in the acquisition, development, redevelopment, operation and management of real estate assets within supply-constrained markets in Los Angeles County. While the early focus was on multifamily properties, the Company's investment focus evolved to include office properties and complementary retail space in California and Honolulu, Hawaii. Between 1993 and 2006, Douglas Emmett acquired a substantial majority of its portfolio through nine institutional funds, and in 2006, the company went public.

The company owns and operates two asset classes: Class A office and multifamily apartments. Through its interest in its Operating Partnership and its subsidiaries and consolidated JVs, it owns and operates approximately 18 million square feet of Class A office space and over 5,000 apartment units within the coastal submarkets of Los Angeles and Honolulu. The business strategy is to select submarkets that are supply constrained, with high barriers to entry, key lifestyle amenities, proximity to high-end executive housing and a diverse economic base, then follow an acquisition strategy of gaining substantial market share.

Ameli Law Group began as the Law Offices of Mark K. Ameli and traces its history to 1980. The firm focuses on personal injury, workers’ compensation, business matters, and contract work, including entertainment and music contracts, as well as business and business litigation. The company's services include video production, digital marketing, and media placement across various platforms. Cannella Media has created several television networks featuring brokered programming and direct response commercials.

Kerendian & Associates began in the mid-1990s as a Los Angeles-based law firm and later grew into a multi-attorney practice through client satisfaction and referrals. The firm focuses on business litigation, real estate litigation, and medical and dental litigation, giving the practice a defined mix of commercial and professional-client work. Public firm descriptions also note representation for businesses, corporations, partnerships, trustees, executors, nonprofits, and individuals, which reflects a broad litigation and advisory presence.

As part of the Jianghai Group, the company benefits from extensive global production capabilities and distribution networks. The company maintains significant operations in both China and international markets.

SNS Law Group is a Los Angeles–based law firm focused on real estate, landlord-tenant, and business-related legal matters. The firm was founded in 2022 by attorneys Edrin Shamtob and Bijan Shakibkoo with the objective of combining transactional real estate knowledge with litigation experience. SNS Law Group represents property owners, landlords, investors, and businesses in matters including unlawful detainer actions, habitability disputes, lease enforcement, real estate transactions, and business litigation.
The firm’s practice spans both contested and non-contested legal proceedings, with work that includes commercial and residential property disputes, contract matters, and corporate litigation. In addition to real estate litigation, SNS Law Group advises clients on property acquisitions, lease negotiations, and ownership-related legal strategy under California law. The firm operates as a privately held partnership and serves clients primarily across Southern California. Its attorneys are licensed in California and maintain memberships in professional legal associations.

MG Partners LLP is a Los Angeles-based accounting and tax services firm providing tax preparation, bookkeeping, financial planning, and related advisory services. The firm serves individuals and businesses and is associated with CPA Argin Gharibian, who specializes in tax compliance and financial consulting.

Ambassador Health Care Inc. provides long-term care and rehabilitation services in California. Established as a locally-owned facility, it offers personalized care plans and maintains a family atmosphere. Services include skilled nursing, ventilator care, and dementia units. The facility also provides 24-hour respiratory therapy and RN staffing. Ambassador Healthcare emphasizes quality of life through various activities and dietary accommodations.

SERP Matrix launched a new marketing agency website in 2018, marking the company’s public entry into digital marketing services. SERP Matrix focuses on search engine optimization, pay-per-click advertising, web design and development, social media marketing, content writing, reputation management, and related online marketing work for businesses across a range of industries. The company presents itself as a full-service agency that builds tailored campaigns for business clients, combining consultation, keyword research, on-page and off-page optimization, directory submissions, and mobile application development to support visibility, traffic, and customer engagement.

The company’s platform highlights pricing guidance, MLS and IDX exposure, professional photography, drone footage, video tours, sign and lockbox setup, and contract and closing support for homeowners. NXTSQFT.com also presents related offerings in mortgage, property claims, commercial real estate, property management, and solar through its broader site navigation. Public-facing pages describe a fully online listing model with licensed Realtor support and a process built around quick listing setup, market updates, and transaction assistance.

Right Decision Regulatory Consulting, based in Houston, Texas, offers specialized consulting services for the oil and gas industry, focusing on regulatory compliance, land management, pipeline integrity, and environmental health and safety. The firm provides tailored strategies to help energy companies navigate complex regulations and maintain operational efficiency. With a team of seasoned experts, it delivers practical solutions to minimize risk, protect assets, and ensure compliance across all stages of energy operations. Committed to responsiveness and quality, Right Decision Regulatory Consulting positions itself as a trusted partner for businesses seeking reliable guidance in meeting industry and government requirements.

Mashcole Property Management, Inc. is strictly a third-party property management company focused on the Southern California markets. The company is hired by a variety of third-party clients ranging from institutional level investors to “mom and pop” investors. Their goal is to oversee the day-to-day operations and management responsibilities of their multi-family portfolios/properties.

Mashcole’s key personnel have extensive experience in the management of assets. These include projects requiring repositioning, due diligence, strong resident retention requirements and lease ups. Mashcole also coordinates renovation projects, which have ranged from $2,500 per unit to $25,000 per unit and up. The company was formed in 2004 and currently manages over 175 apartment communities totaling more than 4,000 units.

ETS Glass Island is a privately held glass fabrication and installation company based in Houston, Texas. The business operates under the legal entity ETS Glass Island LLC, which was formed in Texas in August 2023. The company provides custom glass and mirror solutions for residential and commercial applications, including shower enclosures, stair and balcony systems, patio enclosures, storefronts, office partitions, and interior glass features.
Operating from its Hempstead Road facility, ETS Glass Island offers in-house fabrication and on-site installation services. Publicly available materials indicate the company supports a range of glazing services such as glass cutting, tempering coordination, and hardware supply in support of custom design projects. Its work spans both new installations and replacement or retrofit projects for homes and businesses.
ETS Glass Island serves the Houston metropolitan area and surrounding communities and maintains an online presence showcasing completed projects and service offerings. The company is privately owned and does not trade on a public exchange.

TEXMA is an oilfield equipment manufacturer and supplier operating in Houston, Texas. The company conducts business through Texma Drilling Supply LLC, a Texas-registered limited liability company formed in 2022, and markets its products globally under the TEXMA brand. TEXMA specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of direct-replacement OEM-quality mud pump fluid end parts, expendables, and related drilling components used in oil and gas operations.
According to company materials, TEXMA maintains its corporate headquarters and primary inventory in Houston, where it supports domestic and international customers. Its product range includes mud pumps, fluid end modules, liners, valves, pistons, and other high-wear components designed to operate under high pressure, temperature, and corrosive conditions common in drilling environments. The company emphasizes compliance with API and ISO standards and highlights in-house machining and quality control processes.
TEXMA operates as a privately held company and does not trade on a public exchange. Public filings and business records associate the Hempstead Road location with inventory storage, light manufacturing, and distribution functions supporting oilfield service customers worldwide.

Matrix Stone USA is a privately held wholesale stone and mosaic supplier based in Houston, Texas. The company operates as Matrix Stone USA and focuses on selling marble and glass mosaics, along with related decorative stone products. Publicly available company materials indicate offerings that include artisan glass mosaics, marble mosaic tile, waterjet design products, and river rock selections. The business maintains a showroom and contact location on Hempstead Road in Houston, which is also listed as the registered agent address for its Texas corporation filing.
Matrix Stone USA is organized as a Texas for-profit corporation formed in August 2013. State business records list Kenan Yang as the registered agent and company contact associated with the Hempstead Road address. The company provides sales contact information via its website and includes product category navigation for mosaic and decorative stone lines. Dun & Bradstreet’s business directory lists the firm within building finishing and tile-related categories and identifies a sales representative contact, reflecting ongoing commercial activity.
Matrix Stone USA operates as a private company and does not trade on a public exchange.

Navitas Assurance Partners provides energy assurance solutions that use trade credit insurance and commercial surety to support liquidity, optionality, and credit management in energy markets. The company works with brokers and carriers across trade credit, surety, and energy-related insurance placements, and its offerings include off-balance-sheet alternatives to cash posting and letters of credit. Navitas serves producers, marketers, power participants, and other market counterparties with tools designed for inbound and outbound assurance needs. Overall, Navitas Assurance Partners focuses on the alternative assurance market for energy applications, with services centered on underwriting performance, market liquidity, and collateral optimization.

We love helping people reconnect with those they love through better hearing. Our passion is helping you hear better so you can enjoy your passions, too.

Our professionals are skilled at fitting and programming hearing aids based on your hearing test results. We use the most advanced fitting methods and equipment to make sure you hear with maximum clarity.

Orser & Henson is a Houston-based certified public accounting firm that provides accounting support for individuals and businesses. The firm offers tax preparation, audit services, and consulting. Thomas Orser and Cory Henson are practicing CPAs at the company. The firm operates under the Orser & Henson name and uses that branding.

Prime Management is a Houston-area commercial real estate company that provides leasing, development, and property management services for businesses across the Greater Houston market. The company focuses on commercial buildings, office parks, and shopping complexes, and offers retail space search, tenant build-outs, and help with permitting and architecture. Prime Management has operated in the Houston area for over 30 years and has helped clients find commercial space for nearly 40 years, reflecting a long-running presence in local commercial real estate.

Odyssey Title also offers fully remote, paperless closings and remote online notary services, supported by a digital platform designed for streamlined documentation and compliant processing. The company serves investors, lenders, attorneys, real estate agents, and homeowners, with an emphasis on fast, accurate closings and responsive service.

The company's product line centers on precast concrete panel tanks with integrated liner systems and flexible sizing, and the offering is positioned for applications in oil and gas, mining, water, and waste management. Concept Tanks positions its systems as a rapid-deployment alternative to earthen pits and ponds, with engineered solutions that support relocation, resizing, leak detection, and reduced site preparation. The company also offers industrial, rental, and utility tank solutions, along with floating covers and other fluid-management components.

Xceed Office provides private offices, executive suites, meeting rooms, virtual office plans, and flexible office rentals for businesses seeking a professional workspace. The company focuses on workspace solutions that support professionals, business owners, entrepreneurs, consultants, and teams. Its offerings center on furnished office environments, business addresses, mail handling, live receptionist services, and meeting space use. Xceed Office maintains a market presence around Houston and emphasizes flexible workspace options for organizations that need a polished office setting.

Founded in 2005, Title Houston Holdings (“Title Houston”) is a locally owned and managed independent title agency. They work with the nation’s top underwriters to protect the rights of the parties who close transactions with them. Title Houston Chairman, John H. Duncan, Jr. and President/Co-Founder Frank Vandiver are lifelong Houstonians committed to serving the Houston community. They especially care for commercial and residential customers investing in their community and their fine team of local professionals.

Siebert Williams Shank & Co. began in 1996 as Siebert Brandford Shank, founded by Muriel Siebert, Napoleon Brandford III, and Suzanne Shank, and later took its current name after a merger with Williams Capital Group. The company operates as an independent non-bank financial services firm, with services spanning investment banking, sales and trading, research, and advisory work. Its business is organized around corporate finance, municipal finance, and sales, trading, and research, reflecting a focus on capital markets for public and private companies as well as government-related issuers. Today, the firm maintains a broad national presence and is active in both municipal and corporate underwriting.

Superpath began as High Level Marketing and later rebranded under the Superpath name after more than 17 years in business, keeping a focus on marketing for home-service companies. The company works with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, restoration, roofing, and related skilled-trade businesses, offering services that include search engine optimization, paid search, social media management, website design, video marketing, and content marketing. Superpath helps contractors build visibility across search, maps, social channels, and AI-driven discovery so homeowners can find and book services more easily.

Convergent Science is an innovative, rapidly expanding computational fluid dynamics (CFD) company. Their flagship product, CONVERGE, is a revolutionary CFD software with truly autonomous meshing capabilities that eliminate the grid generation bottleneck from the simulation process. Convergent Science is headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, and has offices in the United States, Europe, and India and distributors worldwide.

Their mission is to enable their customers to perform revolutionary CFD simulations by creating accurate, versatile, user-friendly software and providing unparalleled support. In 1997, Convergent Science’s co-founders were University of Wisconsin-Madison graduate students with an idea, an idea that has grown into a complex multi-physics platform with a global network of users in industry, academia, and government.

The company describes a business built on market knowledge, operational channels, and relationships with oil trading partners and financial institutions, reflecting a focus on oil trading and related support services. Their offerings include comprehensive financial planning, investment management, and ongoing portfolio monitoring. Titan serves a diverse clientele by tailoring services to individual financial goals and risk tolerance. The company emphasizes strategic planning for long-term financial stability.

Carlyle Financial is a mortgage lender and full-service mortgage bank focused on jumbo and super jumbo home loans, as well as purchase, refinance, and investment-property financing. The company works through partnerships with community banks, credit unions, and regional banks in California, and it tailors loan options for borrowers with nontraditional income, self-employment, or real estate investment needs. The firm serves healthcare organizations across the country and works with roles ranging from registered nurses to therapists, case managers, and administrative staff.

Antares is a privately held industrial automation and information technology services firm headquartered in Houston, Texas. Founded in 2013, the company provides automation, engineering, and digital solutions primarily to industrial and manufacturing clients, with a strong focus on steel, pipe, and tube production operations. Antares supports the full project lifecycle, including consulting, system design, implementation, commissioning, and ongoing technical support.
The company’s service offerings include industrial automation and controls, industrial software development, cybersecurity and infrastructure services, custom electrical panel design, tailored technical training, and specialized recruitment for industrial and engineering roles. Antares operates with a multidisciplinary team and maintains partnerships with affiliated Antares companies in Latin America, enabling cross-border project execution and technical collaboration.
In 2023, Antares expanded its Houston operations with the opening of new offices and a technical warehouse, supporting growth in engineering services and business unit diversification. The company remains privately held and continues to operate from its Houston headquarters.
