Sadikoff & Kanter, LLP is a boutique firm based in Los Angeles, CA, offering expert services in financial transactions processing and advisory functions related to depository banking. With a focus on precision and client trust, the firm supports complex financial operations and strategic banking solutions for individuals and organizations.

Upland Workshop began as an independent strategic advisory firm in 2020. The company specializes in communications strategy, content creation, and modernization of systems. They help clients align their narrative with business goals. Their services include strategic communications, media campaigns, and partnership development. The firm works across various sectors including sports, entertainment, and finance. Upland Workshop has built a reputation for creating value through strategic advisory services.

Well People was established in 2008 and has become a prominent name in the clean beauty industry. The company specializes in creating plant-powered makeup and skincare products that are cruelty-free and dermatologist-developed. Their extensive product range includes foundations, mascaras, and various skincare items, all verified by the Environmental Working Group. Well People emphasizes sustainability through ethical sourcing practices while maintaining product quality. The brand continues to serve a growing market of consumers seeking responsible beauty solutions.

Raanan Dental Group Brentwood is a periodontal and dental implant practice led by Dr. Justin Raanan, a board-certified periodontist based in Los Angeles and Beverly Hills. The practice provides specialized services related to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of periodontal disease, as well as surgical placement of dental implants and related procedures. Dr. Raanan completed his dental education at the University of Southern California and advanced specialty training in periodontology at Harvard School of Dental Medicine, where he also earned a Master of Medical Sciences degree.

Frankie Neman is a privately held dental practice providing general, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry services in Los Angeles. The practice is led by Dr. Frankie Neman, who has been practicing dentistry since 1997 after earning a Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from the UCLA School of Dentistry. In 2020, Dr. Neman assumed leadership of the practice following the retirement of Dr. Gary Salenger, who had operated at the same location for several decades.
The practice offers preventive dental care, restorative treatments, and cosmetic procedures, including crowns, veneers, Invisalign, dental implants, and general oral health maintenance. Its clinical approach incorporates minimally invasive techniques and considers overall health factors alongside traditional dental care.

Timothy B McCaffey is a physician-led psychiatric practice based in Los Angeles, California. The practice is operated by Timothy Barry McCaffey, a medical doctor specializing in psychiatry. Clinical services focus on the diagnosis and treatment of mental health conditions through psychiatric evaluation, psychotherapy, and medication management.
Dr. McCaffey received his medical degree from the Perelman School of Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania and completed postgraduate psychiatric training in California. He is licensed to practice medicine in the state of California and is registered in the National Provider Identifier database as an individual healthcare provider. The practice operates as a sole proprietorship and provides outpatient psychiatric care to adult patients.

Lisa Halotek is a Los Angeles–based mental health practice led by licensed psychologist and psychoanalyst Lisa Halotek, Psy.D. The practice provides outpatient psychological services, including psychotherapy and psychoanalytic treatment, serving adult individuals in a clinical office setting on the Westside of Los Angeles. Dr. Halotek holds advanced clinical training in psychology, social work, and psychoanalysis, and maintains licensure in California.
Public professional records indicate that Dr. Halotek established her clinical practice in the mid-2000s, with formal provider registration dating to 2007. In addition to clinical work, she has been involved in professional psychoanalytic organizations and has held leadership and committee roles within national and regional associations related to psychoanalysis and mental health education.

The Palisades Dentists provides general, cosmetic, specialty, and senior care dentistry, with services that include preventive and diagnostic care, restorative treatment, implants, sleep dentistry, and oral surgery. The practice emphasizes minimally invasive, evidence-based, holistic care and uses digital x-rays, 3-D imaging, digital scanning, and laser technology to support treatment. The practice has maintained a multi-year presence serving dental patients and sharing oral-health information since 2017.

The practice operates from its West Los Angeles office on San Vicente Boulevard and is registered as a sole-provider clinical psychology entity. Public records indicate continuous active status since initial incorporation, reflecting long-term operation in the Los Angeles market. In addition to clinical services, Dr. Poulter has engaged in professional writing and public speaking related to psychology and family dynamics, including the publication of multiple books addressing parental and adolescent relationships.
The organization is privately held and is not publicly traded. Operations appear centralized to a single office location, with no disclosed parent organization. The practice functions primarily as an outpatient mental health services provider within the behavioral health sector.

The company focuses on elective and medically necessary dental procedures, including cosmetic restorations, dental implants, and general dental care, with services delivered from its Brentwood-area office.
The practice integrates conventional dental treatments with a holistic approach, emphasizing biocompatible materials and metal-free options where appropriate. Luxe Dental Cosmetics operates an in-house dental laboratory, allowing for direct fabrication of restorations such as veneers and crowns. Over time, the practice has expanded its service offerings to include full-arch implant procedures and same-day emergency dental care.
Luxe Dental Cosmetics is independently owned and operated and does not trade on a public exchange. The company primarily serves patients in the greater Los Angeles area and has built its operations around a single clinical location rather than a multi-office network.

Founded in 1991 by dentist Dr. Jay Grossman, the organization was established to address unmet dental needs among individuals experiencing homelessness and financial hardship. The organization provides a range of dental services, including examinations, cleanings, fillings, extractions, and dentures, with an emphasis on restoring oral health and function. Over time, Homeless Not Toothless has developed referral relationships with public agencies, shelters, and veterans’ organizations to connect eligible patients with care. The nonprofit has also collaborated with community partners and educational institutions to support service delivery and clinical training initiatives.
Homeless Not Toothless is privately held as a nonprofit entity and has been recognized in media coverage and charitable directories for its sustained operations and longevity. Its activities are overseen by a board of directors that includes its founder and other individuals from healthcare and philanthropic backgrounds.

Dr. Cavell holds a PhD in Clinical Psychology and is registered with the National Provider Identifier registry as an individual healthcare provider. The practice operates under the Wilker Orthopedic & Spine Institute name and provides outpatient orthopedic and surgical consultations. Dr. Wilker maintains hospital affiliations with several Southern California medical centers and performs surgical procedures at affiliated facilities. In addition to clinical care, Dr. Wilker has participated in academic research and professional presentations within the orthopedic and spine surgery field, including conference podium and poster presentations.

The practice operates from its Los Angeles location in the Brentwood area and serves patients referred by general dentists and other dental professionals. Clinical services are delivered using diagnostic imaging and endodontic treatment technologies commonly used in specialty dental care.

Primary Integrative Dentistry is a privately held dental practice based in Los Angeles, California. The practice provides general, restorative, cosmetic, and prosthodontic dental services, with an emphasis on integrative and whole-health dentistry. Founded in 2014, the organization has developed its clinical model around the connection between oral health and overall systemic health.
The practice is led by Dr. Tzur Gabi, a licensed prosthodontist whose clinical background includes advanced restorative dentistry, implant dentistry, and full-mouth rehabilitation. Primary Integrative Dentistry incorporates diagnostic technologies and treatment planning methods commonly associated with integrative care, including evaluation of bite function, airway considerations, and material biocompatibility. The practice serves adults and teens navigating anxiety, trauma, relationship challenges, life transitions, self-esteem concerns, and related patterns, with treatment approaches that include psychodynamic, somatic, mindfulness, neuroscience, systems, and cognitive-behavioral methods. The company supports California residents through online care and serves clients in person in Brentwood, Los Angeles.

Pass the OT began in 2013 after Stephanie Shane started tutoring students for the NBCOT® exam, and the company later built its web course around that exam-prep work. The company focuses on occupational therapy and occupational therapy assistant test preparation through online study modules, practice questions, flashcards, audio and video lessons, and one-on-one tutoring. Pass the OT serves exam candidates with a flexible digital learning model and personalized support aimed at helping students prepare for board certification in occupational therapy.

Rogers & Brown was founded in 1968 in Charleston, South Carolina, growing from a humble, one room operation into a truly international logistics company providing a full range of transportation services. They work every day to ensure that their customers’ goods are transported in the most efficient, cost effective, and sustainable method possible while keeping the customers, consignees, and related service providers advised and secure from start to finish. Their dedicated team, global network, and advanced, in-house information systems makes them the ideal partner for all import, export, and warehousing needs.

InCompass Logistics began in 2015 and has grown from an energy-sector focus into a nationwide logistics provider. The company offers transportation and logistics services through assets, owner-operator support, affiliate capacity, and brokerage, with an emphasis on freight movement, customer communication, and operational consistency. InCompass Logistics serves multiple industrial verticals, including energy, building products, steel, and power generation, reflecting a broad reach across the transportation market.

PERI began in Germany in 1969 as a family-run company focused on formwork and scaffolding technology. The business supplies wall, column, slab, universal, and customized formwork, along with civil engineering systems, scaffolding, and shoring products for construction projects. In the United States, PERI offers engineering solutions, leasable products, and cleaning and repair services to support formwork and scaffolding work. The company has completed projects spanning building, infrastructure, and transportation work, demonstrating a broad presence across construction applications.

Aprojects was founded in 2005 as a global logistics service provider focused on complex supply chains and turnkey project solutions. The company’s services include transportation by air, road, sea, and chartering, along with warehousing, customs, surveys, engineering, preservation, and maintenance. Aprojects describes its work around project cargo and industrial logistics, supporting sectors such as energy and transportation through integrated supply chain services. Recent company updates also show continued international expansion, including new market activity in Papua New Guinea and Malaysia.

WaterFront Maritime Services is a maritime services company focused on ship agency and port-call support for charterers, owners, operators, and ship managers. The company organizes local, regional, and global services tied to the movement of dry, liquid, and gas commodities, with coverage through a wide network of port locations and local agency staff. Its service mix includes full agency support, protective agency, canal transits, husbandry services, bunkering, market intelligence, cargo documentation, and other value-added operational support. The company also emphasizes compliance, safety, environmental management, and data integration as part of its broader service model.

RCR Global Logistics, LLC was organized in Texas in 2021 as a limited liability company, giving the business a relatively recent origin in the state's transportation and logistics market. The company maintains a principal office in Dallas. The company operates as an active entity in the logistics sector, with a focus on freight movement and related supply-chain services rather than consumer retail or manufacturing.

Citadel, formerly Citadel Investment Group, was founded in 1990 by Kenneth C. Griffin and has grown into a multi-strategy alternative investment manager. The company focuses on identifying market opportunities across public and private investments, using talent, technology, analytics, and research to pursue long-term returns for institutional investors. Citadel operates major strategy areas in equities, fixed income and macro, credit and convertibles, and commodities, while Citadel Securities functions as a separate market-making business under the same broader founder ownership.

Your Behavioral Health began in 1985 and has grown into a behavioral health platform spanning psychiatric care, therapy, TMS treatment, residential programs, outpatient services, detox, and sober living. The company operates through three specialized brands: Neuro Wellness Spa for psychiatry, therapy, and TMS; Clear Behavioral Health for mental health and substance use treatment; and New Life House for structured sober living for young men. Your Behavioral Health serves adults and teens across Southern California and offers virtual care alongside in-person treatment, with an integrated model designed to move patients through different levels of care as needs change. In 2023, Comvest Partners acquired the company, recognizing it as a regional provider with a full spectrum of inpatient, outpatient, interventional psychiatry, and residential care.

Los Angeles–based clinical neuropsychology practice operating from South San Vicente Boulevard and led by Dale S. Sherman, PhD. Established in 2006, the practice specializes in comprehensive neuropsychological evaluation and assessment of brain–behavior relationships. Services focus on cognitive functioning, memory, attention, executive functioning, emotional regulation, and neurological conditions affecting behavior and performance. The practice provides outpatient neuropsychological testing and consultation for adults and works in coordination with medical providers, legal professionals, and treatment teams when appropriate. Known for its individualized, evidence-based assessments, the practice serves patients throughout Los Angeles seeking diagnostic clarity and treatment guidance related to neurological and psychological conditions.

Placenta Plus is a Los Angeles–based postpartum wellness company operating from South San Vicente Boulevard. The business focuses on placenta encapsulation services, a niche maternal wellness offering that processes a client’s placenta after childbirth into consumable capsules or alternative formats intended to support postpartum recovery. Placenta Plus positions its services within the luxury maternal-care market, serving clients throughout Beverly Hills and greater Los Angeles. The brand has gained visibility through national lifestyle media coverage highlighting high-end “placenta parties” and bespoke postpartum experiences.

Navah Elyasian, LMFT is a Los Angeles–based licensed marriage and family therapist providing trauma-informed psychotherapy services from her office on South San Vicente Boulevard. Established in private practice around 2010, she specializes in attachment-focused EMDR therapy, Internal Family Systems (IFS), somatic-based interventions, and Trauma Resiliency Model (TRM) techniques. Navah works with individuals, couples, and families addressing trauma, PTSD, anxiety, relationship issues, codependency, and attachment wounds. With advanced training in Emotionally Focused Couples Therapy and certification in EMDR, her practice emphasizes nervous-system regulation, emotional safety, and long-term relational healing. She operates as an independent practitioner serving clients throughout Los Angeles in a private, outpatient clinical setting.

Beverly Hills Heart & Vascular Center is a specialty cardiology and vascular medicine practice located on South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles. Established in 2014, the practice provides comprehensive diagnostic and interventional care for cardiovascular, arterial, and venous conditions. The center focuses on prevention, early detection, and minimally invasive treatment of heart disease, peripheral arterial disease, and venous disorders, including varicose veins and deep vein thrombosis. Operating as a private medical office, the practice integrates advanced imaging, endovascular techniques, and outpatient procedures to deliver personalized cardiovascular care. The center serves patients from the Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and greater Los Angeles areas and maintains professional affiliations with major regional medical institutions.
profile.companyName: Beverly Hills Heart and Vascular Center

name: Beverly Hills Heart and Vascular Center

profile.locationBio: RC Care & Beauty is a Los Angeles–based wellness and post-surgical recovery studio specializing in manual lymphatic drainage and Brazilian detox massage. Founded in 2021 by certified massage therapist Roseli Chife, the practice focuses on supporting post-plastic surgery recovery, reducing swelling, improving circulation, and accelerating tissue healing. Operating from its studio on South San Vicente Boulevard, RC Care & Beauty serves clients recovering from cosmetic procedures as well as individuals seeking ongoing wellness, body sculpting, and detoxification treatments. Known for its personalized care model and surgeon-referred post-operative services, the studio offers specialized lymphatic therapy in a calm, private outpatient setting and maintains a strong reputation for high-quality recovery support within the Beverly Grove and Beverly Hills medical corridor.

Golden State Capital Partners, Inc. is a Los Angeles–based investment and real estate consulting firm incorporated in 2015. Led by founder and principal Justin Maghen, the company operates as a privately held California corporation focused on real estate investment, development consulting, and related financial activities. Golden State Capital Partners has served as a project applicant and investment entity for multifamily and mixed-use development proposals across Los Angeles, including urban infill residential projects. Operating with a lean organizational structure, the firm engages in strategic planning, capital structuring, and project oversight for real estate ventures within Southern California.

LA Clinic BH is a boutique luxury skincare and body-treatment clinic located on South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles. Operated by LA CLINIC BH LLC, the clinic was founded by Hayat Moubarak, a celebrity Master Esthetician with over 40 years of experience in European and results-driven skincare. The practice emphasizes customized, non-toxic, clean skincare protocols, using EWG-verified products to deliver high-impact results with minimal irritation. The San Vicente Boulevard location serves a high-end clientele from Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and surrounding Los Angeles markets. Services focus on advanced facial treatments, body therapies, and specialized skin solutions rather than medical or invasive procedures.

Immortelle Med Home Healthcare is a Los Angeles–based, licensed home health agency specializing in high-acuity post-surgical nursing and recovery case management. Incorporated in 2019 and operating under Immortelle Med and Immortelle Inc., the organization provides comprehensive home health services including skilled nursing, wound care, medication management, chronic condition monitoring, rehabilitation coordination, and post-operative recovery support. Immortelle Med is widely recognized for its concierge-level aftercare services for patients recovering from elective and non-elective surgeries, including plastic surgery and complex medical procedures. Services are delivered both in private residences and in managed recovery accommodations, with 24/7 clinical oversight by licensed healthcare professionals. Operating from administrative offices on South San Vicente Boulevard and a primary clinical hub on South Doheny Drive, Immortelle Med serves patients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding areas with an emphasis on safety, discretion, and medically supervised recovery.

Beverly Hills Institute For Pain Management is a California-based pain management practice focused on helping injured workers and people involved in motor vehicle accidents. The company says care centers on identifying the source of pain and using office-based treatments to support recovery and function. Services listed on the company website include platelet-rich plasma injections, epidural steroid injections, facet injections, medial branch blocks, occipital nerve blocks, trigger point injections, stem cell therapy, and IV infusion treatments. The practice also describes a professional team of certified healthcare specialists and offers appointments through several California locations while maintaining a broad focus on interventional pain care.
profile.companyName: Beverly Hills Institute For Pain Management

name: Beverly Hills Institute For Pain Management

profile.locationBio: Sorasora is a Los Angeles–based wellness, health, and beauty business operating as Sorasora LLC from its office on South San Vicente Boulevard. Established in 2022, the company is organized as a member-managed California limited liability company and is led by its manager, Sarah Jean Connor. The company maintains a small operational footprint consistent with personalized, appointment-based services commonly found in wellness and aesthetic practices. Sorasora operates independently and is not affiliated with similarly named beauty or skin studios elsewhere in California.

Art Lewin Bespoke, founded in 1989, is a privately held custom tailoring firm based in Downtown Los Angeles. The company designs and produces bespoke suits, shirts, formal wear, and alterations, all crafted in-house using over 4,000 imported fabrics from Italy, England, Scotland, and France. Recognized regionally, it has served more than 23,000 clients—ranging from corporate leaders to Hollywood talent—and maintains a high client retention rate of roughly 94%. Led by founder and principal Art Lewin, an expert tailor and entrepreneur whose journey began in London’s fashion heritage before launching in Southern California, the firm prides itself on personalized fittings at home, office, or showroom. Art Lewin also authors business books and hosts workshops on entrepreneurship. The firm operates multiple locations across Southern California, including Beverly Hills, Palm Springs, Scottsdale, Orange County, and San Diego.

Law Office of Brian Y. Shirazi, PC is a Los Angeles–based employment law firm located on South San Vicente Boulevard. Founded in 2025 as a California professional corporation, the firm focuses exclusively on employee-side labor and employment law matters. Attorney Brian Y. Shirazi represents workers in disputes involving wrongful termination, workplace discrimination, sexual harassment, retaliation, wage and hour violations, whistleblower claims, and hostile work environments. Licensed to practice in California in 2024, Mr. Shirazi provides personalized legal representation, emphasizing strategic advocacy and accountability for employers who violate labor laws. The firm operates as a boutique practice serving clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding areas, handling cases on a contingency-fee basis where applicable.
profile.companyName: Law Office Of Brian Y. Shirazi, PC

name: Law Office Of Brian Y. Shirazi, PC

profile.locationBio: Bryan Yang, MD is a California-licensed psychiatrist operating from South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles. Practicing through Bryan Yang, M.D., Inc., the office provides outpatient psychiatric evaluation, medication management, and treatment for a wide range of mental health conditions including mood disorders, anxiety disorders, substance-related disorders, and psychotic disorders. The practice emphasizes comprehensive psychiatric assessment and evidence-based treatment approaches tailored to individual patient needs. Established as a professional corporation in 2016, the practice functions as a small, physician-led medical office serving patients from Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and the greater Los Angeles area.

The Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety (LADBS) is the City agency responsible for safeguarding public health, safety, and welfare through the enforcement of building, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, zoning, and related municipal codes. Established in 1946, LADBS administers construction permitting, plan review, inspections, and code enforcement for residential, commercial, and industrial properties throughout the City of Los Angeles. The department conducts site inspections at properties such as 640 South San Vicente Boulevard to verify compliance with approved plans, building codes, accessibility standards, and life-safety requirements. LADBS inspectors and engineers operate as public officials and do not lease or occupy commercial space within the buildings they regulate. The department also oversees specialized programs including seismic retrofitting, green building compliance, deputy inspector licensing, and emergency response for unsafe structures.
profile.companyName: The Department of Building and Safety

profile.locationBio: Westdale West, LLC is a California limited liability company established in 2017. The company’s stated business activity is medical education, including branded educational initiatives such as “Kidney Conversations with Dr. Rastogi.” The San Vicente Boulevard suite functions as a professional administrative office, rather than a clinical or patient-facing facility.

Vanessa Moselle is a Los Angeles–based holistic health practitioner who operates a private wellness practice under the name VeesHoney. Her work focuses on identifying and addressing the root causes of physical and emotional imbalances through a method known as Cellular Nutrition Therapy, a non-invasive approach that incorporates muscle testing and applied kinesiology principles. Vanessa specializes in supporting hormone balance, digestive health, autoimmune concerns, skin health, detoxification, anxiety, and overall cellular healing. Through personalized nutrition, lifestyle guidance, and holistic assessment, she works one-on-one with clients seeking long-term wellness solutions rather than symptom-based treatment. Her practice emphasizes individualized care, natural healing, and empowering clients to take an active role in their health.

aliases: The American Association of Aesthetic Medicine and Surgery

profile.locationBio: Sam Assassa, M.D. is a Los Angeles–based, board-certified physician specializing in internal medicine and non-surgical aesthetic medicine. Practicing from his office on South San Vicente Boulevard, Dr. Assassa is the founder and medical director of Beverly Hills Aesthetics, a nationally and internationally recognized center for minimally invasive cosmetic procedures. He received his medical degree from Damascus University Faculty of Medicine and completed postgraduate training at Loyola University–affiliated hospitals in Chicago and Case Western Reserve University–affiliated hospitals in Cleveland. Board certified in Internal Medicine, Dr. Assassa has practiced medicine for more than two decades and is widely regarded as a pioneer in non-surgical facial and body contouring techniques. He has introduced proprietary procedures such as the CosmoFaceLift™ and Smart Lipo-based facial and body sculpting methods, lectured in over 15 countries, and served as President of the American Association of Aesthetic Medicine and Surgery since 2006. His practice combines primary internal medicine expertise with advanced aesthetic treatments in a private outpatient medical setting.

name: Sam Assassa, M.D.

profile.locationBio: Battaglia Inc, operating at this location through Battaglia Shop LLC, is a luxury fashion and lifestyle brand with deep Italian heritage and a longstanding presence in Southern California. Founded in 1961, Battaglia is best known for its refined menswear, bespoke tailoring, fragrances, and specialty accessories inspired by classic European craftsmanship. The brand traces its origins to Giuseppe Battaglia, who introduced Italian fashion sensibilities to the United States and became a founding luxury presence on Rodeo Drive. From its South San Vicente Boulevard location, Battaglia conducts boutique retail and brand operations, including fragrance development and specialty product distribution. The company maintains a selective, high-end positioning and serves a clientele seeking timeless style, craftsmanship, and exclusivity rather than mass-market fashion.

Fujii Chiropractic Lab is a private, appointment-only chiropractic clinic located on South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles, serving the Beverly Hills and West Hollywood area. Founded in 2022 by Dr. Ryota Fujii, the clinic emphasizes a holistic, root-cause approach to pain relief and long-term wellness rather than symptom-based treatment. Inspired by Japanese principles of balance, precision, and minimal force, Fujii Chiropractic Lab provides one-on-one care focused entirely on the individual patient. Services include gentle chiropractic adjustments, myofascial release, shiatsu massage, applied kinesiology, and soft-tissue therapies. With treatment available in both English and Japanese, the clinic attracts local and international patients seeking personalized, high-quality chiropractic care in a calm, clinical setting.

Beautiful Brows Academy is a boutique permanent-makeup studio and training operation located at 640 S San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles. The business is publicly marketed as Beautiful Brows by Adriana Viloria and focuses on advanced brow and cosmetic tattoo techniques, serving both clients and students interested in professional certification. Services offered at this location include microblading, ombré brows, lip micropigmentation, eyeliner tattooing, and micro channeling treatments. In addition to client services, the studio promotes educational components consistent with a beauty academy model, providing hands-on instruction and technique-based learning for aspiring permanent-makeup artists.

Creative Mind Access Visas & Passports is a Beverly Hills–based concierge visa and passport expediting firm founded by Fabio Pastorini. Established operationally in 2004, the company specializes in fast-track passport services, visa processing, work permits, and global mobility logistics for executives, touring professionals, and specialized groups. Creative Mind Access is particularly known within the entertainment and live events industries, supporting international travel for musicians, production teams, athletes, and business leaders. Operating as a boutique expediting firm, the company emphasizes personalized service, close relationships with embassies and consulates worldwide, and end-to-end management of complex travel documentation. With offices in strategic U.S. locations and long-standing international partnerships, Creative Mind Access enables clients to meet demanding travel schedules while minimizing administrative risk and delays.

Unwinding Trauma is a Los Angeles–based psychotherapy practice founded and led by Larry Levi, MA, LMFT, SEP. Established in 2006, the practice specializes in healing developmental trauma, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), grief, anxiety, and nervous-system dysregulation. Drawing from over two decades of clinical experience, Larry Levi integrates evidence-based and somatic approaches including Somatic Experiencing, EMDR, Brainspotting, NeuroAffective Relational Model (NARM), mindfulness practices, and art therapy. Unwinding Trauma offers individualized therapy for adults and couples, with a collaborative, trauma-informed approach designed to restore emotional regulation, resilience, and a sense of safety. The practice operates as a private, one-on-one clinical setting serving clients throughout Los Angeles and California via in-person and telehealth services.

BonAlive Inc is a medical device and biomaterials company specializing in bioactive glass technology for bone regeneration and infection management. Operating from South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles, the company develops and commercializes S53P4 bioactive glass, a smart biomaterial composed of elements naturally found in the human body. BonAlive’s products are designed to stimulate bone growth while inhibiting bacterial growth, offering an alternative to antibiotic-dependent treatments in orthopedic, trauma, and cranio-maxillofacial applications. The company positions its technology under the “Smart Healing™” platform, focusing on sustainable, evidence-based solutions to address global challenges related to bone infections and antibiotic resistance. BonAlive products are CE-marked and supported by extensive clinical research and peer-reviewed studies.

DiCecco Law Partners was founded by a team of attorneys with extensive experience handling complex commercial claims and transactions. The firm provides strategic legal counsel for business disputes and transactions, with practice areas that include commercial litigation, business transactions, insurance, healthcare, hospitality, and regulatory matters. The firm advises healthcare providers and institutions on compliance, malpractice defense, and transactions, while supporting hotels, restaurants, and tourism businesses with contracts, labor issues, and liability defense. The practice serves a broad range of commercial clients and business sectors through litigation, transactional work, and industry-specific legal support.

CASA Houston began as a Houston showroom in 2018 with contemporary European home furnishings and brands that were new to the local market. The company offers Italian design across furniture, lighting, bath, and kitchen categories, and its branded showroom format gives each collection a distinct display area. CASA Houston also serves as a dealer for specialty brands such as Foster and Poltrona Frau, reflecting a focus on imported home interiors and design products for residential and trade customers.

Perry Homes began in 1967 as a family-owned homebuilder and has remained a woman-owned business focused on new construction. Perry Homes builds and sells homes across Texas and has expanded into Florida, including markets such as Tampa, Orlando, Southwest Florida, and Jacksonville. Perry Homes offers smart home technology, warranty support, and homeowner resources that continue through the buying and post-closing experience. Perry Homes also supports community giving through the Perry Homes Foundation and related charitable efforts while maintaining a focus on quality craftsmanship and customer service.

Big Dreams Entertainment began in 2019 after producer Leslie Greif sold ThinkFactory Media to ITV Studios and launched a new production venture focused on film and television storytelling. The company develops scripted and unscripted projects across television series, limited series, documentaries, game shows, movies, documentaries, and docuseries, with work spanning early development through post-production. Big Dreams Entertainment has produced projects such as The Offer, The Hatfields and the McCoys, Sun Records, Texas Rising, and several Lifetime films, building a presence across major entertainment platforms. The company also emphasizes collaboration with creative partners and production work that ranges from smaller-budget projects to large-scale studio releases.

BluePath Solutions is a health economics and value communications firm that develops insights across the healthcare technology lifecycle, with services centered on value marketing and communications, modeling and data visualization, and health economics and outcomes research. The company works with biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic clients to design, execute, and interpret economic analyses that support market access and payer-focused decision-making. BluePath Solutions expanded its platform through the acquisition of Qualia Bio, an agency focused on healthcare policy, market access, and reimbursement, adding broader support across policy, evidence generation, and commercialization needs.

The Green Room, located at 1640 S Sepulveda Blvd in Los Angeles, is a premier creative space designed to empower content creators, media professionals, and innovators. Known for its sophisticated and modern approach, The Green Room provides a versatile environment ideal for productions, podcasts, and private events. With cutting-edge amenities, soundproof facilities, and a focus on client experience, it serves as a hub where creativity meets comfort. Whether for industry professionals or entrepreneurs, the space inspires collaboration and supports the highest standards of media production. Strategically located in the heart of West Los Angeles, The Green Room blends style, functionality, and flexibility, enabling individuals and brands to transform vision into reality. It’s not just a space—it’s an experience curated for those who expect excellence in every detail.

Banc of California began in 1941 and has grown into a relationship-focused business bank serving companies across multiple stages of growth. In 2023, the company completed its merger with PacWest Bancorp, expanding the business under the Banc of California name while keeping its focus on commercial banking. The company provides banking and treasury management services, plus loan and deposit products for small, middle-market, and venture-backed businesses. Its business lines include commercial banking, commercial real estate, construction, multifamily real estate, warehouse lending, asset-based lending, fund finance, and global treasury management, with service available through branches and regional offices in California and other U.S. markets.

Shout! Studios began as Retropolis Entertainment in 2002 before becoming a prominent media distributor. The company specializes in releasing classic films, TV shows, and music collections. Their catalog includes various genres through imprints like Scream Factory for horror titles. Shout! Studios also produces original content and manages streaming services. Over two decades, they've built a reputation for preserving cult favorites and making them accessible through modern platforms.

More Better Mwy Gwell is a creative consultancy dedicated to delivering innovative brand experiences through thoughtful design and strategic storytelling. Located at 1640 S Sepulveda Blvd in Los Angeles, the company’s mission reflects its name: to make brands bigger, experiences better, and ideas resonate more deeply. Specializing in branding, content development, and campaign execution, More Better Mwy Gwell works with businesses that value originality and a bold approach to communication. Their services encompass concept creation, digital engagement, and marketing solutions tailored to client objectives. Whether supporting emerging companies or established organizations, their team strives to transform concepts into compelling narratives that inspire and connect with audiences on a global scale. Driven by creativity and collaboration, More Better Mwy Gwell blends strategy with artistry to help clients achieve meaningful impact in highly competitive markets.

Rhenus Logistics began in 1912 and has grown into a global logistics company with a broad supply-chain focus. The company provides transportation, warehousing, customs clearance, shipment tracking, recycling, and other value-added services for industries such as automotive, high tech, life sciences, healthcare, and fashion. Rhenus Logistics emphasizes multimodal transport and digital tools to support flexible, efficient supply-chain operations. The business operates internationally across a wide network and continues to position logistics as an end-to-end service rather than a single transport offering.

Pacific Surgical Distribution, Inc. is a Los Angeles–based medical device distribution company founded in 2006 that specializes in spine and surgical solutions for healthcare providers. Serving hospitals and surgeons throughout Southern California and the western United States, the company supplies specialized surgical products and supports clinical teams with reliable distribution and operational expertise.

The Salem Law Firm, established in 2003 by Edmond Salem, provides comprehensive legal services across California. Originally focused on family law and civil litigation, the firm expanded into personal injury and business disputes. Their practice areas now include real estate, criminal defense, and immigration law. The firm emphasizes personalized client service and courtroom experience in both state and federal cases.

The Angell Foundation was established to honor David and Lynn Angell's commitment to social justice. The foundation focuses on three main areas: education opportunities, food equity, and transformational leadership development. They invest in programs that help underserved communities access resources for better lives. The foundation operates primarily in Southern California and New England. Through strategic grantmaking, they aim to create systemic change in these critical social sectors.

aliases: Law Office Of Steven L Bryson

profile.locationBio: The Law Office of Steven L Bryson in California specializes in bankruptcy law, particularly Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 cases. Steven L Bryson graduated from Southwestern Law School in 1978 and has been practicing since 1979. The firm serves clients needing debt relief and financial restructuring through bankruptcy proceedings. While there's another attorney named Steven Bryson in Philadelphia focusing on personal injury law, this California-based practice concentrates on bankruptcy solutions. Their services help both individuals and businesses navigate complex financial challenges.
profile.companyName: Law Office of Steven L Bryson

name: Law Office of Steven L Bryson

profile.locationBio: Perry S Oretzky CPA has operated since 1989 as a California-based accounting practice. The firm provides traditional accounting services including bookkeeping and financial statement preparation. While originally licensed as both an attorney and CPA, their current focus remains on accounting services. They serve clients throughout California with tax compliance and financial auditing needs. The company maintains a professional presence in the Los Angeles area while serving a broader regional client base.

Madelyn Hammond & Associates began 16 years ago as an events and marketing company. The company specializes in producing live events, talent booking, and creating video content. Their work includes producing award shows for organizations like the American Cinematheque and Critics Choice Association. The business offers marketing support for entertainment and media clients. Services also include content production, graphic design, and resume writing.

The Source Health Treatment Center provides minimally invasive orthopedic and regenerative medicine. Established as a comprehensive pain management facility, the center uses advanced techniques for chronic pain relief. Services include interventional spine procedures, sports medicine, and regenerative therapies. The center operates multiple California locations and participates in FDA clinical trials. Their approach emphasizes holistic care and non-surgical solutions for musculoskeletal conditions.

Founded in 1915, Jewish Big Brothers Big Sisters of Los Angeles (JBBBSLA) enriches the lives of children through meaningful mentoring, camp, and scholarship programs. JBBBSLA’s mission is to assist children in achieving their full potential by providing impactful programs that facilitate lasting relationships and support positive youth development. JBBBSLA also owns and operates Camp Bob Waldorf, a 112-acre residential camp and retreat center in the Verdugo Hills of Glendale.
profile.companyName: Jewish Big Brothers Big Sisters of Los Angeles

name: Jewish Big Brothers Big Sisters of Los Angeles

profile.locationBio: Metro Star Properties has been active in Connecticut's real estate market for over thirty years. The company specializes in creating vibrant urban spaces through mixed-use developments. Their portfolio includes residential apartments, retail spaces, and office buildings. The organization emphasizes architecturally significant structures that enhance community livability. Metro Star focuses on revitalizing downtown areas while maintaining neighborhood character.

BluSky Technology Services provides technology products and services to government agencies, with a focus on professional services, support, and Oracle-related software and infrastructure optimization. The company integrates technology to improve performance, availability, and risk management, alongside broader services for data-center environments. The company started in 2020 under the former name Bluesky Payment Services LLC before adopting the current BluSky Technology Services name. The business operates in the technology services and enterprise software support verticals, with a market presence centered on public-sector and business technology needs.
HJK International, Inc.is a total real estate service company, providing brokerage, management, appraisal, and remodel/renovation coordination services in the Greater Los Angeles area.

Ameriprise Financial was founded by John Tappan in 1894 and later operated as American Express Financial Advisors before adopting its current brand name. The company focuses on financial planning, wealth management, asset management, insurance, annuities, and related advisory services for individuals, institutions, and small businesses. Ameriprise Financial also offers retirement-oriented products and insurance-related solutions through its broader financial services platform. The company is a long-running financial firm with a national and international presence centered on advice and goal-based planning.

Prager Metis CPAs, LLC is an international accounting and advisory firm offering a comprehensive range of services, including audit, tax, business consulting, and financial advisory solutions. Established through the merger of Prager and Fenton LLP and Metis Group LLC, the firm serves clients across diverse industries such as real estate, entertainment, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations. Prager Metis provides specialized services in forensic accounting, business valuation, and international tax planning, catering to both domestic and global clients. The firm emphasizes a personalized approach to client service, leveraging deep industry expertise and advanced technology to deliver strategic financial solutions. Headquartered in New York City, Prager Metis operates multiple offices across the United States and internationally, positioning itself as a trusted advisor for businesses and individuals seeking comprehensive financial guidance.

Arnie & Company was founded in 1989 and built its practice around technical assistance and financial consultations for clients facing complex financial issues. The firm provides litigation and forensic services centered on complex commercial litigation, fraud and forensic accounting, and specialized investigations. Its work includes accounting and economic analysis for dispute-related claims such as lost profits, contract damages, and other financial controversies, alongside support for matters involving internal controls, reporting issues, and deceptive schemes. Arnie & Company serves a diverse clientele across commercial and investigative engagements.

Ariel Home Healthcare is a home health care provider based in Arlington, Texas, specializing in delivering skilled nursing and therapeutic services to patients in their homes. The company focuses on supporting individuals who require medical care outside of a hospital setting, offering services that may include nursing care, physical therapy, and other health-related assistance tailored to patient needs. Founded in 2020, the organization operates within the home health care sector, serving clients who need ongoing medical attention in a residential environment. Ariel Home Healthcare is privately held and aligns with industry standards for home-based health services, ensuring continuity of care for patients recovering from illness, injury, or managing chronic conditions.

3C Metal USA was established in 2017 as part of 3C Metal's expansion into the Americas. The company provides engineering, procurement, fabrication, and installation services for high-pressure piping and structural projects, with work that supports oil and gas, marine, and other heavy industry applications. 3C Metal began in France in 1995 and later expanded into a multinational group with services that include structural steel fabrication, piping, electrical and hydraulic integration, project management, and installation support across industrial and energy-sector projects.

Berman Financial Services is a Los Angeles financial services firm focused on tax preparation and related client work. The company provides tax preparation, tax planning, bookkeeping, and estate and trust tax work. The firm serves both individuals and small businesses, with a market presence centered on tax and financial support rather than product sales.

SERVPRO began in 1967 as a painting business in Sacramento, California, and later expanded into a franchise system focused on cleaning and restoration. The company provides residential and commercial services that include water and fire damage mitigation, mold remediation, storm response, construction, general cleaning, specialty cleaning, and reconstruction. SERVPRO's business model centers on local franchise professionals supported by national systems for emergency response and disaster recovery. The company continues to operate as a nationwide franchisor focused on cleanup, restoration, and rebuilding services after property damage.

Tillster builds unified commerce software for quick-service and fast-casual restaurant brands, connecting in-store and online ordering with digital experiences, targeted marketing, loyalty programs, and data tools. The company's platform supports kiosks, mobile apps, websites, delivery management, and guest engagement across a wide restaurant network. Tillster traces its roots to 2002, when EMN8 was founded to develop digital solutions for restaurants, and the business later adopted the Tillster name after its rebrand.

Mental Fitness Clinic was established in 2015 and serves patients across the life span with psychiatry, psychotherapy, and neuropsychological testing. The company provides both in-person and telehealth care, with treatment plans that may include medication management, talk therapy, lifestyle changes, and other evidence-based approaches. Mental Fitness Clinic works with children, adolescents, adults, and athletes, and the practice also offers specialized support for concerns such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, OCD, trauma, and stress-related conditions. The company employs an integrative model that combines mind and body wellness in personalized care plans.

Amplified Entertainment is a full-service talent management and production company that represents performers and directors across film, television, theater, and music. The company's work spans recording and music touring, placing it at the intersection of artist representation and entertainment production. Its business is centered on managing creative talent and supporting projects that move between screen, stage, and live performance. Based in Los Angeles, the company operates as an entertainment services firm with a focus on multi-format representation and production.

Evening Star is a game development studio founded in late 2018 that focuses on designing fresh, fun games built to stand the test of time. The company develops 3D game projects, including Penny's Big Breakaway, and uses its proprietary Retro Engine technology in its work. Evening Star operates as a distributed studio built around close collaboration and strong communication, with ongoing careers, blog, and technology pages supporting its development efforts.

Founded in 2001, the company offers tax planning and return preparation, tax authority representation, bookkeeping, financial statement preparation, accounting system implementation, and management advisory services. The firm also provides estate, trust, gift, retirement, and succession planning support, with services that connect personal wealth matters and business continuity needs. Its practice spans compliance, reporting, and advisory work across individual, partnership, corporate, and not-for-profit client needs.

profile.locationBio: Corner Stop Mini Mart LLC is a Los Angeles grocery and convenience business organized in California in 2025. The company serves local shoppers with groceries and everyday essentials, fitting the neighborhood retail model used by small corner stores. The firm is active and operates as a grocery store.

The Molly Steinsapir Foundation is a California 501(c)(3) nonprofit established in 2021, created to honor Molly Olivia Steinsapir after her death at age 12. The foundation provides tangible assistance to Los Angeles County residents in need, with a focus on children and on meeting basic needs that would otherwise go unmet. The foundation's work spans fire relief, furniture and clothing support, help for people moving off the streets, and youth-led community projects that encourage local teens to take part in the response. The foundation also supports memorial efforts tied to Molly's interests in animals and the planet, while maintaining a broader community presence through the Youth Board and shared community space.

Krav Maga Worldwide grew from the Krav Maga lineage brought to the United States by Darren Levine, who founded the Krav Maga Association of America and later Krav Maga Worldwide to keep the system organized as it expanded. The company focuses on self-defense training built around Krav Maga principles, with programs designed for civilians and for people pursuing instructor certification through structured training and testing. Krav Maga Worldwide also supports licensed training centers and regional training centers that follow company standards and provide access to certification courses and advanced training opportunities. The company extends its curriculum through an online academy and educational resources that keep the emphasis on practical, real-world self-defense instruction.

Victor Sherman began in 1984 as a criminal defense practice founded by attorney Victor Sherman. The firm focuses on defense work in business and financial crimes, tax fraud, money laundering, state and federal felony drug offenses, grand jury investigations, criminal and civil forfeiture, asset forfeiture, conspiracy, federal sentencing, frozen assets, and internet crimes. The practice handles federal criminal defense and represents clients in major courts and cities across the United States. Over time, Victor Sherman has built its work around trial advocacy, investigations, and case strategy for clients facing complex criminal allegations.

Breslauer, Rutman & Anderson began as Breslauer, Rutman & Anderson LLC in California and later continued under the current corporate form, Breslauer, Rutman & Anderson, Inc. The firm focuses on accounting and business management work, with services that include tax preparation and bookkeeping for individuals and small businesses. The company operates in the office administrative services and management services space, which fits its long-running advisory and back-office support role. The business has maintained a presence in Los Angeles for years and continues to operate under the Breslauer, Rutman & Anderson name.

Shebby Hirashima is a family law firm focused on divorce, custody, support, property division, and domestic violence matters, and the practice also handles family law mediation. The firm's attorneys emphasize courtroom advocacy alongside tailored client guidance, and the practice handles complex financial and custody disputes. Shebby Hirashima was formed by David Shebby and Kristen Hirashima, and the firm is a Southern California family law practice based in Los Angeles.

Wolf Express Liquor operates as a Texas-based distributor specializing in alcoholic beverages. Established in the Greater Houston area, the company serves a wide network of restaurants, nightclubs, and bars with both established accounts and new partnerships. Their business model focuses on same-day delivery services for commercial clients, including flexible scheduling options. The product portfolio features numerous premium spirit brands across major categories. Wolf Express Liquor emphasizes customer service through dedicated sales representatives and direct order management systems.

Brian Vogel Photography, established in 2010, is a Houston-based studio offering commercial and advertising photography services. The company provides customized solutions for various needs including portraits and product photography. Serving both national and international clients, they focus on artistic creativity and quick adaptability. Brian Vogel Photography maintains membership with Professional Photographers of America.

Justin Fulton Tattoo operates as a private tattoo studio and fine art practice under the name Fulton Fine Art in Houston, Texas. The studio is led by artist Justin Fulton and is located at 2315 Commerce Street. Publicly available information indicates that the practice focuses on custom tattoo work alongside the creation and sale of original artwork and tattoo flash designs.
The studio operates on an appointment-based model rather than as a traditional walk-in tattoo shop. Justin Fulton’s work spans multiple tattoo styles, including black-and-grey and color tattooing, with influences ranging from traditional tattoo aesthetics to contemporary illustrative approaches. In addition to tattooing, Fulton Fine Art produces original paintings, drawings, and limited-edition artwork available through its website.
Justin Fulton Tattoo functions as an independent, owner-operated creative studio with no identified parent organization. The business is privately held and does not publish financial information. The Commerce Street location serves as both a tattoo studio and art production space, supporting tattoo sessions, design development, and fine art creation.

Zú Art Collective began when Houston artist Alexander Arzú transitioned from architecture to visual arts. The studio creates customized murals and street art that connect brands with audiences while maintaining community focus. Services include graphic design, digital illustrations, and commissioned artworks. Zú Art Collective emphasizes collaborative projects that blend cultural elements into public and commercial spaces. The collective also maintains an online store featuring digital art pieces.

Never Endz Tattoo Studio is a Houston-based tattoo and piercing studio operating at 2315 Commerce Street in the East Downtown (EaDo) area. Public listings indicate that the studio functions as a private, appointment-only operation, with bookings managed primarily through third-party platforms such as Fresha. The studio provides custom tattoo services, tattoo cover-ups, and body piercing services.
Based on customer reviews and business directory information, Never Endz Tattoo Studio emphasizes a clean, professional environment and individualized client experiences. The studio is identified across multiple listings as women-owned and Latino-owned, and is described as LGBTQ+ friendly. Operations are structured around scheduled sessions rather than walk-in retail tattooing, aligning with private studio use.
Never Endz Tattoo Studio is independently operated and privately held, with no identified parent organization. The Commerce Street location serves as its sole studio, supporting tattoo sessions, consultations, and related body art services. The business does not publish financial disclosures and appears to operate with a small team or owner-operator model typical of boutique tattoo studios.

Since their founding in 1934, they have been singularly focused on one thing: providing World-Class Personal Service and financial security to California school employees and their families. This isn't just something they say — everything they do, every decision they make, is with an unwavering commitment to serving the best interests of Members. Although they offer products and services similar to other financial institutions, their structure and culture are vastly different. Banks are for profit, while credit unions are Member-owned financial cooperatives, meaning their excess earnings are returned to their Members in the form of lower rates on loans, higher rates on savings, low-to-no fees, and many complimentary services. They take to heart the "people helping people" philosophy, the principle on which credit unions were founded.

BWA began in 1969 as a chartered surveying practice focused on independent consultancy for the financial and management aspects of land and buildings. The company crosses construction, real estate, facilities management, and management consulting, giving clients support across the lifecycle of projects and assets. BWA's services include quantity surveying, cost management, contract administration, employer's agent work, project management, and facilities consultancy. The business works with public and private sector clients across a broad range of sectors, including residential, industrial, healthcare, retail, education, and commercial projects.

Emily Faith Strauss understood at age 24 what the fine jewelry market was missing: Approachable-priced, thoughtfully designed pieces made for women like herself. Upon recognizing this void, Emily began to design and create her own pieces, launching EF Collection in 2010. Fine Jewelry Houses are historically generational handovers; however, Emily was determined to see her vision of delicate, feminine pieces at approachable prices through and shake up the industry.

In 2012, Emily began selling her pieces at her local hair salon, where she continued selling for the next 3 years. During this time, Emily steadily built up a Direct to Consumer Clientele, began utilizing her growing social media platform, and made the entree into wholesale, with Shopbop.com . By 2014, EF Collection secured it’s first luxury department store partner - Bergdorf Goodman, forever changing the landscape of and introducing fine jewelry on the 5th Floor (5F).

Drip Hydration began in 2018 as a mobile IV therapy service and has since expanded into on-demand wellness care. The company provides in-home and on-site IV infusions, hydration treatments, diagnostic testing, vaccines, peptide therapy, medical weight loss medications, lab tests, and related wellness products. Drip Hydration also supports memberships, event services, and shipped-to-you options as part of a broader medical wellness model. The business serves customers through a nationwide and international service network built around licensed clinical care and personalized treatment options.

ISearch Group began as a recruiting firm focused on executive search and research, building its business around identifying, screening, and presenting candidates for client hiring teams. The company provides a fresh alternative to traditional internal and outsourced recruitment and serves companies across North America, EMEA, and APAC. Its work centers on mid-level and senior-level hiring across finance, accounting, leadership, talent acquisition, and related professional functions, with a market presence in executive search and research services.

Getty Images began in 1995 as a visual content business focused on licensing imagery and related media for commercial use. The company supplies royalty-free images, editorial photography, video, illustrations, vectors and music, with services spanning creative projects, news coverage, sports, entertainment and archive content. Getty Images also offers digital asset management tools, brand content distribution services and generative AI features built around commercially safe, ready-to-license content. The business serves customers across professional creative, media and corporate workflows and has developed into a broad visual media marketplace with a large digital library and global creator network.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade is an Irish government department responsible for diplomacy, consular services, passports, visas, and trade promotion. The department began in 1919 as Ireland's foreign affairs apparatus and later adopted its current name, reflecting a broader remit that includes international engagement and economic promotion. The department works through embassies and consulates abroad, supports Irish citizens overseas, and coordinates Ireland's representation in multilateral forums. The department also advances Irish Aid, diaspora engagement, and international priorities linked to peace, security, and global relations.

profile.locationBio: Idomeneo Enterprises began in 2001 as an independent HR consulting business and later expanded into a broader people-operations firm. The company provides human resources consulting, payroll administration, benefits management, staffing support, and technology tools for hiring, document management, employee access, and time-off workflows. Idomeneo also includes employee engagement and development services, along with an insurance agency offering under a separate brand. The business centers its work on helping growing companies handle compliance, workforce strategy, and day-to-day HR support.

Alias Intelligence began in 2021 as a background investigations firm focused on timely, accurate searches for financial institutions, corporations, real estate entities, law firms, and hiring teams. The company now combines due diligence, executive and employment screening, discreet source inquiries, asset searches, litigation support, AI-driven due diligence, and ongoing monitoring through a client portal and self-service platform. Alias Intelligence serves clients across commercial real estate, executive search, investment banking, general partner, legal, limited partner, and corporate settings, reflecting a broad market presence in investigations and risk-related intelligence.

E & L, LLP is a California law firm built around employment, personal injury, workers' compensation, and family law matters. The firm was established by David Lavi and Arie Ebrahimian, both of whom serve as founder and managing attorney, and the practice grew from advocacy for employees facing wrongful termination, wage disputes, discrimination, harassment, and leave-related issues. E & L, LLP represents clients in personal injury matters, including motor vehicle collisions, truck accidents, dog bites, and pedestrian accidents. The firm maintains a client-focused approach centered on legal guidance, privacy, and representation across disputes involving workplace rights and injury claims.

Rapid Medical develops neurovascular therapy tools for ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke. The company began in Israel and has grown into a global medical technology business serving stroke care through proprietary interventional devices, clinical research, and regional operations in multiple markets. Rapid Medical's platform centers on responsive, remotely adjustable tools designed to adapt to patient anatomy, and the company continues to generate new clinical evidence and achieve product clearances across its stroke-focused portfolio.

Identification Data & Imaging has focused on identity intelligence and information solutions for risk management, supporting use cases such as consumer and business identity verification, due diligence, fraud detection and prevention, legislative compliance, and debt recovery. The company previously offered visual and electronic identification systems, CCTV, peripherals, and supplies, reflecting a background in identification-related products before expanding into broader data-driven services.

Stuf Storage began during the early pandemic as a self-storage business focused on converting underutilized basements, garages, and other building spaces into nearby storage solutions. The company serves consumers and businesses with month-to-month storage, digital key entry, online reservations, and secure facilities designed for convenient neighborhood access. Stuf Storage also works with real estate owners to turn unused space into storage as an added amenity and a source of recurring rent, while operating in several major U.S. markets.

SensaPay began with a focus on simplifying payment processing for businesses and building a more seamless experience for merchants and customers. The company offers merchant accounts, a payment gateway, ACH processing, payment links, subscriptions, virtual terminals, invoicing, and point-of-sale tools for online, in-person, and mobile payments. SensaPay supports specialized verticals including ecommerce, SaaS, nonprofits, digital goods, B2B, and law firms, demonstrating a broad presence in payments for businesses with varied processing needs. The company is a payments technology provider centered on unified payment workflows, security features, and reporting across multiple channels.

RSL and Company began as a Los Angeles accounting practice founded by Ron Litvak and developed into a boutique business management firm focused on tax and financial services. The company serves real estate owners and developers, entertainment professionals, small businesses, and high-net-worth individuals with work that includes complex tax planning and compliance, cash management, bookkeeping, bill pay, and coordination around estate planning. The firm's services center on accounting and business management, with attention to clients whose financial lives involve multiple income sources, ownership structures, and ongoing reporting needs.

profile.locationBio: Secure Nursing Care, LLC is a regional nurse-staffing agency founded in 2017 and headquartered in Batesville, Mississippi. As a temporary nurse-staffing provider, Secure Nursing Care supplies qualified clinical professionals to facilities facing fluctuating staffing needs. The company emphasizes reliability and regional support, offering flexible employment opportunities for nurses while helping healthcare organizations maintain adequate staffing levels. With a focus on responsive communication and regional outreach, Secure Nursing Care positions itself as a trusted partner for healthcare organizations seeking dependable supplemental staffing. The company maintains a straightforward employment process and encourages clinicians to apply directly through its online platform.

The Consulate General of Belgium in New York is part of Belgium's diplomatic network in the United States and supports Belgian nationals and visa applicants through consular registration, passport and identity card services, document legalization, and emergency assistance. Belgium and the United States established diplomatic relations in the 1830s, and the Belgian consular presence in New York has long served as a point of contact for consular affairs in the country. The New York post handles visa services for Belgium and supports a wide jurisdiction across many U.S. states, while remaining connected to Belgium's broader embassy-and-consulates structure in the United States.

Fate Foods, LLC began in 2019 and has built its business around Dateables, a line of date-based foods. The company focuses on snackable and spreadable products made with wholesome, all-natural ingredients, including date treats, spreads, syrups, and paste. Fate Foods, LLC operates in the food manufacturing and specialty foods space, with products centered on dates as a primary ingredient. The company's market presence is tied to packaged foods and ingredient-driven snacks that appeal to consumers looking for simple, fruit-based alternatives.

Harder Stonerock LLP is a premier law firm headquartered in Los Angeles specializing in media, entertainment, intellectual property, and high-profile business litigation. Known for its elite clientele and expertise in reputation management, the firm provides legal services to celebrities, production companies, digital media platforms, and corporations across the United States.

Niasoff Group LLC is a privately held Limited Liability Company. The company’s official filings position it as an entity that operates within real estate or related investment sectors, consistent with its classification and typical business activity for firms associated with Wilshire Blvd’s business marketplace.

AOG Living provides marketing and management operations consulting to financial institutions and other owner-clients.
