CVS Pharmacy began in 1963 as Consumer Value Stores, a health and beauty retailer that later adopted the CVS name, and pharmacy services were added in Rhode Island in the 1960s. The company now operates as part of CVS Health's pharmacy business, with services that include prescription dispensing, vaccinations, counseling, prescription delivery, mail-order pharmacy, and specialty pharmacy. CVS Pharmacy also serves as a neighborhood retail brand with a broad U.S. presence and a business mix that combines pharmacy care with consumer health and convenience merchandise.

Dakota Enterprises began in the mid-2000s with a first apartment investment in Houston, and that start grew into a vertically integrated real estate business focused on multifamily housing. The company handles acquisition, renovation, ground-up construction, leasing, and property management, with an emphasis on market-rate workforce housing and housing preservation. Dakota Enterprises also develops new communities and manages a growing portfolio across the Greater Houston area. The business continues to expand through projects in multifamily development and construction while supporting community-oriented housing needs in Texas.

Stella Coffee bought a neglected cafe (Carthay Cafe) in an office building in 2018 and with some hard work, a lot of paint, and DIYs it has become a warm and welcoming gem in the neighborhood. Tucked between two office buildings and a public park on San Vicente Blvd, they serve mostly breakfast and lunch to a fast-paced clientele who often have only minutes to eat. This includes private nurses, doctors, and dentists who do not get long lunch breaks.

Renova One began in 1996 and has grown from a flooring-focused business into a nationwide property renovation company. The company serves multifamily, single-family, and commercial clients with flooring and tile work, turnkey services, interior and exterior renovations, roofing, painting, unit turns, and 24/7 emergency restoration. Renova One also supports new construction and tenant improvement projects, bringing renovation, maintenance, and restoration work together for property owners, managers, and developers. The company maintains a broad market presence across the United States through regionally based teams and a service model built around coordinated project delivery.

AshtonBridge Capital is an investment firm focused on commodities, trade finance, and real estate. The company trades physical natural resources, including agricultural, forestry, mineral, and oil and gas products, and invests in real estate to generate returns for investors. The company also offers trade finance and purchase-order financing for businesses, serving a broader role in capital sourcing for hard-to-finance industries. AshtonBridge Capital operates a business model built around commodity trading, property investment, and financing services.

Cryoport is the industry’s most trusted provider of cold chain logistics solutions for temperature-sensitive life sciences materials, serving biopharmaceutical, IVF and surrogacy and animal health organizations around the world. Cryoport’s proprietary Cryoport Express® liquid nitrogen dry vapor shippers, innovative C3™ 2-8°C solution, Cryoportal® logistics management platform, leading-edge Smartpak II® condition monitoring system and geo-sensing technology paired with unparalleled cold chain expertise and 24/7/365 customer support, make Cryoport the end-to-end cold chain logistics partner that you can trust.

Grateful Hair Ministry is a faith-based nonprofit organization located on South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles, dedicated to serving individuals experiencing medical hair loss, particularly cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy. The ministry partners with oncologists, hospitals, foundations, and advocacy organizations to provide custom human-hair cranial prostheses (medical wigs) with dignity, compassion, and cultural sensitivity. Operating by appointment only, the San Vicente Boulevard suite functions as a private fitting and consultation space, not a traditional salon or medical clinic. The organization emphasizes emotional and spiritual support alongside practical services, helping patients maintain confidence and identity during treatment.

Skin by Molly M – Clinical & European Skincare is a boutique, owner-operated skincare clinic located on South San Vicente Boulevard in Los Angeles. The practice specializes in results-driven clinical and European skincare techniques, offering highly customized treatments tailored to individual skin conditions. Services emphasize acne management, advanced facial therapies, and non-invasive skin rejuvenation using professional-grade technologies and products. The San Vicente Boulevard location operates as a non-medical skincare clinic, serving a clientele that includes entertainment and high-profile clients seeking personalized, appointment-based care.

By Hadeel Beauty is a boutique permanent makeup and beauty studio in Los Angeles. Founded in 2019, the studio specializes in microblading, ombré brows, lip blush, brow lamination, and non-invasive skin treatments, serving a diverse clientele seeking long-lasting cosmetic enhancements. The practice operates on an appointment-based model, with services performed by licensed professionals using cosmetic tattoo and advanced esthetic techniques.

Himari operates as a Japanese restaurant located in Houston, Texas. The company provides both dine-in and home delivery options for customers. Their menu includes signature Japanese dishes such as dumplings, sushi rolls, sashimi, noodles, and various other traditional offerings. Established as a private entity, Himari has secured funding to support its operations. The restaurant serves the Houston area with authentic Japanese cuisine through multiple service channels.

Cooking Girl began as a vibrant Sichuan restaurant in Houston, Texas, bringing bold Asian flavors to the city's diverse food scene. The restaurant focuses on traditional cooking techniques with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Their extensive menu features regional Chinese specialties like mapo tofu and cumin lamb alongside popular American-Chinese dishes. Multiple locations across Houston now serve the community with generous portions and attentive service. Cooking Girl has become known for its welcoming atmosphere and flavorful food that captures Sichuan's culinary heritage.

Uovo is an Italian restaurant group based in Los Angeles that serves handmade pasta imported daily from Bologna, Italy. The company was founded in 2017 by brothers Carlo and Lele Massimini along with restaurateur Jerry Greenberg. Their unique concept involves making fresh pasta in Italy using traditional methods and ingredients unavailable in the US, then shipping it overnight for next-day service. Uovo currently operates five Los Angeles locations and plans to expand to New York in 2026. The restaurants offer various tasting menus featuring classic Italian dishes made with their signature imported pasta.

DISH, formerly DISH Network Corporation, began in 1980 as EchoStar, a C-band satellite distributor founded by Charlie Ergen, Candy Ergen, and Jim DeFranco. The business later developed direct broadcast satellite service, and by the 2000s it was focused on pay-TV offerings built around DISH TV, customer equipment, and home entertainment features such as DVR and voice remote tools. In the 2010s, the company expanded into streaming with Sling TV and moved into wireless with DISH Wireless and Boost-related services, making connectivity a broader part of its portfolio. DISH Network later merged with EchoStar and became a wholly owned subsidiary, while the combined business continued to cover satellite, streaming, and wireless communications.

AEI Consultants is an employee-owned consulting firm focused on commercial real estate services, including building, environmental, land, energy, sustainability, and property valuation work. The company was founded in 1992 and serves clients across North America with services that support acquisition due diligence, financing, redevelopment, disposition, compliance, and asset value decisions. AEI Consultants offers bundled consulting across environmental review, building assessments, land surveying, sustainability, and valuation, giving the business a broad role in real property risk evaluation.

Everlast Gates and Fence is a Texas-based contractor specializing in custom gates, fencing, and automated access systems for residential and commercial properties. Founded in 2019, the company operates as a privately held entity and serves clients across the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. Its services include installation and repair of electric and automatic gates, custom iron and wood fencing, and advanced access control systems such as keypads and intercoms. Everlast also offers remodeling and construction services, positioning itself as a comprehensive property improvement provider. The company emphasizes licensed technicians and compliance with safety standards, holding certifications under the Renovation, Repair, and Painting Rule.

The brand operates from its Los Angeles headquarters, which houses its retail storefront, design studio, and production space, and has expanded to include a Miami location. Gallery Dept. continues to push boundaries in the fashion industry by merging art, culture, and individuality into every collection.

Crown of Kreation LLC is a boutique, woman-led barbershop located in the Fairfax District of Los Angeles, California. Established in 2019, the company has built a reputation for delivering high-quality grooming services in a private, personalized setting. Specializing in precision haircuts, fades, tapers, and beard grooming, Crown of Kreation caters to all hair textures and styles, ensuring every client receives a tailored experience. The studio emphasizes comfort, professionalism, and attention to detail, creating an environment where clients feel valued and confident. Unlike traditional barbershops, Crown of Kreation focuses on quality over quantity, offering one-on-one appointments to maintain a high standard of service. The business is independently owned and operated, reflecting a strong commitment to community and customer satisfaction. With its modern approach to barbering and dedication to excellence, Crown of Kreation continues to be a trusted destination for grooming in Los Angeles.

Founded in 2024 by Marcela, a talented tattoo artist with a strong creative vision, Marcela Tattoos has quickly become a go-to destination for custom tattoos in Los Angeles. Marcela combines artistic skill with cultural influences to create meaningful, one-of-a-kind designs for her clients. With a growing social media presence and a reputation for excellence, Marcela Tattoos continues to set trends in the tattoo industry while maintaining a focus on individuality and self-expression.

Sightline Media Group, formerly Gannett Government Media, is a global provider of news, information and marketing solutions in the military, defense, federal technology and C4ISR markets. Our award-winning, independent news organization spans the globe, from our headquarters in the suburbs of the nation’s capital, to eight domestic and international bureaus, with correspondents in 19 countries.

Founded in 1951 by William E. Nassour and Eddy D. Field, the Los Angeles Philanthropic Foundation was created to help exceptional students pursue private college education regardless of background or financial circumstance. The foundation provides scholarships to students at private colleges and universities in Southern California and lists eligibility tied to academic progress, extracurricular involvement, and community service. The organization also operates as a tax-exempt public benefit corporation and supports its mission through donations, legacy gifts, and other charitable contributions. Its program network includes California Institute of Technology, Harvey Mudd College, Mount St. Mary’s University, Pepperdine University, Pomona College, and the University of Southern California.

Fifth Third Bank traces its roots to the Bank of the Ohio Valley and later became Fifth Third National before adopting the Fifth Third Bank name. The company provides consumer and business banking, commercial banking, wealth management, mortgage lending, and payments-related services, with offerings spanning everyday banking, financing, and advisory needs. Fifth Third Bank has served customers since 1858 and now serves individuals, businesses, and communities through a broad U.S. banking network and digital channels.

profile.locationBio: Paduano & Weintraub was founded in 2000 by Anthony Paduano and Len Weintraub after experience at Cahill Gordon & Reindel and Sullivan & Cromwell. Cirrus Asset Management is a privately held real estate management firm founded in 2007. The company specializes in multifamily property management and advisory services, overseeing a portfolio that includes more than 22,000 apartment homes across multiple states. Its operations encompass property management, consulting, and financing solutions, with additional expertise in construction management for client projects. Cirrus emphasizes a process-driven approach, integrating technology and operational strategies to enhance property performance. The firm is licensed by the California Department of Real Estate and has facilitated transactions involving billions in real estate assets. AMC is a leader and innovator of the property management industry, proudly serving apartment homes in Southern California. They operate on a foundation of ethical business practices and a sincere passion for providing homes their VIPs will love. They are on a mission to make coming home the best part of your day. They invite you to join their journey.

McDonald's began as a drive-in restaurant concept in California in 1940 and expanded after Ray Kroc opened the first McDonald's restaurant for the company's system in Illinois in 1955. The company now operates as a global food service retailer built around franchisees, suppliers, restaurant crews, and corporate teams. Its menu and business model center on burgers, breakfast items, beverages, and value meals, supported by a focus on consistency, community connection, and food quality. McDonald's maintains a broad international presence across a wide restaurant system.

Apollon Wealth Management began in 2018 and focuses on financial planning and wealth management for individuals, families, affluent clients, and business owners. The company offers holistic advisory services that include investment advisory, risk management, and business services, with an emphasis on customized planning and long-term client relationships. The company operates a growing national advisory platform and an expanding partner network under Apollon Holdings. Panini Kabob Grill, formerly Panini Cafe, serves Mediterranean cuisine built around kabobs, paninis, wraps, salads, pasta, and catering, with dine-in, takeout, delivery, and online ordering across its California restaurants. Panini Kabob Grill operates locations across Southern California, with the Corona Del Mar restaurant serving as the company's first Mediterranean restaurant location.

Asvar Law is a California law firm focused on catastrophic personal injury and workers' compensation matters. The firm represents injured workers and people hurt through accidents, medical negligence, dangerous property conditions, motor vehicle collisions, and other serious injury cases. Its practice centers on civil litigation and workers' compensation advocacy, with services aimed at helping clients pursue compensation for life-changing injuries. The firm serves clients throughout California and maintains a practice built around serious injury representation and related appeals.

Healing Harvest Texas operates as a medical cannabis provider dedicated to improving patient welfare through professional services. The company emphasizes integrity and accountability while advocating for marijuana's therapeutic uses in conditions like chronic pain and anxiety. Healing Harvest Texas serves both patients and the community by prioritizing education about medical marijuana benefits. The company's approach combines product provision with wellness advocacy and community support initiatives.

Avalon Suites began as a Houston-based flexible workspace provider and now centers on furnished private offices, meeting rooms, conference rooms, and virtual office options. Avalon Suites positions its spaces for professionals, startups, and established businesses that need ready-to-use work settings with onsite, customized, and proactive service. NorthStar Moving began in 1994 as a Los Angeles-based moving company and has grown into a business centered on residential and commercial relocations. The company handles local, long-distance, and international moves, along with full-service storage. Its service mix also includes commercial moving, and the business has emphasized eco-friendly practices such as biodiesel-powered trucks and recyclable packing materials. NorthStar Moving operates as a California-focused mover with a broader reach through regional, national, and international services.

Magic Ice Cube is a California-based company that operates a B2B ecommerce platform for personal protective equipment and related supplies. The business offers masks, gloves, face shields, gowns, hand sanitizer, wipes, thermometers, and disinfecting products, with inventory positioned for pickup or delivery and sales geared toward global corporate buyers. Magic Ice Cube functions as a PPE trading platform with a broader logistics focus, including warehousing and order fulfillment support for commercial customers.

Captain IT began in 2010 and has grown into a managed service provider serving businesses in Southern California. The company focuses on managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud services, network monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and IT consulting for small and mid-sized organizations. Captain IT also provides business continuity planning, governance and compliance support, and related technology services that help clients maintain secure and reliable operations.

Jolt Mobile operates as a wireless connectivity brand focused on broadband SIM plans and portable WiFi devices. The company sells prepaid data SIM cards for hotspots, routers, and IoT devices, along with MiFi devices, internet dongles, and broadband routers that support travel, work, home backup, and connected-device use. Jolt Mobile's product lineup centers on nationwide 5G and 4G LTE data access, and the business also supports online activation, account management, and customer service through its digital storefront.

profile.locationBio: Hanover Company is a family-owned real estate developer founded in 1982 and headquartered in Houston, Texas. The firm operates as a vertically integrated developer, builder, and property manager focused on luxury multifamily residential communities and industrial properties across the United States. The company's multifamily portfolio includes garden-style, mid-rise, and high-rise apartment communities, while its industrial division develops logistics and distribution facilities. Since inception, Hanover has developed over $18 billion in total projects, including more than 70,000 multifamily units and 14 million square feet of industrial space. The company maintains in-house capabilities across development, design, construction, property management, capital markets, and legal functions. Hanover's portfolio spans 18 states and 33 cities, with a geographic concentration in Texas and California. California represents the firm's single-largest state exposure with 36 properties, followed by Texas. The company's top markets by property count include Austin (8 properties), Atlanta (7 properties), and Baltimore (5 properties). Hanover operates through approximately 60 holding entities and maintains lending relationships with Truist Bank, Wells Fargo Bank, and other institutional lenders. The property management division has maintained the highest online reputation score nationwide in the apartment management industry for three consecutive years. Leadership is led by founder Murry Bowden (Executive Chairman), with second-generation family members Brandt Bowden (CEO) and Jeb Bowden (COO) overseeing operations.

Product listings include blends made from rayon, polyester, nylon, cotton, and spandex, showcasing a catalog built around apparel and sewing materials. The brand maintains a fabric vertical and online market presence, while the company's origin history and founding year remain unverified.

Fogelman Properties (Fogelman) is one of the country’s largest and most experienced privately-owned multifamily investment and property management companies. As a fully integrated company, Fogelman specializes in multifamily acquisitions, property management, construction management, and asset management. Nationwide, Fogelman operates 98 multifamily communities totaling more than 30,000 apartment homes across 13 states in the Southeast, Southwest and Midwest. Pan Am Equities has built a solid reputation as one of Manhattan’s preeminent developers and managers of residential properties. The company is dedicated to maintaining exceptional quality, service and attention to detail, ensuring the most desirable lifestyle for its residents. This unparalleled combination provides the highest level of resident service and satisfaction.

Cotton Holdings began in 1996 when Pete Bell and Daryn Ebrecht founded the business to serve organizations needing restoration and business continuity support. The company describes itself as a global, diversified holding company that provides property restoration and recovery, construction, roofing, consulting, workforce staffing, temporary workforce housing, and culinary services through a group of subsidiaries. Cotton Holdings says its brands support public and private entities with turnkey disaster response and operational support across North America and internationally. The company also notes a long-standing role in recovery work tied to major storms, wildfires, and other large-scale disruption events.

Kaiser Permanente began as a health care model developed in the 1940s and grew into an integrated managed care organization built around health plans, hospitals, and Permanente medical groups. The company provides medical care, coverage, preventive services, pharmacy support, and care coordination through a system designed to connect physicians, hospitals, and insurance functions. Kaiser Permanente also supports medical education, research, and community health programs, reflecting a broad presence across care delivery and health improvement efforts.

Flyby Robotics began as Kiki Airlift before adopting its current name and building a business around programmable drone systems. The company develops the F-11 Series, a drone platform with onboard compute for machine learning, programmatic flight control, payload integration, and air-based data collection, with use cases that include ISR, photogrammetry, image capture, and custom developer workflows. Flyby Robotics maintains detailed developer documentation and offers GPS-denied navigation capabilities through work tied to Palantir, positioning the company in the robotics, aerospace, and drone software markets.

Michelson Philanthropies traces its work to 2005, when Dr. Gary K. Michelson began grouping a set of philanthropic organizations under the Michelson Philanthropies umbrella after selling his patent portfolio. Michelson Philanthropies operates as a private operating foundation and uses grantmaking, impact investing, advocacy, and direct programs to support vulnerable and underserved communities. The organization's network includes initiatives focused on medical research, animal welfare, education, intellectual property, and criminal justice reform. Michelson Philanthropies serves communities across California and beyond through research grants, prizes, strategic investments, policy work, and program support.

Los Angeles Unified School District is a public K-12 district serving much of Los Angeles and surrounding communities in southwestern Los Angeles County. The current district was established in 1961, with roots that trace back to city school systems formed in the late nineteenth century, and the district has since developed a broad network of elementary, middle, high, and alternative programs. The district's work includes general education, special education, early childhood education, adult education, magnet programs, dual-language offerings, and student support services, giving the organization a broad educational footprint across the region.

Annex Business Center provides flexible workspace solutions, including virtual offices and private offices. The company serves entrepreneurs and businesses needing professional addresses and administrative support. Services include business formation assistance, such as registrations and certificate procurement. Annex Business Center also offers graphic design and web services. The company operates in Houston, Texas and New Orleans, Louisiana.

The Advocates are a team of experienced injury attorneys dedicated to the people throughout the great state of Utah. They take pride in providing victims of personal injury accidents a voice in the legal process and control over their own recovery. After you have been injured in an accident caused by the dangerous or negligent behavior of another individual, you need help getting what is fair from the insurance company. When you are the victim of a personal injury, it is often easy to feel lost, alone, and unheard. Insurance companies will do whatever they can to take advantage of you during your time of need. Don’t worry. The attorneys with The Advocates are here to help you recover.

Kadence International began in London in 1991 and has expanded into a global market research business serving clients across the UK, Europe, Asia, and the US. The company provides full-service research across customer understanding, new product development, brand creation, communications, and wider insight work for organizations seeking data-driven decisions. Kadence International supports international research projects through local market expertise, multilingual capability, and a network of regional offices and partners. The business publishes market research content and client-focused resources, reflecting an active presence in the global research services market.

Olida is a privately held real estate services company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. Founded in 2019, the organization provides flexible, on-demand office space solutions specifically designed for therapy and wellness professionals. Through its membership model, Olida offers clinicians short-term access to fully furnished, sound-treated therapy rooms without long-term lease commitments. The company operates multiple locations across major metropolitan areas in the United States, including Chicago, New York, Los Angeles, and the Bay Area. Olida supports practitioners by providing amenities such as high-speed internet, printing services, private lounges, and secure digital check-in systems. Membership also includes access to a growing therapist community and professional visibility through an online directory. As a service-driven platform, the company focuses on enabling independent clinicians to manage and scale their practices more efficiently. Olida operates as a privately held entity and functions from its main office in Los Angeles.

Robin Hunter, LMFT is a marriage and family therapy practice built around Robin Hunter's work in private practice and prior experience as a clinical supervisor in outpatient county mental health clinics in Southern California. The practice provides therapy for individuals, couples, and families, with a focus on concerns such as anxiety, depression, family conflict, stress, divorce, parenting, and life transitions, and it uses approaches including cognitive behavioral therapy and structural family therapy. The practice operates in California with virtual service availability and maintains a Los Angeles-area location in the 90049 ZIP code, reflecting a Southern California market presence rather than a single neighborhood focus.

The California State Board of Optometry was created by the California Legislature in 1913 to safeguard public health, safety, and welfare through oversight of optometry. The board operates under the California Department of Consumer Affairs and focuses on licensing, regulation, and consumer protection for optometry and opticianry. Its work includes evaluating licensure applications, administering or coordinating examination and licensing processes, publishing laws and regulations guidance, and providing consumer information and complaint resources. The board also maintains enforcement information, including citations and disciplinary actions, as part of its public-facing regulatory role.

Wells Fargo maintains a broad national and global business presence built through years of expansion and mergers, while continuing to emphasize financial services for households, businesses, and communities.

Lavazza began in 1895 when Luigi Lavazza opened a small shop in Turin and built a business around blending coffee from different origins. The Sinay Company, LLC is a privately held real estate investment and management firm based in Century City, Los Angeles. We believe in an approach that is upstream of the client’s strategic planning and is predicated on shaping opinion and building brands. We drive our teams and our clients towards outcomes that move the needle. Ultimate Performance began in 2009 as a personal training business founded by Nick Mitchell. The business operates as a premium health and fitness platform with international reach.

Unisource also describes additional verticals that include joint ventures, affiliated relationships, and custom programming and technology services, showing a broader focus than core title and escrow work. The business presents itself as a national provider with direct operations and customized service solutions for national and regional financial institutions.

Keystone Document Discovery began in 1993 as a litigation support firm serving law firms and corporate clients. The company provides services that include trial binders, paper discovery and scanning, e-discovery, forensic collections, web hosting, cybersecurity support, and attorney managed review. The business also serves corporate legal departments with discovery services designed to streamline document handling and help manage cost and risk. Keystone Document Discovery has built its work around legal and corporate matters that require document processing, review, and digital evidence management.

Square Nine Capital was founded by an experienced investment team and focuses on bespoke credit investments that are designed to optimize the capital structures of middle-market companies. Square Nine’s platform serves public and private middle-market businesses across industries, with financing activity extending across North America and Europe. Melmed Law Group P.C. is a Century City–based law firm that focuses exclusively on employment and labor law litigation on behalf of employees. Founded in 2015, the firm represents individuals in complex matters involving wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, wage-and-hour violations, class action claims, and Private Attorneys General Act (PAGA) litigation.

Sarraf Law Firm is a Century City–based personal injury law firm serving clients throughout California. Founded in the mid-1990s, the firm focuses on representing individuals injured in automobile accidents, pedestrian incidents, premises liability cases, and other serious injury matters. The practice is led by attorney Raymond H. Sarraf, who personally handles client cases and litigation strategy.

Briones PC is a boutique litigation law firm based in Los Angeles, California, focused on high-stakes class action defense and complex privacy litigation. The firm is led by founder Joshua Briones and is known for defending “bet-the-company” cases involving consumer protection statutes, data privacy, website tracking, and technology-driven claims. The firm serves clients across California and Nevada and centers its work on litigation, settlement negotiations, and courtroom representation in injury and civil cases.

Much, formerly Much Shelist, began in 1970 as a Chicago law firm founded by Morrie Much and Michael Shelist. Its work also includes estate planning and wealth transfer, employee benefits, insurance policyholder matters, startups and venture capital, and technology, data, and financial regulation. The firm operates as a relationship-driven practice focused on practical legal counsel for businesses across a broad range of industries.

Kasowitz is a litigation law firm that traces its origins to 1993, when it began as Kasowitz, Hoff, Benson & Torres and later adopted the current name Kasowitz LLP. The firm centers on commercial litigation and also handles bankruptcy and restructuring, real estate, securities, antitrust, white collar defense, employment, intellectual property, and corporate matters. Kasowitz serves clients that include private equity firms, investment firms, and companies across financial services, technology, and real estate. The firm maintains a broad U.S. presence with New York as its headquarters and largest office.

Nosrati Law is a Century City–based employment law firm that represents employees in disputes involving workplace discrimination, harassment, retaliation, wrongful termination, and wage-and-hour violations. Founded in 2003 by attorney Omid Nosrati, the firm focuses exclusively on labor and employment law, providing plaintiff-side representation throughout Los Angeles and Southern California.

Sherwood Partners began in 1992 as a business advisory firm built around crisis management, restructuring, and financial advisory work. Sherwood Partners serves clients across venture-backed, distressed, and special-situation engagements, with a market presence centered on practical execution and fiduciary oversight.

Odeon Capital Group began in 2008 and has grown into a financial services firm focused on capital markets, corporate advisory, and investment banking work. The company offers sales, trading, and research services across structured products, corporate securities, municipals, treasuries, and related fixed-income products, while also serving clients that include companies, asset managers, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals. Odeon Capital Group is a broker-dealer with a research-driven approach and a client-first model that supports both market intelligence and execution. Its business spans brokerage, investment banking, and research for institutional and other professional clients.

KTBS Law LLP (f/k/a Klee, Tuchin, Bogdanoff & Stern LLP) is a national, boutique law firm that specializes in business reorganizations, distressed corporate transactions, and insolvency-related litigation and appellate advocacy.  KTBS frequently represents debtors, creditors, equity holders, committees, trustees, landlords, potential acquirers of assets, and other parties with interests in financially distressed businesses, both in and out of court in matters of significance nationwide.  KTBS’s bankruptcy and litigation attorneys have also developed expertise representing official creditors’ committees and ad hoc plaintiffs’ groups in significant “mass tort” bankruptcy cases across the country.

City National Bank began in 1954 as a California bank and later became part of Royal Bank of Canada. The firm emphasizes litigation in state and federal court, along with representation aimed at verdicts and settlements in injury, employment, and property matters. The firm maintains a broad civil litigation practice built around dispute resolution for individuals and businesses, with more than five decades of combined legal experience among the attorneys.

Tarantino Properties began in 1980 as a Texas-based real estate firm. The company provides services across multiple sectors including commercial, multifamily, and senior living properties. Tarantino serves both institutional and private clients through customized real estate solutions.

Seldin Company is a leading property management firm with deep roots throughout the Central United States. 

Headquartered in the heart of the Great Plains (Omaha, NE), Seldin was founded in 1923 and engages in the management and expansion of multifamily apartment communities. Yourist Law is a boutique legal practice built by Bradley J. Yourist and Daniel J. Yourist, and the firm emphasizes direct communication, personal service, and practical guidance. Drake Real Estate Group is a privately held commercial real estate firm focused on multifamily property management, acquisition, and value-add repositioning. The business serves clients seeking one-on-one guidance, small-group workouts, bootcamps, and structured training sessions built around health and lifestyle improvement.

As a fully integrated owner-operator, Spring manages construction, leasing, property management, and asset optimization through its in-house teams. This structure enables the firm to execute renovations and business plans efficiently, improve property performance, and maintain direct oversight throughout the investment lifecycle.

Spring combines deep local market knowledge with established capital relationships and an extensive broker network to source both marketed and off-market opportunities. Known for reliable execution and certainty of closing, the firm seeks middle-market multifamily acquisitions where disciplined underwriting, targeted improvements, and active management can create lasting value for investors and residents.

Phillips, Erlewine, Given & Carlin LLP is a California law firm with roots in San Francisco and a practice that has expanded beyond a single office over time. The firm represents workers, consumers, artists, businesses, and other clients in matters ranging from workplace disputes and privacy claims to copyright, trademark, and complex litigation. The firm maintains continued activity in employment, privacy, and entertainment matters, reflecting an ongoing focus on litigation and dispute resolution.

Sushi Zo focuses on Edomae-style omakase, with seasonal chef's-choice meals built around carefully selected seafood, seasoned rice, and dishes served one at a time at the right moment for balance and texture. The company later expanded beyond Southern California into New York and several international markets, while keeping the same sushi-centered format and traditional approach. Sushi Zo is a long-running omakase destination in Los Angeles with a strong reputation for traditional sushi preparation.

School district resources, private school resources, member materials, and an online store provide access to training content and program tools.

Its work spans clients from startups to Fortune 100s across categories such as SaaS, CPG, B2B, D2C, nonprofits, and academia. Panda Express is a quick-service restaurant chain specializing in American Chinese cuisine. The brand was founded in 1983 and is part of Panda Restaurant Group, which also includes other dining concepts. Panda Express focuses on restaurant service built around familiar Chinese-inspired dishes, including signature entrées and seasonal menu items. Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg was founded in 1993 with a focus on sophisticated legal capabilities delivered through a personalized, collaborative approach. The firm handles professional liability defense, securities litigation and arbitration, commercial and business litigation, insurance coverage and litigation, labor and employment matters, data privacy and cybersecurity, intellectual property, and construction-related disputes. Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg also advises on contract matters, surety and fidelity issues, reinsurance, subrogation, and arbitration or mediation. The firm has grown into a nationally recognized practice with a broad litigation and advisory platform serving businesses, financial institutions, insurers, and professionals.

Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. began as an insurance agency founded in 1927 and has since grown into a global business focused on insurance brokerage, risk management, and consulting services. The company plans, designs, and administers property and casualty insurance programs, while also providing claims and information management, risk control consulting, appraisals, and HR and benefits consulting services. Gallagher operates through brokerage and risk management lines of business and serves clients through owned operations and a correspondent network across international markets.

Accelerate Partners began in 1994 as a technology advisory firm and later expanded into AI-focused consulting and speaking work. The company now helps organizations navigate AI strategy, governance, adoption, and related business planning, while also offering keynotes and executive education on emerging technologies. Its founder's background spans early internet services, product work at major technology companies, and ongoing investment and advisory activity in AI, which shapes the firm's market position in business and technology consulting. The company works with emerging and established technology organizations, reflecting a broader advisory presence across business verticals.

UPS began in 1907 as a small messenger service started with a $100 loan, and the United Parcel Service name appeared in 1919 as the business expanded beyond Seattle. Today, the company operates as a transportation and logistics provider with package delivery at its core, along with freight forwarding, warehousing, customs clearance, digital logistics, and broader supply chain solutions. UPS serves customers of many sizes across a wide international network as a global service provider.

Midstream Texas Operating LLC is a private equity-backed petrochemical storage and logistics company focused on midstream infrastructure and energy-product handling. The company operates a petroleum terminal in Ingleside with marine, rail, and truck connectivity, and it markets storage and transportation services for oil and other energy industry products. In the early 2020s, the business announced a truck-to-rail transload project in Corpus Christi to move petroleum and petrochemicals into Mexico, extending its rail-linked logistics footprint. The company provides on-site services that include product testing, heating support, and truck scale capabilities.

SERVPRO began in 1967 as a painting business in Sacramento, California, and later expanded into a franchise system focused on cleaning and restoration. The company provides residential and commercial services that include water and fire damage mitigation, mold remediation, storm response, construction, general cleaning, specialty cleaning, and reconstruction. SERVPRO's business model centers on local franchise professionals supported by national systems for emergency response and disaster recovery. The company continues to operate as a nationwide franchisor focused on cleanup, restoration, and rebuilding services after property damage.

Villoura began as a luxury rental platform centered on curated villas, estates, and mansions for travelers seeking premium stays in Los Angeles. The company offers furnished accommodations for short trips and extended stays, and its services include concierge support, guest assistance, and security coordination. Villoura also works in property management and home marketing for owners looking to place high-end residences in a managed rental portfolio. The company focuses on hand-selected homes across neighborhoods such as Beverly Hills, Malibu, Bel-Air, Hollywood Hills, West Hollywood, and Brentwood, reflecting a business built around upscale hospitality and managed residential stays.

Legent Health began in 2017 as a provider of surgical services and has grown into a network of ambulatory surgery centers and surgical hospitals. The company focuses on orthopedic and spine care and also supports related services in pain management, general surgery, gastrointestinal care, and other procedure-based specialties. Legent Health works through physician partnerships and a patient-centered model that emphasizes minimally invasive treatment, comfortable facilities, and a streamlined care experience.

TechCorr began operations in 2003 as an industrial services provider specializing in asset integrity management. The company offers non-destructive testing, advanced inspections, and fabrication services for critical infrastructure across multiple sectors. Their service portfolio includes corrosion surveys, pipeline integrity assessments, and robotic inspections using drones and crawlers. TechCorr maintains a significant presence in the energy industry while also serving petrochemical, manufacturing, and transportation clients. The company operates globally with numerous locations throughout North America and international offices.

LA Fingerprints built its business around identity-verification services for people and organizations that need background-check processing, licensing paperwork, and related document support. The company focuses on live scan fingerprinting, FBI ink cards, mobile fingerprinting, and notary services, while also offering passport photos, apostille services, certified translation services, immigration fingerprinting, FINRA fingerprinting, Florida live scan services, and ATF fingerprinting. LA Fingerprints also supports federal and state submission workflows through DOJ- and FBI-related fingerprinting services, and it maintains a service model that includes both scheduled appointments and walk-in options. The business operates in Los Angeles and serves clients from that market as a fingerprinting and notary provider.

DMI General Contractor began as a Houston-based construction and remodeling business serving residential and commercial clients. The company focuses on complete rehabs, remodels, kitchens, bathrooms, patios, outdoor kitchens, driveways, decks, siding, and broader repair work that supports property improvements. DMI General Contractor's services emphasize building, restoration, and enhancement projects that improve structural integrity, curb appeal, and everyday functionality for homes and businesses. The company operates as a general contractor in Houston, which aligns with its construction and remodeling focus.

The Home Depot began in 1978 as a home improvement retailer founded by Bernie Marcus and Arthur Blank. The company sells tools, construction products, appliances, and related services, and the business also includes digital shopping and pro-focused offerings for professional customers. The Home Depot operates a broad retail network across North America and continues to expand merchandise and service options around home projects, maintenance, and repair.

Vulcan Seals began in 1986, when Gerry Quinn founded the business to develop products for the single spring mechanical seal market. The company designs, manufactures, and supplies mechanical seals, FEP/PFA encapsulated O-rings and seals, gland packing, and expanded PTFE gasketing for industrial use. Product offerings also include OEM replacement seals, pump seal kits, and cross-reference tools that support replacement across a range of equipment. Vulcan Seals serves industrial verticals including chemical processing, water, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, mining, marine, refrigeration, and semiconductor manufacturing.

Securitas Technology traces its roots to Securitas' security heritage dating back to 1934 and emerged in its current form through the combination of STANLEY Security and Securitas Electronic Security. The company provides integrated electronic security solutions and services, including design, installation, monitoring, maintenance, and system integration for organizations across industries. Securitas Technology works across security, health, and safety technologies, with offerings that include video systems, intrusion detection, access control, fire detection, visitor management, and related connected services. As part of the wider Securitas group, the business emphasizes a global footprint and long operating history in protecting people, property, and assets.

Texas Furniture Installation Services was established in 2012 and brings more than two decades of experience in commercial furniture work. The company provides office furniture installation, corporate workspace setup, retail fixture installation, phone pod installation, office relocation, project management, reconfiguration, repair, upholstery, and storage services. Texas Furniture Installation Services works with corporate offices and also serves healthcare, education, retail, hospitality, financial, consulting, technology, and government clients across Texas. Family-owned operations and free estimates are part of the company's service model.

TnV Energy Services is a Houston-based electrical rig-up service and panel shop company serving the oilfield sector. The company focuses on electrical services for projects that need rig-up support, panel-shop work, and coordination around schedules and timelines. The Texas entity T&V Energy Services, LLC maintains active status, which supports the company's ongoing presence in Houston's energy-services market.

Van Sharks began as a Houston business centered on custom van conversion and repair, and the company now focuses on Sprinter-based builds and related vehicle services. The company offers custom conversions for road travel, off-grid living, family use, remote work, and mobile business applications, along with fleet services, van servicing, maintenance scheduling, DIY kits, and interior and electrical upgrade products. The company also works in mobile med spa interiors, custom cabinetry, and maintenance support, demonstrating a business model that combines fabrication, customization, and aftercare for van owners and commercial users.

Clinica Hispana Cruz 2 operates as an outpatient medical clinic focused on accessible family care for the Hispanic community. By at least 2024, the business was publishing material on preventive health and routine testing, and the clinic provides care for blood pressure, cholesterol, triglycerides, thyroid issues, immigration exams, gynecology, urology, and sexually transmitted infections. The clinic also offers chronic disease support for conditions such as diabetes and arthritis, along with minor procedures including wound suturing, ear washing, and toenail removal. The overall service mix shows a general medical practice centered on primary care, prevention, and selected specialty services.

YEAT UP Organization is a private nonprofit initiative focused on youth support through food access and enrichment programming. The organization offers a food program and seasonal classes that combine nutritious meals with homework assistance, academic tutoring, creative activities, and hands-on learning. Program offerings include STEM activities, cooking classes, and other youth enrichment services for children and teens facing food insecurity or limited academic resources. The organization began as a community-based nonprofit effort in Houston and has built its work around youth development, nourishment, and educational support.

St. Hope Healthcare began in 1999 as a nonprofit community healthcare organization and later expanded from transportation support into medical care delivered through a mobile unit. The company now serves the Greater Houston area as a community health center and provides primary medical care, dentistry, pharmacy, behavioral health, optometry, podiatry, medical imaging, diabetes care, HIV specialty care, hepatitis treatment, prevention services, well-woman care, and nutrition services. St. Hope operates as a patient-centered, federally qualified community health center with a broad care model focused on underserved communities.

With humble beginnings and the determination of its three founding partners—Jim Clayton, Bill Williams, and Steve Sherwood—CWS began managing investment properties in 1969 with a single asset in Southern California. To grow the business, the founders identified potential in under-valued mobile home parks, a strategy they pursued for the next 20 years. By the 1980s, CWS had become one of the largest owners and operators of manufactured home communities in the United States, setting the stage for a transition into apartment community management. In the 1990s, alongside acquiring apartment communities, CWS expanded into the development of newly constructed luxury apartments. Within 10 years of its first apartment acquisition, CWS had surpassed 13,000 apartment homes. Today, CWS continues to specialize in the acquisition, development, management, and disposition of luxury apartment communities nationwide, now with more than 29,000 apartment homes.

The business centers its work on faster, more actionable insight for geology, completions, reservoir, and production workflows.

The company now builds and deploys multi-sensor condition monitoring and predictive maintenance solutions that combine thermal, vibration, visual, environmental, acoustic, and laser sensing with AI-powered software. MultiSensor AI's platform is used for industrial reliability and process control across sectors such as distribution and logistics, manufacturing, utilities, and oil and gas, with a focus on detecting failures early and reducing unplanned downtime.

Hello Sugar operates a waxing and sugaring studio in Mesa, Arizona, providing a wide range of hair-removal services for men and women. They offer Brazilian waxing, full-body waxing, sugaring, and skincare treatments. Services are offered by trained estheticians who use standardized techniques designed to support consistency and comfort across treatments.

The firm began as a boutique legal practice with roots in Los Angeles and an early focus on real estate work, then broadened into a wider business-law platform. The firm serves clients across a broad range of industries, from smaller enterprises to larger corporations, with a market presence centered on commercial and real estate matters in Southern California.

Murad Auctions provides charity auction services for live, silent, virtual, and hybrid fundraising events, along with event-day support and related production services such as audio-visual, photo booth, DJ, and printing solutions. The company works with nonprofits, schools, and other fundraising organizations, and its service offerings also include consulting, planning, and fundraising event resources for galas, donor dinners, golf tournaments, and similar events. Murad Auctions is focused on helping organizations improve fundraising outcomes through auction strategy and execution, and the business has operated since 2000.

Starbucks began in Seattle's Pike Place Market in 1971 as a roaster and retailer of whole bean and ground coffee, tea, and spices. The company later became a coffeehouse focused on serving coffee with a café experience and a welcoming place for customers to gather. Today, Starbucks operates a broad retail business that includes handcrafted drinks, food, cups and merchandise, and at-home coffee products. Starbucks also serves customers across numerous markets and continues to emphasize coffee quality, human connection, and community-minded service.

Stern Property Management is one of Los Angeles’ premiere property management companies and is responsible for the improvement and ongoing profitability of over 1000 apartment and retail/commercial units. The company’s track record is based on ongoing tenant satisfaction and occupancy rates averaging between 95% and 97%. In addition to the spectrum of property management services, Stern’s provides its clients with rental property rehabilitation management and investment syndication expertise. With over a decade of experience and a well-oiled team of subcontractors and business partners, they can’t wait to improve your properties’ performance.

Founded in 1996, UPPF is a leading enterprise in the automotive film industry in China's automotive aftermarket. They have a world-class factory that specializes in high-end automotive film research and development, production and sales. Besides, their facility boasts one-of-a-kind production equipment, patented technology, an automated production line, and strict quality assurance, all of which contribute to the development of high-quality film that is consistent from one roll to the next. UPPF products have been exported to over 80 countries and regions worldwide. In China, they have over 1000 retail stores and over 2000 cooperative high-end car stores, and they have provided professional automotive film service for over 10 million medium and high-end cars.

They offer multifamily, BTR, and retail property management services and a broad range of customized services, including market analysis, underwriting, deal sourcing, new development consulting, and branding and design. They bring specialized living experiences to life for residents at more than 700 properties nationwide and empower their associates to build fulfilling careers serving their owners and residents.

Chipotle Mexican Grill began in 1993 with a single restaurant and grew into a fast-casual restaurant company centered on burritos, burrito bowls, tacos, quesadillas, and salads. Chipotle emphasizes responsibly sourced ingredients, classic cooking methods, and a customizable ordering style built around made-to-order meals. The company operates a broad restaurant network in the United States and also serves international markets through company-owned and partner-operated restaurants. Chipotle supports digital ordering, delivery, catering, rewards, fundraising, and sustainability programs as part of its broader business model.

The Los Angeles Business Council began in 1936 and has long worked as a business advocacy organization in Los Angeles. The council focuses on public policy, education, and coalition-building around housing, green building, energy efficiency, transportation, solar development, and broader economic development. The organization presents research and convenings through its institute and event programming, including work tied to sustainability and architectural recognition. The council is a regional business organization working across business, government, environmental, labor, and nonprofit sectors.

Quanta Services is a leading specialized contracting services company, delivering comprehensive infrastructure solutions for the utility, renewable energy, communications, pipeline and energy industries. Quanta's comprehensive services include designing, installing, repairing and maintaining energy and communications infrastructure. With operations throughout the United States, Canada, Australia and select other international markets, Quanta has the manpower, resources and expertise to safely complete projects that are local, regional, national or international in scope.

Hi-Tech Truck Rigging began as a Houston-area business started in 1946 and has grown around custom truck and van upfitting, fabrication, and equipment installation. Work spans industries such as oil and gas, agriculture, construction, transport, utility, and field service, with installations and conversions built for specialized commercial use. Global Importing Group operates as a food importer and distributor focused on imported groceries and beverage categories. Old Navy began in 1994 as Gap Warehouse before adopting its current name, and the brand has since built a broad presence in apparel and accessories. The brand's mix of everyday basics and fashion-driven collections has kept Old Navy positioned as a large mass-market retailer in the clothing space.

F45 Training offers studio-based workouts, a mobile app, guided challenge programs, recovery support, nutrition guidance, and corporate wellness options. Cuballama began as a service focused on connecting people with Cuba through mobile recharges and calls, and the business later expanded into shipping, travel, and online shopping services. Service lines also include business cards, book printing, and other print products used by businesses that need marketing and production support. The firm is a full-service printing and marketing provider serving a broad customer base in the Los Angeles market and beyond.

Valet Living began in 1995 as Valet Waste, built around doorstep trash and recycling collection for multifamily communities. The company later expanded beyond waste collection into premium home-related amenity services, turn services, maintenance support, pet solutions, and app-enabled resident services. Solar One is a commercial and industrial solar development firm established in 2017. Solar One provides development, engineering, procurement, construction, and operations and maintenance services through a self-performing model. Solar One designs and installs on-site solar and battery energy systems for rooftops, open land, and parking areas, serving businesses, educational facilities, dealerships, and multifamily properties. The company maintains a national portfolio and focuses on helping customers reduce energy costs, manage incentives, and support sustainability goals.

Kolache Bar is a Houston bakery and café focused on kolaches, croissants, sandwiches, donuts, cakes, pastries, and drinks. The business centers its menu on fresh breakfast items and rotating seasonal flavors, with kolaches offered in savory and sweet styles. The Houston location serves breakfast hours and menu items such as breakfast sandwiches, croissants, donuts, and iced coffee, maintaining an active market presence in the local breakfast and pastry category.

The company sits within a business line with more than 20 years in the Mexican electricity sector, and Saavi continues to expand its energy footprint through asset combinations and solar activity. Saavi Energy Solutions therefore operates as a commercial energy provider tied to a wider platform focused on supply, generation, and energy commercialization.

Asset Living is a third-party property management firm founded in 1986 that serves multifamily, student, and affordable housing communities across the United States. The company also works in active adult and build-to-rent housing, combining property management with services such as compliance training, financial planning, marketing, underwriting, due diligence, construction management, and data analytics. Asset Living operates as a broad real estate management platform that supports owners and institutional partners through property management, asset management, receivership, and investment services. The company maintains a national operating footprint built around residential real estate management and related support functions.

Greysteel was founded in 2012 as a commercial real estate advisory firm built to combine investment sales with debt and structured finance services. Greysteel has since developed a national platform that serves private, middle-market, and institutional investors across the United States. Greysteel's core business centers on investment sales, debt placement, and structured finance, with sector-specific advisory across property types such as healthcare, affordable housing, multifamily, office, retail, industrial, and other asset classes. Greysteel is a national commercial real estate and capital markets services firm continuing to expand its advisory footprint.

Drake Real Estate Group is a privately held commercial real estate firm focused on multifamily property management, acquisition, and value-add repositioning. Founded in 2014, the company operates primarily in Southern California and specializes in third-party management of apartment communities alongside investment and redevelopment activities. Its core services include day-to-day operational management, capital improvement oversight, and asset repositioning strategies for multifamily properties.

American Landmark was founded in 2016 following the sale of Landmark Apartment Trust, building on a long operating history in multifamily real estate. The company owns and operates apartment communities across the Sun Belt and focuses on acquisition, repositioning, and professional property management. American Landmark emphasizes resident services, investor returns, and team development as part of its business model. The company maintains a broad portfolio and a market presence that spans several states, with the business centered on multifamily housing rather than a single local market.

Pacifica Companies is a privately held real estate developer, owner, investor, and investment manager founded in 1978 by Ash Israni. The firm operates as a vertically integrated platform with a diversified portfolio spanning multiple asset classes and geographies. The company pursues an opportunistic investment strategy across senior housing, hospitality, multifamily, retail, office, industrial, and master-planned communities throughout the United States, India, and Mexico. Since entering the Indian market in 2004, Pacifica has expanded its footprint to cities including Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Chennai, Hyderabad, and Bangalore. In the United States, the company maintains operations across multiple asset classes with geographic exposure concentrated in California, Florida, Arizona, Utah, and New York. Through its hotel division, Pacifica Host Hotels, the firm owns and operates over 30 properties under brands including Marriott, Hampton Inn, Doubletree, and Holiday Inn. The senior living division manages approximately 80 to 100 communities nationwide, operating independent living, assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing facilities. The firm partners with pension funds, institutional banks, investors, and real estate funds for strategic investing ventures.

Solaris Global was created to address a gap in solar-industry logistics and supply-chain support for turnkey projects. Solaris Global focuses on end-to-end solar supply-chain services that include warehousing, distribution, pick and pack, trucking solutions, freight forwarding, full bonded truck brokerage, jobsite offloading, rigging, and piling, racking, and mounting support. Solaris Global emphasizes communication, cargo monitoring, and value-added service throughout each project, with an approach built around helping move solar equipment from transport through installation. The company operates within the broader renewable-energy logistics market and maintains solar supply-chain work as its core business focus.

Accurate Methods began in 2008, when experience in finance, accounting, and tax work pointed to a need for an alternative to traditional in-house accounting departments. The company has grown into a boutique full-service bookkeeping and financial services consulting firm serving small to mid-sized businesses and non-profits. Its work covers bookkeeping, advanced bookkeeping, outsourced CFO and controller support, and project-based consulting and review, including financial cleanup, planning, analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and QuickBooks implementation and training. Accurate Methods also emphasizes support for clients that need scalable accounting processes and help with recordkeeping, reporting, and financial operations.

Graphene One is a graphene materials company that develops graphene powder, graphene oxide, and Kyorene, a graphene-infused fiber line used in textiles and other high-performance materials. The company traces its graphene work to research and development that began in 2009 under QS Safety, and later moved into commercial graphene fiber production. Kyorene has applications in knitting, home textiles, industrial fabrics, and related materials, with uses tied to thermal regulation, odor control, and mechanical strength. The company is a producer of graphene-based technical fibers and related products, reflecting a focus on materials manufacturing rather than broad consumer retail.

Pattern Ventures is a specialist fund of funds that focuses on partnering with exceptional small venture funds and emerging managers in the early-stage venture landscape. The firm was built by Nico Mizrahi and Alex Kassan after identifying an opportunity to back new venture talent with a model centered on manager selection, capital access, and portfolio support. Pattern Ventures combines fund-of-funds investing with co-investment activity and uses a data-driven approach to identify and support emerging managers. The business is positioned around venture capital fund allocation rather than direct operating-company ownership, with HARDCAP extending access for managers seeking investor relationships.

Ceviche Ria began as a Baja-style seafood concept that grew out of Tomball and later expanded across the greater Houston area. The company serves made-to-order ceviches, aguachiles, tostadas, rice bowls, Baja tacos, seafood cocktails, and related pickup, delivery, and catering offerings. Ceviche Ria positions the business around fresh Latin American flavors and a fast-casual dining format, with a market presence that now includes Tomball, Houston, Spring, and The Woodlands.

TTR Shipping began in 2003 as a family business and has grown into a specialized transportation and logistics company focused on high-value assets. The company handles copier shipping, office moving, warehousing, lease returns, and equipment relocation, with services that also include IT equipment, medical equipment, e-waste recycling, and hard-drive wiping. TTR Shipping says it provides coast-to-coast coverage across the United States and also supports some international shipping needs. The business presents itself as a white-glove operation built around careful handling, customer service, and tracking support for commercial shipments.

The Madison Real Estate Group is a full-service commercial real estate firm with a strong presence across California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, Florida, and Texas. Known for its commitment to excellence, Madison prioritizes hiring talented professionals with college degrees and equipping them with the training necessary to consistently deliver the high-quality results its partners expect.

With a robust portfolio of well-managed, attractive communities, Madison takes a long-term, relationship-driven approach to business. The company seeks partners who align with its philosophy of trust-building and sustained collaboration. Across all engagements, Madison upholds a standard of integrity and mutual satisfaction, fostering productive and enduring partnerships.

RPM is an Austin, Texas-based multifamily property owner-operator, investment, and development firm active across the United States. Founded in 2002 as Roscoe Property Management by Jason Berkowitz, the company began with just 10 units under management. Through both organic growth and strategic mergers, RPM Living has evolved into one of the nation's largest multifamily operators. 

The firm manages 226,169 units across 26 states. RPM operates through a vertically integrated platform encompassing property management, investment acquisitions, and development. The company maintains 12 regional offices. In 2021, RPM merged with Atlanta-based CF Real Estate Services, expanding its footprint across the Southeast and Midwest. This transaction added approximately 26,000 units to the portfolio. The merger with CF Real Estate Services brought together leadership from both organizations under the RPM brand. 

RPM's assets total a portfolio valued at $3 billion. The company's operations span conventional multifamily, student housing, senior living, and affordable housing sectors. In 2023, RPM Living experienced its largest year of growth, adding 75,000 units to its portfolio and achieving the second-largest portfolio increase among the Top 50 apartment managers.

The Department of Justice began in 1870, when Congress established a federal department to handle the government's legal affairs and support federal law enforcement. The Department serves as the principal agency for enforcing federal law, defending the interests of the United States, and protecting civil rights. Its work spans criminal prosecution, civil litigation, public safety, crime prevention, grantmaking, and legal oversight through a wide network of offices, litigating divisions, and law enforcement components. The Department also includes agencies and programs that support victims, manage corrections-related functions, and provide legal guidance across the federal government.
