Perspire Sauna Studio is a wellness franchise specializing in full-spectrum infrared sauna and red-light therapy. Founded in 2010 by Lee Braun in Southern California, the company combines traditional sauna practices with modern technology to promote detoxification, stress relief, and improved sleep. Perspire operates as a privately held business and has grown into one of the fastest-expanding infrared sauna franchises in the United States. The brand entered the Charlotte market in 2021 with its Providence Park location and later added a Ballantyne studio. Each location offers private suites equipped with infrared heaters, chromotherapy lighting, and entertainment options, along with optional contrast therapy through proprietary SNØ Showers. Perspire’s expansion strategy includes single-unit and multi-unit franchise agreements, positioning the company to meet rising demand for science-backed wellness services.

Sandbox VR began in 2016 when founder Steve Zhao pivoted from mobile games to create social virtual reality experiences. The company developed proprietary motion-tracking systems that enable groups to interact physically in virtual environments. Their business model combines corporate locations with franchise partnerships to expand globally. Sandbox VR creates original VR content designed for multiplayer participation and operates numerous international venues through both direct ownership and franchise agreements.

HTX Endodontics is a Houston-based endodontic practice focused on root canal therapy and related care for preserving natural teeth. The practice offers root canal treatment, endodontic retreatment, endodontic microsurgery, cracked tooth treatment, patient information, and referral resources for dental offices. HTX Endodontics also emphasizes advanced technology and patient-centered care in its approach to treatment and comfort.

Braids of Love Studio is a Houston hair salon focused on braids, locs, and natural hair styling. The studio offers services for women, children, and men, including knotless braids, crochet braids, and starter locs. Founding details remain unclear, and the company's origin history is limited.

Flawless Image Barber Shop and Art Gallery is a Houston personal care business that combines haircutting services with an art gallery. The business has served Houston for more than two decades and focuses on hair styling, hair coloring, special effects, and hair cuts. The company offers a broader salon offering that includes related grooming and hair care work, along with retail products. Flawless Image Barber Shop and Art Gallery is a neighborhood hair and beauty business with a steady local presence in Houston.

The Church of Pentecost - Bellaire Assembly is a Houston congregation within Church of Pentecost USA Inc., a Bible-believing Pentecostal church family. The broader Church of Pentecost traces its origins to Ghana and has grown into an international Pentecostal denomination, with a focus on worship, mission, and Christian formation. Bellaire Assembly serves as a local church expression of that network, with ministries centered on worship services, discipleship, small groups, prayer, and missions.

Relax Mind Wellness Clinic is a Houston-based practice focused on psychiatry and holistic health care. The clinic is an active psychiatric and mental health organization, with the business name registered in 2025. The practice is a locally owned private practice dedicated to compassionate care in psychiatry and holistic health. Relax Mind Wellness Clinic serves as a mental health clinic with an emphasis on psychiatric services and wellness-oriented care.

PEN America began in 1922 as a writers' organization and has grown into a nonprofit focused on free expression, literature, and human rights. The organization supports writers and readers through advocacy, research on threats to speech, literary awards, grants, fellowships, public programming, and membership activities. PEN America also works on issues such as book bans, educational gag orders, online abuse, and disinformation while maintaining a broad presence across the United States and worldwide through its connection to the PEN network.

Outlive Chiropractic & Wellness is a Houston chiropractic practice focused on care that supports health, mobility, and long-term wellness. The company offers chiropractic adjustments along with therapies such as myofascial release, dry needling, and therapeutic exercise, and the practice also addresses concerns including sports injuries, headaches, and pregnancy-related pain. Outlive Chiropractic & Wellness provides personalized appointments and serves veterans through VA Community Care, which places the business in both general chiropractic care and broader recovery-oriented services. The company operates under the Outlive Chiropractic name while presenting itself as a wellness-focused chiropractic provider.

Zen Drip Bar & Medspa is a Houston medical spa focused on IV hydration, wellness injections, and aesthetic care. The brand offers services that include neurotoxins, PRP, fillers, glutathione, hair-regrowth offerings, peptide therapy, lipodissolve, Celluma light therapy, and lab testing, reflecting a business centered on both wellness and cosmetic treatments. The company operates in Houston under the same name, establishing its presence as a Houston-based medspa brand.

Spiritual Lines Studios is a Houston tattoo studio that centers its work on tattoo therapy and appointment-only sessions. The studio operates at Unit 10 at the Ironworks campus in Houston's East End, where it is part of the broader creative business mix. The company operates a service model built around scheduled visits and hourly pricing, which reflects a studio structure rather than a walk-in retail format. The business functions as a specialized body-art studio with a clear emphasis on personal tattoo appointments and therapeutic framing.

Technicolor Tattoo, HTX is a queer-owned and operated tattoo studio in Houston's East End. The company focuses on custom tattoo design and offers a team with varied styles, including traditional, ornamental, anime and manga, fine line illustration, realism, cover-ups, and black-and-gray work. The studio emphasizes a safe environment and community connection while serving clients through both appointments and selected walk-in hours. The studio maintains an active roster that includes Jo Ann Woods, Cedro, Anji, and Sarah Bobby, reinforcing the studio's broader service offering within the tattoo and body-art vertical.

The Mood Room Garden and Bar opened in Houston as a beverage bar and social experience built around mood-inspired drinks. The company offers classic and craft cocktails, mocktails, non-alcoholic drinks, and alternative beverages that include THC and mushroom-based options. The Mood Room hosts private events and regular live programming such as comedy nights, music events, game nights, and themed gatherings. The company centers on bar service, event hosting, and a nightlife format that blends drinks with community-focused entertainment.

name: The Mood Room Garden ad Bar

profile.locationBio: GoJui Acai & Smoothie Bar is a Houston-based açaí and smoothie bar focused on fruit-forward drinks, bowls, and related juice-bar offerings. The business began as a simple setup in a shipping container, and the concept centered on fresh ingredients and made-to-order menu items rather than a large-format restaurant model. The menu includes açaí bowls, smoothies, lemonades, icees, and popsicles, and the business operates in Houston's East End area. The company has built a local food-service presence around quick-service, health-oriented menu items that appeal to customers looking for bowls and blended drinks.

Turkish Grand Bazaar takes its name from Istanbul's historic Grand Bazaar and presents itself as a Turkish goods shop centered on traditional crafts. The company offers products across categories such as mosaic pieces, wood carving, hand embroidery, Turkish tile, metallic embroidery, costumes, wire wrap, and personal gifts. The business operates as a home decor retailer in Houston, focusing on Turkish-made decorative and gift items. The company is built around Turkish craftsmanship, home accents, and specialty gifts for shoppers seeking cultural and decorative goods.

Galveston-Houston Immigrant Representation Project began in 2020 as a nonprofit legal services organization built to support immigrants with representation and access to due process. The organization focuses on immigration legal services and related social services, with work that includes family unity cases, protection from deportation, freedom from abuse and persecution, and citizenship support. GHIRP serves immigrants in the Galveston-Houston area and also offers community education through legal clinics, workshops, and know-your-rights sessions. The organization operates a holistic model that combines legal help with advocacy for immigrant rights and access to justice.

Dreamers Books + Culture is a curated bookstore focused on Latiné and Latin American books, authors, and culture. The company centers personalized attention, respect for communities, and a carefully selected catalog that spans fiction, nonfiction, poetry, children's books, and art. Dreamers Books + Culture began as a community-driven bookstore project that first reached readers through pop-ups before moving into a permanent shop in Houston. The business positions itself as a gathering place for cultural connection and literary discovery, with an emphasis on voices across Latin American diasporas and stories that broaden understanding of identity and heritage.

3twentysix began as a creative outlet and has grown into a retail-ready stationery and lifestyle brand with a brick-and-mortar presence in Houston's East End. The company sells feel-good stationery, stickers, desk goods, accessories, planners, notebooks, cards, tees, and hats, with products that are designed or sourced for a playful mix of humor, pop culture energy, and everyday motivation. 3twentysix maintains an in-person shop in Houston while supporting online sales and wholesale distribution, giving the business a presence across retail and business-to-business channels.

Mossrose Bookshop began in 2025 as a pop-up romance bookshop in Houston and later expanded into a physical storefront under the same brand. The company focuses on romance novels from a diverse range of authors and genres, and its offerings include books, audiobooks, accessories, book lists, pre-orders, and author-signing event items. Mossrose Bookshop also uses its space for community programming such as book clubs and upcoming in-store events, giving the business a presence that combines retail with reader-focused gatherings.

Nima Mex is a Houston-based boutique retailer focused on imported goods from Mexico and Colombia. The company's product mix includes Latin handmade bags, accessories, and handcrafts, along with ethically sourced Latin handcrafts and folk art. Nima Mex operates in a booth-based selling format, and the business was active by 2022 and remains active in recent times.

Ozzirys Boutique started as a Houston fashion boutique and has expanded into a broader retail mix that includes women's clothing, accessories, gifts, handmade bags, greeting cards, cosmetics bags, and kitchen or home items. The company offers new arrivals, dresses, tops, bottoms, rompers, denim, shoes, sweaters, outerwear, and gift-focused collections through its online shop, while in-person pickup is available for online orders. The business operates as a curated boutique built around unique pieces and seasonal drops, with a store presence in Houston and an emphasis on fashion and gift merchandise.

Wishful Heart Boutique is a family-owned boutique founded in Houston, Texas, in 2023. The company focuses on women's clothing across a broad size range and also carries accessories and game-day essentials. Wishful Heart Boutique sells through an online shop and offers in-store pickup at Ironworks Marketplace in Houston's East End. The company's catalog includes items such as tops, dresses, crop pants, fringe shorts, and blouses, representing a mix of everyday apparel and seasonal fashion merchandise.

Sew Great by Nery is a Houston-area sewing and creative studio that combines instruction, retail, and custom work. The business offers sewing classes for multiple skill levels, including beginner basics, garment-making, alterations, and project-based workshops, along with rentals for sewing machines and included fabric for many classes. Its broader creative offerings also include crochet, watercolor, hand embroidery, needlepoint, handmade gifts, and sewing supplies. The business is a family-owned small business specializing in sewing, embroidery, and wholesale services, which fits the company's current mix of instruction and merchandise.

Uncynical Wave is a veteran-owned business that designs, sources, and brings to market lighted art products for fans and collectors. The company focuses on premium 3D light frames and LED light boxes that combine layered artwork with illuminated displays for home decor, gifts, and fan collections. The company maintains a market presence that extends beyond its own online storefront through retail and exhibitor settings. The business has built its brand around fandom-oriented art themes and a product line centered on display pieces rather than general merchandise.

Shop Local Market began as a pop-up market focused on local artists, makers, vintage curators, small-batch brands, music, and food, and later expanded into permanent brick-and-mortar spaces in Houston. The company curates markets and special events that bring together handmade items, vintage goods, and products from local artisans and small businesses. Its offerings include an online market and vendor programs that support local creatives and entrepreneurs. Shop Local Market maintains an active presence through recurring markets, event calendars, and retail spaces centered on local shopping and community discovery.

Cargo Vintage is a Houston-based vintage clothing retailer that sells curated apparel through an online shop and a physical store presence. The company focuses on vintage tees, jackets, denim, sportswear, and women's vintage pieces, with inventory that spans clothing from the 1950s through the 1990s. Cargo Vintage's product mix also includes brand-specific and graphic apparel such as Liquid Blue items, Starter jackets, and other retro pieces, which places the business in both vintage resale and streetwear retail. The company has an established local market presence beyond its own storefront in Houston's vintage retail landscape.

Microvast began in 2006 and builds lithium-ion battery systems for electric commercial vehicles, energy storage systems, and battery components. The company is vertically integrated, with work spanning research and development, core battery chemistry, cell production, module assembly, and pack manufacturing. Its product portfolio serves electrification and energy storage use cases, and the company maintains a broad market presence tied to battery technologies and related components.

Brinshore is a real estate developer focused on affordable housing and community building. Founded in 1994, the company develops mixed-income residential communities, planned communities, single-family and townhome projects, multi-use buildings, and historic restorations and reuse. Brinshore combines development, ownership, and partnership roles to shape projects that can include residential, commercial, educational, and civic uses, while emphasizing collaboration and long-term sustainability. The company operates as a national developer with regional offices and a portfolio that spans communities across the United States.

name: Defined Mgmt - The Union at Winona

profile.locationBio: Mezcal Houston is a local Houston restaurant in Midtown that centers its menu on Mexican cooking and family recipes. The restaurant serves dishes made with fresh ingredients, including hand-pressed tortillas, birria, mole, enchiladas, tacos, fajitas, seafood, prime steak, desserts, and beverages. Mezcal Houston also provides reservations and offers a casual dining experience built around food, drinks, and a family-friendly atmosphere.

Empirical Wealth Management began in 2006 as a wealth management firm focused on comprehensive advice for clients with complex financial needs. The firm provides financial planning, investment management, tax strategy, estate planning, real estate, and insurance services. Empirical describes its approach as fiduciary, goals-based, and multidisciplinary, with planning that coordinates investments, taxes, legacy needs, and risk management. The business serves individuals and institutions through a broad advisory platform and a research-driven investment philosophy.

Asset Living is a third-party property management firm founded in 1986 that serves multifamily, student, and affordable housing communities across the United States. The company also works in active adult and build-to-rent housing, combining property management with services such as compliance training, financial planning, marketing, underwriting, due diligence, construction management, and data analytics. Asset Living operates as a broad real estate management platform that supports owners and institutional partners through property management, asset management, receivership, and investment services. The company maintains a national operating footprint built around residential real estate management and related support functions.

name: Asset - The Fuse at Park Row

profile.locationBio: Gruve began in 2024 as an AI-driven enterprise services company and launched with an initial acquisition that expanded its security and data-management capabilities. The company builds AI infrastructure, AI security, and governance offerings for enterprise workloads, and its services also span cybersecurity, data, customer experience, network automation, and enterprise application support. Gruve's portfolio includes managed services and implementation work across areas such as AI operations, secure access, observability, segmentation, and AI agent development. The company serves organizations seeking to move AI into production with measurable outcomes across security, infrastructure, and data.

ZRS Management began operations in 1991 as a multifamily property management firm. The company provides services including property operations, marketing, leasing, and accounting. Over the years, it has developed a diverse portfolio that spans conventional, affordable, and student housing properties. ZRS serves institutional clients and individual owners while maintaining a focus on community management. Through strategic growth, the company has established a significant national footprint in the property management sector.

The Schwager Law Firm is a legal practice focused on family, criminal, immigration, and property and financial matters, with services for individuals and businesses. The firm offers a broad legal practice that includes child custody, adoption, domestic violence, marriage and divorce, immigration, criminal law, and property settlements and rights. Candice Schwager has practiced in Texas since 1998, and the firm provides civil litigation, guardianship, probate, trust law, and business law experience. The firm represents clients across the United States and maintains a practice built around tailored legal solutions for clients in multiple legal verticals.

Founded in 1890, Gibson Dunn is a U.S.-based multinational law firm that provides legal services across litigation, regulatory, and transactional matters. The firm originated in Los Angeles and expanded nationally and internationally over the course of the twentieth century, establishing offices in major commercial and financial centers in North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Gibson Dunn advises corporations, financial institutions, and public entities on complex disputes, investigations, and cross-border transactions. The firm has developed recognized practices in appellate and constitutional law, antitrust, mergers and acquisitions, securities litigation, white collar defense, and public policy. Over its history, Gibson Dunn has represented clients in precedent-setting matters before the U.S. Supreme Court and other appellate courts.

BFP Educational Services provides educational services in Houston, with a focus on personalized learning and academic support for students of different ages. The company emphasizes education, connections, and practical solutions, with work centered on teaching, serving, and helping individuals pursue their goals. The company operates within the education services vertical and maintains a student-focused model built around individualized support.

JZ Law Group, P.C. is a Los Angeles law firm founded by Jacob Zadeh to represent property owners and businesses in disputes. The company focuses on real property litigation, landlord-tenant matters, civil litigation, construction defects, and appeals, with work that covers ownership, leases, contracts, and related business disputes. JZ Law Group, P.C. also prepares transactional documents such as purchase agreements, leases, and business contracts, tying its advisory work to the same litigation-focused practice. The firm builds its legal practice around court advocacy, negotiation, and case resolution for clients across the Los Angeles area.

profile.locationBio: LLF National Law Firm began in 2008 and focuses on education law and academic defense for students, parents, faculty, and school employees. The firm handles student discipline matters, Title IX defense, academic misconduct, disability accommodations, discrimination, and related school disputes across the United States. The practice covers K-12, college, graduate, and professional programs, and the firm has represented thousands of clients through difficult school-related cases.

profile.locationBio: Hatch Fertility, formerly known as The Egg Donation and Surrogacy Program, began in 1991 and focuses on third-party reproduction services for intended parents, surrogates, and egg donors. The company provides egg donation and surrogacy programs, including matching, screening, and support throughout fertility journeys, and also offers fixed-fee and all-inclusive program options for IVF-related family building. The company helps people build families through a national fertility network and a long-running surrogacy practice.

name: Pacific Fertility Center Los Angeles

profile.locationBio: Lemon Law is a California-based law firm that focuses on lemon law and vehicle warranty disputes. The business began in 2024 and serves consumers seeking help with defective cars, buybacks, refunds, replacements, and related claims under state lemon law rules and the federal Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act. The firm provides free case reviews and no-upfront-fee representation, and it publishes state and manufacturer-specific resources for drivers dealing with recurring vehicle defects.

Salon Republic began in 2000 with a single studio in Studio City and has since expanded into a salon-studio business serving independent beauty professionals. The company provides private salon suites and related amenities such as lockable storage, towel service, Wi-Fi, and in-salon beauty supply access, while also offering a platform for clients to find beauty professionals. Salon Republic's business mix extends beyond studio rentals into education and media, including blog content, podcasts, and the Hair Game podcast hosted by founder Eric Taylor. The company maintains a broad presence across California and several other western states, reflecting a salon-studio model built around flexible workspaces for beauty pros.

True West Capital Partners began in 2009 and focuses on providing flexible capital solutions to middle-market companies across the United States. The company structures debt and equity investments for acquisitions, growth capital, leveraged buyouts, management buyouts, recapitalizations, and refinancings. Its current investment focus spans business services, consumer and food, healthcare, niche manufacturing, transportation, and logistics. The company's portfolio has expanded beyond its western roots while it continues to emphasize long-term relationships, candor, and trust in its investment approach.

RPM is an Austin, Texas-based multifamily property owner-operator, investment, and development firm active across the United States. Founded in 2002 as Roscoe Property Management by Jason Berkowitz, the company began with just 10 units under management. Through both organic growth and strategic mergers, RPM Living has evolved into one of the nation's largest multifamily operators. 

The firm manages 226,169 units across 26 states. RPM operates through a vertically integrated platform encompassing property management, investment acquisitions, and development. The company maintains 12 regional offices. In 2021, RPM merged with Atlanta-based CF Real Estate Services, expanding its footprint across the Southeast and Midwest. This transaction added approximately 26,000 units to the portfolio. The merger with CF Real Estate Services brought together leadership from both organizations under the RPM brand. 

RPM's assets total a portfolio valued at $3 billion. The company's operations span conventional multifamily, student housing, senior living, and affordable housing sectors. In 2023, RPM Living experienced its largest year of growth, adding 75,000 units to its portfolio and achieving the second-largest portfolio increase among the Top 50 apartment managers.

VIV Athletic Club is a West Los Angeles athletic club focused on strength training, group fitness, personal coaching, and recovery services. The company offers free weights, powerlifting, boxing, climbing, and InBody analysis alongside wellness amenities such as sauna, cold plunge, red light therapy, compression boots, and hyperbaric oxygen. VIV Athletic Club supports independent trainers and provides custom fitness programs, race preparation, and women's health support. The company is a fitness and recovery destination built around strength, longevity, recovery, and community.

Spectrum Solutions Acquisitions provides residential property preservation and inspection services for mortgage servicing and related property management needs, with offerings that include property securing, winterization, debris removal, yard maintenance, eviction support, and a range of inspection services. The company performs residential renovation and repair work, including lender-driven repairs, insurance claim repairs, and fix-and-flip renovations, which places it across property services and light construction activity. The business engages in field service management work tied to maintenance and alteration of residential buildings, reinforcing its role in the real estate services market.

aliases: Marina Plastic Surgery, Los Angeles, P.C.

profile.locationBio: Marina Plastic Surgery is a cosmetic surgery practice that offers facial, breast, and body procedures alongside non-surgical med spa care and skin-rejuvenation treatments. The company provides consultations, surgical procedures, med spa treatments, and recovery-focused care supported by board-certified plastic surgeons and accredited surgical facilities. Marina Plastic Surgery was founded as a plastic surgery practice in 1986 and has since built a broad aesthetic medicine portfolio that includes cosmetic surgery, non-invasive body contouring, laser treatments, and other skin-care services.

name: Marina Plastic Surgery

profile.locationBio: Regus began in Brussels in 1989 as a flexible office space provider and has since grown into a global workspace brand within International Workplace Group. The company offers private offices, coworking desks, virtual office plans, meeting rooms, day offices, business addresses, and related workplace services for businesses and individuals. Regus serves customers through a broad network of workspaces designed for short-term and long-term use, with services that support office needs, collaboration, and business presence across markets worldwide.

Sky Project Management, formerly Sky Acquisitions LLC, provides government contracting, procurement, project management, and professional services for government and corporate clients. The company centers its work on contract execution, procurement strategy, project delivery, and consulting support, with services framed around federal, state, and municipal work. Sky Project Management also pairs its service offering with strategy sessions and training content focused on government contracting, giving the business both advisory and educational verticals. The company operates in Houston under the Sky Project Management and Professional Services name.

Texas Protax has focused on property tax protest and appraisal reduction work since 1988. The company handles the full protest process, including property value review, informal negotiations, formal Appraisal Review Board hearings, and arbitration when needed. Texas Protax serves residential and commercial property owners and works across Austin, Central Texas, San Antonio, and the Greater Houston area, with a team that includes licensed consultants, realtors, attorneys, appraisers, and former Appraisal District employees.

Sergio Cantu Photography offers photography and video services in Houston and surrounding areas. The company specializes in portrait sessions, quinceañera coverage, and save-the-date shoots. Sergio Cantu Photography handles both photo and video work for local clients, with a focus on event and portrait imagery.

Orbach Huff & Henderson LLP is a California law firm that provides full-service legal representation for public agencies and private clients across the state. The firm focuses on insurance defense, coverage, business litigation, and a broader mix of transactional and trial work tied to construction, public works, real property, procurement, governance, and related disputes. Founded in 1997, the company emphasizes conflict-free counsel and serves clients in several practice areas that support project delivery, dispute resolution, and public-sector legal needs.

Tanglewood Coworking provides coworking memberships, resident desks, private offices, meeting rooms, and virtual office options centered on shared workspace and business support services. The company also offers mail handling, a registered agent service, and Texas business formation help, positioning the business at the intersection of workspace, administration, and company setup services. Its offerings are built around flexible access, front-desk support, and address-based services for individuals and organizations that need a professional office presence without a traditional long-term lease.

The Akeeli Group provides customized due diligence, business intelligence, background and compliance checks, competitive intelligence, social media mapping, and human source collection for private-sector clients. The company also conducts in-jurisdiction investigations and market-entry due diligence to support assessments of partner, reputational, and operational risk. InfoFax Investigations became part of the business in 2023, bringing an established investigations practice under the current brand.

Fabrega Hood is a law firm focused on litigation matters that include commercial disputes, personal injury, insurance coverage, construction, and premises liability. The firm handles consumer, insurance, commercial, and personal injury work, reinforcing a practice built around civil disputes and related claims. The firm provides legal representation for individuals and businesses across these practice areas.

Langdon Manor Books specializes in original source materials that tell American stories, with a focus on American social movements, American personal narratives, photo albums, and outsider books. The company buys and sells rare printed matter and archival materials, including diaries, scrapbooks, and other original items tied to underrepresented groups, courageous women, LGBTQ+ history, Western Americana, and business and commercial history. The business operates as a dealer that preserves everyday stories through collecting, cataloging, and offering material in those subject areas, building its trade around historically significant primary materials rather than conventional retail books.

Onebox began in 1997 and offers a virtual phone system built to manage business communications through a single service. The company's product set includes auto-attendant call routing, professional greetings, voicemail, online faxing, conferencing, mobile apps, text messaging, and web-based account controls. Onebox also provides virtual office assistant options that route calls, support business phone numbers, and let users manage calls and faxes without physical hardware. The service is positioned for small businesses and individuals that need a flexible business phone and messaging platform.

The Sylvie is a French-European bistro with menu service spanning breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and the company also offers online ordering and catering. The Sylvie features a dining concept built around lighting and a central tree-like sculpture, with a name tied to the Latin root for forest and a French form of Sylvia. The business also offers coffee, cocktails, beer, and food items, giving The Sylvie a broad daytime-to-evening restaurant profile in downtown Houston.

Vision Source is a network of private practice optometrists that supports independent eye care through shared expertise, member programs, and business resources. Founded in 1991, the organization was created to preserve independent optometry and build a collaborative model for professional eye care. The company supports member practices with staff training, business growth tools, practice transitions, and managed vision care resources. Vision Source also connects independent eye doctors through buying-group benefits and a broad support network centered on private practice care.
